title: Social Media Manager & Strategist (AI-Savvy)
description:
NOW HIRING: Social Media Manager & Strategist (AI-Savvy)



Remote | Part-Time | Flexible Hours



ABOUT US



Queen Clean is a growing commercial and residential cleaning company based in Bozeman, Montana, USA.



We're looking for a creative, proactive, and results-driven Social Media Manager & Strategist to help strengthen our online presence, grow our audience, and improve our overall social media footprint.



We're not just looking for someone who can create pretty graphics or schedule posts. We want someone who understands social media strategy, account management, analytics, a local audience, and how to turn creative ideas into measurable results.



We're especially interested in someone who has experience working with U.S.-based businesses and knows how to leverage AI tools to improve marketing, content creation, and overall social media marketing impact.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Social Media Management & Strategy



• Develop and implement social media strategies aligned with our business goals.

• Manage social media accounts, including content planning, scheduling, publishing, and performance monitoring.

• Identify opportunities to improve brand awareness, audience engagement, and growth.

• Research trends, competitors, and creative marketing opportunities.



Content Creation & AI Integration



• Create engaging graphics, captions, reels, and short-form video content.

• Maintain a consistent brand identity and voice across platforms.

• Use AI tools to improve creativity, productivity, and marketing workflows.

• Explore new content ideas and creative approaches relevant to our local market.



Analytics & Performance



• Monitor social media analytics and track relevant performance metrics.

• Identify what works, what needs improvement, and why.

• Provide clear performance updates and actionable recommendations.

• Continuously refine strategies based on actual data and results.



Team Collaboration



• Collaborate with Queen Clean's owner and management team.

• Participate in scheduled Google Meet co-working and strategy sessions.

• Communicate progress, share ideas, and provide recommendations proactively.

• Manage deadlines and follow through on agreed priorities.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



• Minimum of 2 years of professional social media management and marketing experience with U.S.-based businesses or clients, either within a company or as an independent contractor.

• Demonstrated ownership of social media strategy, execution, performance, and measurable results.

• Platform Expertise: Demonstrated experience managing business accounts across major platforms, including
, Instagram, LinkedIn, and TikTok, as applicable.

• Content Planning and Execution: Experience developing and managing content calendars, writing engaging copy, coordinating creative assets, scheduling posts, and maintaining consistent brand messaging.

• Performance Optimization: Ability to interpret analytics, identify opportunities, and proactively adjust strategies to improve reach, engagement, traffic, and conversions.

• Community Management: Experience monitoring comments, messages, and audience engagement while maintaining a professional brand voice.

• Marketing Tools: Proficiency with social media scheduling, publishing, reporting, and content creation tools.

• Portfolio: Strong portfolio showing previous work, managed accounts, and actual analytics or performance results.

• Social Media Strategy: Experience developing social media strategies, not just creating content.

• Analytics and Reporting: Familiarity with social media analytics and performance reporting.

• AI Proficiency: Knowledge of AI tools and their practical applications in marketing.

• Communication Skills: Excellent written English and understanding of U.S. audiences.

• Professional Attributes: Creative, detail-oriented, organized, and reliable.

• Independence and Initiative: Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable working independently.

• Collaboration: Comfortable collaborating in real time through Google Meet.



Nice to Have:



• Experience creating AI avatars or AI-generated videos.

• Experience marketing local service-based businesses.

• Experience with AI-assisted video editing and content creation.



WORK SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY



This is a remote, part-time position with flexible hours.



Much of the work can be completed independently. However, we're looking for someone who can provide some consistent availability during our Montana business hours:



9:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time (Montana, USA)



You do not need to work the entire 9–5 schedule.



However, you must be comfortable joining scheduled Google Meet co-working sessions to collaborate, discuss strategies, review performance, and work together on marketing initiatives.



Clear communication, reliability, and the ability to work collaboratively are important to us.



OPPORTUNITY FOR GROWTH



We're looking for someone who wants more than just another short-term project.



This position will begin as part-time, with the possibility of expanding as Queen Clean continues to grow.



We value creativity, initiative, accountability, and someone who genuinely enjoys helping a small business succeed.



HOW TO APPLY



If you're interested in joining our team, please complete our application form:







In your OnlineJobs.ph application message, please briefly answer the following questions:



1. Why are you interested in this role, and what makes you a strong fit?

2. Which social media management, design, scheduling, and analytics tools have you used?

3. Which responsibilities have you personally handled (strategy, content creation, publishing, reporting, account management, advertising, etc.)?

4. What AI tools have you used professionally for social media marketing, and how do you use them?

5. If you managed social media for a cleaning company in Bozeman, what would you prioritize during your first 30 days?



WHAT TO EXPECT DURING OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS



As part of our interview process, candidates should be prepared to share and discuss:



• Portfolio and Work Examples: Social media accounts you've managed, content you've created, and strategies you've developed.

• Organic Performance: Actual metrics demonstrating results, such as reach, engagement, audience growth, website traffic, and conversions.

• Campaign Performance: Examples of campaigns you've managed, including objectives, execution, performance metrics, and outcomes.

• Strategy and Decision Making: Your role in developing strategies, evaluating performance, and making adjustments to improve results.

• Professional References: Please be prepared to provide 2–3 professional references from previous clients or employers if you advance to the next stages of our hiring process.



We're interested in understanding not just the work you've produced, but the results you've achieved and your direct contribution to those outcomes.



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Please include the keyword QUEEN somewhere in your OnlineJobs.ph application message.



APPLICATIONS WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY DISQUALIFIED IF:



• The required Google Form has not been completed and submitted.

• The keyword QUEEN cannot be found in your OnlineJobs.ph application message.



Both requirements must be met for your application to be considered.



We value attention to detail, initiative, and candidates who carefully follow instructions.



We look forward to learning more about you! 💜



Queen Clean | Bozeman, Montana, USA

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter, Neutral Accent (Full-Time, Soft Sales, US Hours)
description:
Hi there!



We're a US sales agency hiring a full-time remote phone caller with a clear, neutral English accent.



The Job

You call independent natural food stores in the US and offer the buyer a free product placement. It is a relaxed, soft-sell role, not hard sales. Most calls take 3 to 4 minutes. On a calling day, our callers typically get 3 to 10 stores to say yes.



Who We're Looking For

Neutral-accent spoken English that US store buyers understand easily. We check this with your voice sample.

Phone experience with US customers is preferred, not required. If you are talented and new to this, apply.

A headset and a quiet room, so your voice comes through clearly. Wired internet and a USB headset are preferred.

Someone who wants a steady, long-term role and will be excited to do it well.



Schedule (Required)

Full time, Monday to Friday, 10:00 pm to 6:00 am Philippine time (9:00 pm to 5:00 am from mid-March to early November). That is 9:00 am to 5:00 pm US Eastern time. Full time is preferred. If you are a strong caller who can only work 20 to 30 hours a week inside those hours, apply and tell us your availability.



Pay

$5 per hour plus $3 for each store that says yes. Our part-time callers have earned about $25 to $120 in bonuses per two-week pay period when calling consistently. The rate rises to $6 per hour once you have shown strong performance and stayed with us, typically 3 to 6 months. Paid every two weeks. Independent contractor.



Timeline and Paid Trial

Interviews start right away. Training starts in early December, with three 3-hour paid trial shifts at $5 per hour. Calling starts in early 2027.



How to Apply

Send a short voice sample in English with your application. One you already have is fine. A Vocaroo link is best (free, no sign-up). A Google Drive link or an audio file works too. A Loom video works too. Please turn on downloading, because we download it to review it. Applications without a voice sample will not be reviewed.

title: Personal Assistant
description:
I’m looking for a sweet, bubbly, and sassy high-level Personal Assistant to work directly with me as my right hand. Most of this role is executive assistant work: running my calendar, priorities, making phone calls, communication, and projects. The rest is personal logistics, keeping my life outside of work organized so I can stay focused.



I’ll be upfront. This is a demanding role, not a basic admin job. You will be in the middle of everything I’m doing, day to day, as our company scales fast.



*You must speak English with little to no accent.*



About me and the company



I’m the co-founder and COO of BookDrop, a fast-growing bulk book logistics and resale company. We’ve more than doubled headcount in the last year and we’re not slowing down. I need someone who is organized, proactive, warm, and hungry to be the best assistant they can possibly be. Not someone looking for a comfortable job. Someone who wants to be trusted with real responsibility and become indispensable to an executive long-term.



The details



Full-time remote, based in the Philippines, working Arizona hours (starting 6:00 AM AZ time flexible).



What you’ll do



Act as my right-hand partner in daily execution and organization

Manage my calendar, scheduling, reminders, and priorities

Organize communication, follow-ups, and task tracking

Support operations, growth projects, and leadership workflows

Handle personal logistics: travel, appointments, purchases, family scheduling, and the small things that pile up

Build clean systems in Google Sheets and other tools

Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) every day to draft, research, organize, and move faster



This role requires serious initiative. You don’t wait to be told every step. You think ahead, bring solutions, and stay steady when things move fast.



Required skills



Advanced Google Sheets skills

Real, hands-on experience using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT. Non-negotiable. You should be using AI daily, not something you tried once.

*Strong English communication, written and spoken*

Highly organized and comfortable juggling many priorities at once

Tech-savvy and quick to learn new tools

Reliable internet and the ability to work US hours





Who thrives here



Wants to be THE best assistant



If you read the expectations above and felt excited instead of nervous, you’re probably who I’m looking for.





How to apply



Send your resume to 
 with “More Books!” in the subject line and include a roughly 2-minute video covering:



What is your favorite non-fiction book and why?

Why you’d be a good fit for this role



The video is how I judge your English and vibe. TIP - Be camera ready, dont be too formal (relax and have fun), and dont choose atomic habits as your favorite book.



Also feel free to send any attachments that show your Google Sheets and AI skills.



Applications without both a resume and a video will not be reviewed.

title: Customer Relations/ Sales in Real Estate
description:
Job description:

Compensation:1500$ plus 0.5% of all deals closed and1% in renegotiation

Customer Relations Specialist

Location: Miami, FL -remote

Job Type: Full-Time



About Us



Solution Based Homebuyers is a fast-growing real estate investment company specializing in identifying, acquiring, and managing residential properties. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment and are expanding our Customer Relations team in Miami.



Position Overview



Once our Acquisitions team signs an agreement with a seller, the file is transferred to Customer Relations. As a Customer Relations Specialist, you will take ownership of the seller relationship and help guide the transaction from contract to closing.



Your responsibility is to maintain strong communication with the seller, keep the deal moving forward, resolve issues, and renegotiate terms when necessary to ensure the transaction remains viable.



This is not a traditional customer service position. It is a customer-facing role that combines relationship management, negotiation, sales, and problem-solving. Successful team members are confident communicators who can protect the relationship while also protecting the profitability of the deal.



Key Responsibilities



Take ownership of signed agreements transferred from the Acquisitions team



Build and maintain strong relationships with sellers throughout the transaction



Follow up consistently to keep sellers engaged and deals moving toward closing



Renegotiate pricing or contract terms when necessary



Identify and resolve issues that could delay or jeopardize a transaction



Set clear expectations with sellers regarding timelines, inspections, documentation, and next steps



Maintain accurate and detailed notes, tasks, and updates within the CRM



Coordinate closely with Acquisitions, Dispositions, Transaction Coordination, and other internal departments



Ensure smooth departmental handoffs and clear communication across every active file



Escalate high-risk files and develop solutions before issues become major problems



Work toward individual and company performance goals tied to closed and funded transactions



Qualifications



Proven sales, negotiation, account management, or relationship-management experience



Strong verbal and written communication skills



Confident handling difficult conversations and negotiating contract terms



Ability to build trust while remaining firm and solution-oriented



Highly organized and capable of managing multiple active files at the same time



Strong follow-up habits and attention to detail



Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment



Self-motivated, accountable, and results-oriented



Real estate experience is preferred but not required



Experience in real estate, solar, insurance, automotive sales, or another high-activity sales environment is a plus



What We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is competitive, organized, persuasive, and emotionally intelligent. You should be able to connect with sellers, uncover the real cause of an issue, and confidently guide the conversation toward a solution.



You must be comfortable taking ownership of your files and being held accountable for performance.



Why Join Solution Based Homebuyers?



High earning potential tied directly to deal performance



Base compensation plus commission



Clear opportunities for advancement within a growing real estate company



Hands-on training and support



Collaborative, in-office team environment



Fast-paced culture focused on execution, accountability, and results



We are hiring immediately.



Experience:



Sales: 1 year (Preferred)

Location:



Miami, FL 33133 (Preferred)

Shift availability: Monday- Saturday 



Work Location: Remote

title: Skool Ads Media Buyer
description:
NOW HIRING: Skool Ads Media Buyer & Community Growth Specialist



Position: Skool Ads Media Buyer

Employment Type: Contract / Part-Time (Potential for Long-Term Partnership)

Work Arrangement: Remote



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced, results-driven Media Buyer who specializes in running paid advertising campaigns and scaling Skool communities.



We need someone who understands the Skool platform, knows how to generate quality leads and paying members, and has a proven track record of scaling online communities through paid advertising.



This is NOT an entry-level position. We are looking for someone who has actual experience managing ad campaigns, optimizing conversions, and scaling membership-based businesses.



Responsibilities



* Plan, launch, manage, and optimize
 and Instagram ad campaigns.

* Develop advertising strategies specifically designed to grow Skool communities.

* Drive consistent new member acquisitions and increase monthly recurring revenue (MRR).

* Optimize campaigns for cost per lead, cost per acquisition, and return on ad spend.

* Analyze campaign performance and make data-driven decisions.

* Create and test different ad creatives, hooks, copy, and audiences.

* Develop retargeting strategies to convert interested prospects into paying members.

* Monitor daily ad spend, campaign performance, and conversion rates.

* Identify opportunities to increase membership while maintaining profitable acquisition costs.

* Provide weekly performance reports and growth recommendations.

* Work toward aggressive membership and revenue growth targets.



Required Qualifications



* MUST have previous experience running paid ads for Skool communities.

* MUST have experience scaling membership-based businesses or online communities.

* Proven experience managing
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

* Strong understanding of sales funnels, conversion tracking, and retargeting.

* Experience optimizing campaigns for recurring revenue and customer acquisition.

* Ability to interpret ad data and make strategic adjustments.

* Must be results-driven and comfortable working toward measurable growth goals.



What We Are Looking For



We want someone who knows how to take a community from hundreds of paying members to thousands.



We are looking for a strategist, not someone who simply knows how to press buttons inside Ads Manager.



You should understand how to:



* Acquire new paying members consistently.

* Scale ad spend without destroying profitability.

* Lower customer acquisition costs.

* Increase conversions from ads to paid memberships.

* Build a predictable paid acquisition system.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your previous experience running ads for Skool communities.

2. Examples of Skool communities you have helped grow.

3. Before-and-after membership numbers.

4. Monthly ad budgets you have personally managed.

5. Results achieved, including cost per acquisition and revenue generated.

6. Screenshots or case studies demonstrating your results.

7. Your monthly management fee or proposed compensation.



IMPORTANT: Applicants without previous paid advertising experience and proven results scaling Skool communities will not be considered.

title: SENIOR FULL-STACK AI ENGINEER, CREATOR PLATFORM
description:
SENIOR FULL-STACK AI ENGINEER, CREATOR PLATFORM



BOSS MGMT GRP | Full-time | Remote | Long-term



Only apply if you have built software for an influencer marketing platform or agency. Applications without a specific example will not be reviewed.



ABOUT US

BOSS MGMT GRP is a creator economy and brand partnerships group. We manage 400+ creators across YouTube, Instagram and TikTok.



We are building our own operating system to replace HubSpot and run the entire business: creator discovery, outreach, onboarding, rosters, media kits, brand CRM, contracting, campaign fulfilment and automation. The foundations are in place and running on real data, but there’s still a lot to build. We need a senior engineer who has done this before to help us finish it.



THE ROLE

You will work alongside the developer who built the platform, our in-house full-stack developer, and both directors. You report to the directors day-to-day. You will have a real say in architecture.



YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

- Assess the architecture. Review the codebase and data model and deliver a written assessment by day 30: what is solid and what is fragile.

- Get outreach live. Fix contact enrichment, finish the review-and-approve flow, and switch on in-platform
 sequences with deliverability done properly.

- Land the HubSpot transition. Migrate creators, brands and deals into the platform, with clean deduplication and suppression so signed creators never receive cold outreach. HubSpot is switched off in April 2027.

- After that: campaign fulfilment and contracting, plus deals, finance and reporting.



MUST-HAVES

- Hands-on engineering experience on an influencer marketing or creator sponsorship platform, or building in-house tools for an influencer agency. For example, platforms such as Faved, ThoughtLeaders, InfluencerFunds, Agentio or similar.

- 5+ years of full-stack experience with TypeScript, React/Next.js, and PostgreSQL.

- You have run a CRM or large data migration end-to-end: mapping, deduplication, parallel run, cutover.

- You have shipped LLM features in production (drafting, classification, enrichment, retrieval) and know how to keep them accurate and auditable.

- YouTube Data API and YouTube Analytics API experience, including OAuth and quota management.

- Queue and background job architecture for scraping, enrichment and scheduled runs.

- You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) daily, and can still explain and defend every line you ship.

- Clear written and spoken English. You can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical directors.



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- HubSpot API and data model experience.

- Instagram Graph API and TikTok API experience.

-
 infrastructure: Resend or similar, SPF / DKIM / DMARC, warm-up, suppression, sender reputation.

- Integrations with PandaDoc, Xero or payment platforms.

- You have built campaign fulfilment workflows: deal tracking, deliverables, approvals, reporting to brands.

- You have set up Claude or similar AI tools for a non-technical team: projects, connectors, skills and automations that people use every day.



OUR STACK

- Next.js on Vercel, Neon PostgreSQL with Prisma, Vercel Blob, Vercel Cron and service queues, Anthropic Claude API, Resend, Gmail API, HubSpot API. Planned: PandaDoc, Xero, Airwallex.



TERMS

- Full-time independent contractor, engaged by BOSS MGMT GRP HOLDINGS LIMITED.

- Three-month paid trial at your full rate, with a checkpoint on day 30. Ongoing engagement after that.

- Philippines preferred. Southeast Asia and India also considered.

- Working hours start at 9 am Manila time, with daily overlap with our Australian and European team.

- Side work is fine as long as it doesn’t conflict and isn’t in the influencer marketing space.

- Start as soon as possible.



A NOTE ON CONFIDENTIALITY

We are hiring for your skills and experience. We do not want, and will not ask for, any confidential information, code or data belonging to a former employer or client.



HOW TO APPLY

 your application to CEO Michael Harris 
 and Director Blake Jenkins 
 both in the same
.



Subject line: ROSTER - Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer - [Your Name]



Answer all six questions in the
. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



1. Which influencer marketing platform or agency tool did you work on, what was your role, and for how long?

2. What exactly did you build there? Name the features or modules you personally shipped.

5. Your expected monthly rate in USD, and your earliest start date.

6. Links to your LinkedIn, GitHub and anything live that you built.



HIRING PROCESS

1. Application review.

2. Short intro call.

3. Paid test task (3 to 4 hours) on a real problem from our platform.

4. Panel interview with our developers and both directors.

5. Offer.

title: Track & Trace – Quality Assurance Team Lead (Brokerage Operations)
description:
GH Logistics is a growing US-based freight brokerage and asset-based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. Our operations are built on strong systems, clear communication, accountability, and reliable execution.



We're looking for an experienced, detail-oriented, and results-driven Track & Trace Quality Assurance Team Lead to oversee our QA operations, lead a team of remote associates, and ensure every booked load is properly verified before pickup. This is a hands-on leadership position for someone with strong US freight brokerage experience, sound operational judgment, and the ability to hold a team accountable in a fast-paced environment.



If you have experience managing logistics operations, identifying freight fraud risks, resolving escalations, and driving team performance, we'd like to hear from you.



Role Overview

Every day, GH Logistics books trucks to move freight across the United States. Before those trucks pick up, our Quality Assurance team verifies that the assigned drivers are legitimate, qualified, properly documented, and prepared to execute their loads.



As the Quality Assurance Team Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing the team's daily workload, monitoring verification progress, reviewing operational accuracy, and ensuring that no critical verification steps are overlooked. You will serve as the primary point of escalation for unresolved driver verification issues, suspicious carrier activity, tracking discrepancies, and operational concerns that could affect pickup performance or shipment security.



Beyond supervising the team, you are expected to remain actively involved in operations, make timely decisions, identify process gaps, and ensure consistent execution of established SOPs. This is a working leadership role, not solely an administrative or supervisory position. You must be comfortable stepping into operational tasks, handling difficult situations, and taking ownership of your team's results.



What You'll Be Doing



Team Leadership & Daily Operations

• Lead and supervise the Quality Assurance team, ensuring all assigned next-day loads are reviewed and verified before pickup.

• Distribute workloads based on shipment volume, urgency, team capacity, and operational priorities.

• Monitor individual and team productivity, task completion, verification accuracy, and overall performance.

• Ensure team members consistently follow established SOPs, verification procedures, and documentation standards.

• Provide real-time guidance, coaching, and corrective feedback to improve individual and team performance.

• Identify performance gaps, recurring errors, and accountability concerns, and escalate them to management when necessary.

• Maintain clear shift handovers, ensuring pending verifications, unresolved issues, and critical follow-ups are properly communicated.

• Take ownership of daily QA execution and ensure operational priorities are completed without unnecessary delays.



Load Verification, Quality Control & Fraud Prevention

• Oversee the verification process for booked loads, ensuring rate confirmations are sent to the correct carriers.

• Ensure driver information, carrier details, and load assignments are complete, accurate, and properly documented.

• Review CDL verification results and ensure required identity verification procedures are followed.

• Monitor compliance with driver check calls, tracking assignments, and pre-pickup verification requirements.

• Conduct quality checks and spot audits to identify incomplete verifications, documentation errors, and procedural violations.

• Investigate inconsistencies involving driver identities, carrier information, contact numbers, and shipment assignments.

• Identify potential freight fraud, identity mismatches, double-brokering indicators, and other suspicious activities.

• Immediately escalate high-risk concerns to Carrier Sales, Operations, and Management.

• Ensure questionable or unverified assignments are escalated and appropriately resolved before freight movement.



Escalation Management & Operational Decision-Making

• Serve as the first point of escalation for QA associates handling complex or unresolved verification issues.

• Investigate discrepancies between rate confirmations, TMS records, carrier instructions, driver information, and shipment documents.

• Make timely, informed decisions within established authority and escalate matters requiring management approval.

• Coordinate with Carrier Sales, Track & Trace, and Operations to resolve verification delays, missing information, and potential service failures.

• Prioritize urgent operational concerns based on fraud risk, pickup deadlines, shipment impact, and customer requirements.

• Ensure unresolved issues are properly documented, assigned, and followed through until resolution.

• Communicate critical i
 to management with clear findings, actions taken, and recommended next steps.



Driver Coordination & Tracking Oversight

• Ensure assigned drivers are contacted and properly informed of pickup and delivery details, appointment times, and equipment requirements.

• Oversee the accuracy of driver information entered into the Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Monitor GPS tracking assignments and ensure tracking readiness before scheduled pickups.

• Ensure CDL verification links are sent and outstanding requirements are followed up on promptly.

• Verify that team-driver assignments meet the required confirmation procedures.

• Step in to conduct driver or dispatcher calls when necessary to resolve urgent issues or support the team.

• Ensure no assigned load is overlooked due to incomplete follow-ups or unclear ownership.



Performance Monitoring, Reporting & Process Improvement

• Track daily QA performance, including load verification completion, documentation accuracy, outstanding requirements, and unresolved escalations.

• Monitor individual productivity and identify associates who require additional coaching or support.

• Prepare clear operational updates and performance reports for management.

• Review recurring verification errors, missed follow-ups, and operational bottlenecks.

• Recommend improvements to workflows, verification procedures, and quality control processes.

• Support onboarding and training of new QA associates to ensure they understand operational expectations and SOPs.

• Promote a culture of accuracy, urgency, accountability, and continuous improvement.



What Success Looks Like

• All assigned next-day loads are reviewed and verified before pickup.

• QA associates consistently complete required verification steps accurately and on time.

• Driver information, CDL verification, tracking assignments, and check calls are properly documented.

• Potential freight fraud indicators are identified early and escalated immediately.

• High-risk or unresolved verification issues are not overlooked or allowed to progress without appropriate action.

• Workloads are distributed fairly and effectively, and the team consistently meets operational deadlines.

• Individual performance is monitored, and recurring errors are addressed through coaching and accountability.

• Carrier Sales, Operations, and Management have clear visibility into verification progress and outstanding concerns.

• Shift handovers are organized, with no critical tasks left without ownership.

• QA processes become more consistent, efficient, and reliable under your leadership.



Who We're Looking For

• At least 2 years of hands-on experience in a US freight brokerage, trucking carrier, or third-party logistics (3PL) company, preferably in Track & Trace, carrier operations, dispatch, or logistics quality assurance.

• Previous experience as a Team Lead, Senior QA Associate, Operations Supervisor, or similar leadership role is strongly preferred.

• Strong understanding of US trucking operations, including driver assignments, pickup and delivery appointments, equipment requirements, and CDL verification.

• Familiarity with freight fraud prevention, carrier verification, and operational risk management.

• Experience using Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and GPS tracking platforms such as FourKites, Samsara, or MacroPoint.

• Proven ability to manage workloads, monitor team performance, and maintain operational accountability.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the confidence to make decisions under pressure.

• Ability to investigate conflicting information, identify operational risks, and determine appropriate escalation actions.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including confidence communicating with US-based drivers, dispatchers, and operational leadership.

• Comfortable handling outbound calls, difficult conversations, and urgent operational escalations.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.

• Ability to coach team members, provide constructive feedback, and address performance concerns professionally.

• High attention to detail, strong ownership, and a proactive approach to operational challenges.

• Minimum typing speed of 50 WPM.



Work Setup & Schedule

• Work Arrangement: Full-Time Remote | Direct Engagement with a US Company

• Schedule: Sunday - Thursday 7 AM - 5 PM Central Time | Tuesday - Saturday 7 AM - 5 PM Central Time

• Contract Type: Independent Contractor

• Active, attentive, and proactive Zoom participation with camera on is required throughout scheduled shifts.

• Time tracking software is used for accountability and performance monitoring.

• Reliable internet connection, backup internet and power supply, and a suitable remote workspace are required.



What You'll Get

• Long-Term Opportunity: An ongoing leadership role within a growing US logistics company.

• Monthly Stipend: $75 monthly insurance stipend, with eligibility beginning after 30 days of engagement.

• Regular Payment Schedule: Payments processed twice monthly according to established payroll schedules.

• Leadership Experience: Take ownership of team performance, operational quality, and daily execution.

• Direct US Operations Exposure: Work closely with US-based logistics teams and operational leadership.

• Meaningful Operational Impact: Help prevent freight fraud, protect shipments, improve operational accuracy, and strengthen team performance.

• Structured Workflows: Established SOPs, clear expectations, and opportunities to contribute to process improvements.



Ready to Apply?



Freight fraud prevention and operational accuracy are critical to the success of our business. We're looking for a leader who can do more than supervise a team, someone who can take ownership, make sound decisions, hold people accountable, and ensure every verification is completed correctly.



If you're an experienced US logistics professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving complex operational problems, and knows how to lead a team toward consistent results, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Carrier Onboarding Representative
description:
GH Logistics is a growing freight brokerage and asset-based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. Our strength comes from reliable carrier partnerships, disciplined execution, clean communication, and scalable capacity across the U.S. As our network continues to expand, we are looking for a Carrier Onboarding Representative to help identify, verify, onboard, and develop relationships with reliable trucking carriers across our priority markets.



This role is not just about adding carriers to our network. It is about building a dependable carrier base, maintaining strong relationships, and ensuring our operations teams have access to qualified carriers when capacity is needed.



Role Overview

You are responsible for sourcing, vetting, onboarding, and maintaining relationships with qualified carriers while supporting the growth and reliability of GH Logistics' carrier network. You will work directly with U.S.-based trucking companies to identify carriers operating in our priority markets, verify their qualifications, complete onboarding requirements, and maintain accurate carrier records.



This is a high volume and phone-based role that requires persistence, organization, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced freight environment. This role does not involve booking loads or negotiating freight rates. Your primary responsibility is to ensure qualified, verified carriers are properly onboarded, documented, and connected with the appropriate internal teams. This role is strictly for fluent English speakers, as the position requires constant communication with U.S.-based carriers and internal team members throughout the shift.



What You'll Be Doing



Carrier Sourcing and Network Development

• Make at least 30 outbound calls daily to identify and connect with potential carriers.

• Handle approximately 20 inbound calls daily related to carrier inquiries, onboarding, and follow-ups.

• Identify reliable carriers actively operating in GH Logistics' priority markets.

• Build professional relationships with carrier owners, dispatchers, and fleet representatives.

• Introduce GH Logistics and explain our carrier onboarding process, freight network, and communication expectations.

• Identify carrier operating areas, preferred lanes, equipment types, and availability.

• Follow up with existing carriers to maintain engagement and updated information.

• Focus on developing long-term carrier relationships rather than simply increasing onboarding numbers.



Carrier Verification and Fraud Prevention

• Verify carriers using approved tools

• Review carrier operating authority, insurance coverage, safety records, and compliance information.

• Check the company's Do Not Use (DNU) list before proceeding with onboarding.

• Identify potential red flags involving fraud, double brokering, or suspicious carrier information.

• Ensure all verification requirements are completed before onboarding a carrier.

• Escalate questionable carriers or compliance concerns to management.

• Follow company-approved verification procedures without skipping required steps.



Carrier Onboarding and Documentation

• Successfully onboard at least 3 qualified carriers daily.

• Complete all required carrier onboarding documentation accurately and efficiently.

• Ensure carrier information and compliance records are complete and up to date.

• Create at least 1 group chat daily with a newly onboarded carrier to establish direct communication.

• Immediately post every newly onboarded carrier in the designated channel.

• Ensure every onboarded carrier is properly recorded and accessible to the appropriate internal teams.

• Coordinate with internal teams to ensure newly onboarded carriers are ready for potential freight opportunities.



Carrier Relationship Management and Tracking

• Update and maintain spreadsheet daily.

• Track carrier onboarding activity, call volume, follow-ups, and carrier information.

• Maintain accurate carrier contact information, operating preferences, and relevant details.

• Monitor existing carrier records and update information as needed.

• Ensure all onboarded carriers are properly documented and included in the appropriate tracking systems.

• Maintain organized daily activity logs and communication records.

• Coordinate with internal teams to address carrier-related inquiries or concerns.



Directory and Communication Management

• Maintain the GH Logistics carrier directory and designated group chats.

• Add new contacts and remove outdated or inactive members as needed.

• Ensure appropriate team members are included in required communication groups.

• Maintain accurate group membership and required administrative access.

• Escalate missing information, access restrictions, or communication issues to management.

• Keep carrier communication organized, professional, and accessible to internal teams.



What Success Looks Like

• Consistently completes 30 outbound calls daily.

• Handles approximately 20 inbound calls daily.

• Successfully onboards at least 3 qualified carriers daily.

• Creates at least 1 group chat daily with a newly onboarded carrier.

• Every onboarded carrier is properly verified through approved tools.

• No carriers on the DNU list are onboarded.

• All newly onboarded carriers are immediately posted in the communication channel.

title: Transportation Tracker - OTR Operations
description:
AJG Transport is expanding its route operations division and seeking a reliable, detail-oriented professional to help support and streamline our daily transportation duties. We are looking for a Transportation Tracker to support real time fleet movement, manage load data accuracy, and ensure smooth coordination between drivers, customers, and internal teams.



Role Overview

You will serve as a real time control point within route operations. Your responsibility is to ensure loads are properly assigned, tracked, updated, and documented while maintaining consistent communication across drivers, brokers, and customers. You will operate within structured SOPs while making fast, sound operational decisions when challenges arise.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor lanes, driver movement, load progress, ETAs, and service requirements using GPS and TMS.

• Assign and dispatch loads based on driver availability, Hours of Service, customer requirements, and operational priorities.

• Maintain accurate real-time load data, check calls, timestamps, delivery milestones, and documentation in TMS and Google Sheets.

• Communicate with drivers, brokers, and customers while proactively addressing delays, route conflicts, detention risks, and other service issues.

• Follow established dispatch and escalation SOPs, provide clear shift reports and handoffs, and escalate operational risks to leadership as needed.



What Success Looks Like

• Monitor lanes and critical loads with urgency, accuracy, and consistency from start to finish.

• Maintain complete, accurate, and up-to-date information across TMS, Google Sheets, and tracking platforms.

• Provide scheduled updates on time with clear, concise, and actionable communication.

• Identify and escalate operational risks early, bringing solutions and next steps whenever possible.

• Maintain smooth and well-documented shift handoffs, and demonstrate reliability during high-pressure situations.



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in logistics, freight brokerage, dispatch, transportation tracking, or similar operations, with an understanding of fleet coordination, load planning, and Hours of Service.

• Ability to monitor multiple loads and drivers simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, urgency, and proper prioritization in a live dispatch environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills across Zoom, chat, and
, with a minimum typing speed of 45 WPM.

• Highly detail-oriented with sound judgment, strong follow-through, and the ability to operate effectively in high-volume communication environments.

• Team oriented, coachable, and dependable, with a willingness to follow established processes, accept feedback, and collaborate without resistance or ego.



Why Join AJG Transport?

• Permanent remote opportunity with a stable, long-term setup.

• Structured systems, clear expectations, and defined performance KPIs.

• Hands-on leadership with direct feedback, coaching, and support.

• Measurable growth opportunities within a scaling freight brokerage.

• Performance recognition with advancement potential for strong contributors.



Schedule & Work Setup

• Direct hire, full time position with a US based company, and permanent work from home setup.

• Available shift: Sunday - Thursday 9:30 PM - 7:30 AM CST

• Zoom presence with camera on and audio unmuted is required throughout the scheduled shift.

• Time tracking software is used for accountability and performance support.



If you thrive in fast moving transportation operations, understand the importance of real-time coordination, and can execute lanes with precision under pressure, we want to hear from you.

title: Trailer Management Admin
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Thursday - Monday 8 PM - 6 AM CST | Tuesday - Saturday 8 PM - 6 AM CST

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Hubstaff time tracking during shifts.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who can recognize trailer issues, coordinate repairs, follow up consistently, and ensure equipment returns to service as quickly as possible

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.

• Candidates who are unfamiliar with trailer maintenance concerns or are uncomfortable coordinating repairs and operational solutions



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, properly repaired, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, problem-solving, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.

Terms

title: E-commerce Inventory & Listings Specialist (Amazon, Shopify)
description:
E-commerce Inventory & Listings Specialist (Amazon, Shopify)

Full-time, remote. Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm US Central (10:00pm to 7:00am Manila time from November to March; 9:00pm to 6:00am from March to November). Reports to Michelle, Operations.



IF YOU'VE EVER CAUGHT A BAD FLAT FILE BEFORE IT WENT LIVE, READ ON

The inventory file says one number, the warehouse says another, and the upload is due in the morning. Most people upload and hope. We're looking for the person who stops, traces the gap to its source, and fixes it first.



ABOUT LUX & NYX

Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. Featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. We sell across Shopify DTC, Amazon, Nordstrom, and Macy's, and through a corporate gifting channel. Remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu.



THE ROLE

You'll own the accuracy of everything we put on a marketplace and every number we report on: available-to-sell and inventory files, listings on Amazon, Shopify and our retail partners, our daily sales and ads reports, and the orders, returns and customer messages that follow. You'll be our warehouse's main contact, and you'll work closely with Michelle, who leads operations.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Inventory and available-to-sell files: keep one master product sheet as the source, reconcile inventory and ATS files for SKU, UPC and quantity before every upload, and check them live after. That includes Amazon, Shopify, our retail portals, and our ESP and SAGE corporate gifting catalogs.

• Listings: launches, price updates, retired SKUs, flat files and approved promotions, plus a weekly check for suppressed or rejected listings.

• Reporting: prepare our daily sales report and marketing ads reports, check every number against its source, and flag what doesn't add up.

• Orders, returns and the warehouse: keep orders moving, check the returns, files and invoices our warehouse sends, and follow up with vendors until every issue is closed.

• Customer care and reviews: answer customers within one business day, warmly and in our brand voice, including refunds, returns and warranty claims.

• Production support: prepare purchase orders, packing lists and shipping documents from approved inputs for our weekly production meeting.

• Tickets and SOPs: follow every Seller Support and portal ticket until it's fixed, and write down every step you own.



Not part of this role: pricing, budget and other financial decisions, paid ads management, forecasting, corporate gifting quotes and orders (another teammate owns those), running the warehouse floor, product design, and accounting.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• You stop rather than upload. If a count, price or SKU doesn't match its source, nothing goes live until it does. That's the number one thing.

• Hands-on listing work for a brand or seller: Amazon flat files, Seller Central, retailer portals or Shopify product setup, including fixing rejected or suppressed listings.

• 2+ years reconciling inventory, orders, invoices or e-commerce reports for someone else to act on.

• Strong spreadsheet skills: formulas, lookups and reconciliations.

• Comfortable with totals, per-unit costs and variances, and you can show where every figure came from.

• Customer care for an online brand, written warmly and clearly.

• You work it out yourself. AI can help you draft or double-check, but the thinking and the judgment are yours.

• Clear, polished written English, and steady follow-through without anyone having to chase you.

• Here for the long haul: you want to own this work and get great at it.



A strong plus: Mirakl, ShipStation, ESP or SAGE catalogs, EDI, packing lists and carton planning, or working day to day with a 3PL.



You don't need every box ticked. If you catch the mistake before it goes live and you can show where every number came from, we want to hear from you.



WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

• Every upload matches the master sheet, and nothing goes live with an open question.

• Every report goes out on time and matches its source.

• Customers hear back within one business day.

• Every open ticket and vendor issue has a next step.



PAY AND BENEFITS

US$600 to $1,300 a month depending on experience, plus a performance bonus. Paid PTO. Health stipend. Weekly 1:1 with Michelle, async-first on Slack.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply right here on OnlineJobs.ph. Your application must do three things:



1. Start with the word TRACE.

2. Answer this in your own words: It's Monday, December 21. Tomorrow at 10:00am US Central you upload the Amazon available-to-sell file. Last Friday's inventory file shows 448 units of the Belt Bag in Black. On Saturday, 30 units shipped on a corporate order. Today's warehouse count shows 412 units. 12 customer returns arrived Friday and haven't been inspected yet. The warehouse is closed Thursday and Friday for Christmas. title: Client Project Manager (Part-Time, US Hours)
description:
Visit this link for a video explanation of this role by Travis Rose:





ABOUT GROWING ROSES



Growing Roses is a consulting firm run entirely by Travis Rose in Dallas, TX. Travis helps companies across every industry and department — finance, legal, HR, operations, development, L&D — design and configure ClickUp around how they actually work.





THE ROLE



Title: Client Project Manager (contract, part-time, remote)

Hours: 20 hours/week

Schedule: Available for client calls 12:00–4:00 PM US Central, Monday–Thursday (2:00–6:00 AM Philippine time; 1:00–5:00 AM during US daylight saving time). Remaining ~4 hours flexible.

Pay: $1,000 USD/month, rising to $1,200/month once month-3 milestones are met (typically ~90 days), plus a 13th-month bonus each December

Type: Independent contractor, with intent to build a long-term relationship

Availability: As soon as possible





WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



Projects slow down when action items slip — both by Travis and his clients. Travis is strong at discovery and solution design, but weaker at follow-up and keeping many threads organized across projects. This role owns the follow-through so projects move faster and nothing falls through the cracks.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Attend all client calls live, with camera on

• Capture clear minutes and action items: who, what, by when

• Keep action items and meeting notes current in each client's ClickUp workspace

• Read back action items at the end of each call

• Open calls by following up on last meeting's items, including the uncomfortable ones

• Chase clients between meetings via
/ClickUp/Slack/etc. when they're blocking progress

• Keep a short cross-client list of what needs Travis's attention, and run a quick priority review with him after calls

• If time remains in the 20 hours after the above is accomplished, assist with admin tasks (logging time, calendar review, etc.)





FIRST 90 DAYS



• Month 1: Attend every call, write minutes and action items. Travis reviews them before they go out.

• Month 2: Run the action item read-back at the end of calls. Minutes go out without review.

• Month 3: Open calls with follow-ups and chase clients between meetings on your own.



These milestones can be met earlier based on Travis's discretion and trust. Pay increases to $1,200/month once Month 3 milestones are met.





REQUIREMENTS 

• Reliably available for live calls 12:00–4:00 PM US Central, Mon–Thu.

• Clear written and spoken English at a fluent conversational level (this is a FIRM requirement) 

• Proactive, organized, and deadline-driven — you follow up without being reminded

• Confident speaking up with senior client stakeholders

• Comfortable learning unfamiliar industries quickly; you don't need to be an expert, just able to capture who, what, and by when

• Experience with flexible work management tools like ClickUp, 
, Notion, Asana, etc. 

• Experience coordinating projects with multiple stakeholders, including clients or other external parties.

• Stable internet, a quiet workspace, and a reliable computer







SECURITY AND CONFIDENTIALITY



Our clients are security-conscious. You'll:

• Sign an NDA, a contractor agreement with IP assignment, and client NDAs where required

• Provide an NBI clearance before your start date

• Use a 1Password vault provided by Growing Roses for all credentials for this work

• Work browser-only, with nothing stored locally





HIRING PROCESS



1. Initial application — When you apply, include:

   • A link to your LinkedIn profile (preferred) or your résumé

   • A link to a video (Loom, Google Drive, or unlisted YouTube) of you answering the following in 5 minutes or less:

      a. Tell me about a time a project stalled because someone else wasn't delivering. What did you do?

      b. How do you keep track of action items across several projects at once?

      c. Our calls are 2–6 AM your time (1–5 AM during US daylight saving time). How would you make that work long term?

2. Interview with Travis (45 minutes, during the US Central meeting window)

3. Paid work sample ($25) — Watch an hour-long recorded client meeting and send the action items and a short summary.

4. References — Two, ideally past managers who can speak to meeting deadlines.

5. Paid trial week ($250) — Sign the NDA first, then attend real client calls, write minutes, and run one read-back.

6. Offer





SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



• Every client call ends with clear, confirmed action items

• Client action items stop slipping for weeks

• Travis's own commitments get done on time

• Travis spends less time organizing and more time solving problems



—



Thanks for reading! I look forward to your application.

Red Branch Outdoor Living is a residential design-build company in South Alabama. We build decks, patio covers, pavilions, outdoor kitchens, and landscaped outdoor spaces.



We’re looking for someone who enjoys both sides of design: figuring out how an outdoor space should look and feel, and drawing it clearly enough for a crew to build. On one project, you might turn field measurements into a 3D model of a deck and patio cover. On the next, you might design the planting beds and help our salesperson show the homeowner how the whole backyard will come together.



You’ll work directly with our sales team, structural engineers, and production team. Your drawings will be used in client conversations, engineering reviews, and on real jobsites.

- Model outdoor projects in SketchUp and produce 2D and 3D concept drawings from site photos, field measurements, and the salesperson’s notes.

- Design planting layouts around how people move through the space. Use sun and shade, soil moisture, drainage, mature plant size, spacing, and maintenance needs to choose what goes where.

- Create a scaled planting plan and plant schedule with labeled locations and quantities by plant type. Review it with the salesperson and flag any site questions the team needs to resolve.

- Coordinate drawing revisions and keep projects organized in JobTread. Work with engineers on redlines, answer drawing questions from the field, and keep the latest plans easy to find.



What we’re looking for

- Experience with SketchUp or comparable 3D drafting software and the ability to produce clear, dimensioned construction drawings.

- A portfolio that shows both technical drafting and planting or landscape design.

- Practical knowledge of how outdoor structures are assembled and an eye for how decks, paths, patios, and planting beds fit together.

- Ability to research plants suited to South Alabama and explain why your selections fit the site.

- Clear written English for drawing notes, questions, and team updates, along with reliable internet for remote work.

- SketchUp LayOut, JobTread, and U.S. residential permit drawing experience are advantages.

title: Marketing & Growth Coordinator – AI-Powered Content, Social Media & Outreach (US Law Firm)
description:
A note from Omari Ruddock, Managing Partner



I’ll be straight with you about why this job exists. I run Ward Ruddock, a personal injury and property insurance law firm in Miami, Florida. We represent people after car and truck crashes, serious a
, and storms that tear their homes apart, and then we take on the insurance companies for them. We do great work for our clients. The problem is that not enough people know about us yet.



I have the knowledge and the stories. I don’t have time to film content every day, and I don’t want a marketing system that waits on me. I’m hiring someone who can produce a high volume of strong content on their own, using the best AI tools available, and who can build the relationships that bring in new clients.



You won’t be one of ten assistants in a pool. You’ll work directly with me, and what you do will show up in how fast this firm grows. 



What you’ll own, in order of priority



Content: the voice of the firm. You create content from start to finish, without waiting on me to film. You use AI tools (Bloom, Higgsfield and others), along with design and editing tools, to produce reels, short videos, carousels, graphics and explainers that teach people their rights after an a
 or an insurance denial. You write the hooks, scripts and captions. You keep our calendar running at 2 posts a day, 7 days a week, across Instagram,
, LinkedIn and TikTok, and you queue each week’s content for my approval in one batch. You also manage our Google Business Profile and make sure every happy client is asked for a review.



Partner outreach: building our referral network. You research and build lists of local businesses that see injured people every day (chiropractors, physical therapists, body shops, public adjusters, roofers). You reach out by
, LinkedIn and phone, book intro meetings onto my calendar, prepare a short brief before each one, and follow up afterward. You keep every relationship warm in our CRM.



Social lead response: the first reply. When someone messages us after the worst day of their life, you answer quickly and kindly using our scripts, collect their basic info, and get them booked with our intake team. You never give legal advice or talk about case details. We train you on exactly what to say. This takes the least of your time, but when a message comes in, it jumps to the front of the line.



What a week here actually looks like



On Monday you plan the week’s content around what people in South Florida are searching for and worried about: hurricane claims, trucking crashes, insurance denials. By Wednesday, 14 posts are built, captioned and waiting in my approval queue. In between, you send outreach
s, follow up with a chiropractor who opened your message twice, and book two lunch meetings for me on Thursday. A message comes in from someone hurt in a crash on I-95, and you answer within minutes and get them on the phone with our team. On Friday you send me a short report: what posted, what performed, how many meetings got booked, and how many leads came in.



What it’s like to work here



We’re client-centered. Our clients come to us hurting and scared. Everything we put out should make them feel they’ve found people who will actually help.



We’re easygoing about style and serious about standards. No micromanaging and no politics. Deadlines are deadlines, though, and quality matters.



You’ll be heard. If you find a better tool, format or hook, use it and show me the results. I want someone who improves our systems, not just someone who follows them.



You’ll grow. As our marketing grows, this role grows into leading it.



You’re probably the right person if:



You already use AI tools to create images, video and copy, and you can show work that doesn’t look like generic AI

You’ve grown a business’s social accounts and can show the numbers

You know what makes someone stop scrolling within the first 2 seconds

title: eCommerce Performance Marketing Creative Strategist

We want someone who understands what makes an ad convert, can independently develop creative ideas, and knows how to turn them into engaging, high-performing ads. You'll have plenty of creative freedom to experiment with different hooks, angles, storytelling approaches, and formats.



**What You'll Be Doing**



- Develop original ad concepts/scripts supporting a target of 60 finished video ads monthly, including iterations and variations of winning ads.

- Research competitor ads, customer pain points, reviews, objections, and creative trends to identify new angles worth testing.

- Write engaging, conversion-focused scripts for short-form, long-form, VSLs, UGC-style, storytelling, and other experimental ad formats.

- Create clear, production-ready briefs for our video editor, including scripts, voiceover direction, B-roll suggestions, and visual references.

- Study our existing winning ads, analyse Meta performance, and develop meaningful iterations to improve results.

- Prepare a weekly creative testing plan outlining what ads to create, which angles to test, and the reasoning behind them.

- Work closely with our editor, review finished ads, and provide feedback to ensure the creative vision is executed well.



**Who We're Looking For**



- Proven experience developing direct-response video ads for eCommerce brands (ideally 7+ figures brand), particularly on Meta.

- Proven track record of achieving meaningful results with the ads you've developed.

- Strong understanding of direct-response performance marketing, buyer psychology, what stops scroll, storytelling, and what makes an ad convert.

- Excellent scriptwriting and copywriting skills, with the ability to create natural, relatable, and persuasive ads.

- Experience analysing creative performance and developing iterations of winning ads.

- Able to work independently, take ownership of creative strategy, and consistently bring fresh ideas.

- Creative, proactive, reliable, and a good communicator.

- Experience creating ads for UK audiences or the ability to write scripts tailored to different regions.

- Interest in the automotive or security niche is a plus, but not essential.



You don't need professional video editing skills. We're looking for someone who knows what ads to create, why they should work, and how to communicate that vision to an editor. 



Competitive compensation based on experience, with performance bonuses for exceptional results and opportunities to grow into a larger creative leadership role.



To apply please tell us:



Your experience working as a Creative Strategist.

Your portfolio, best ad concepts, scripts and finished creatives.

A brief introduction to your creative research and testing process.



Please note shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short creative strategy test.
