title: WE’RE HIRING: PERSONAL INJURY CASE MANAGER (REMOTE – PHILIPPINES)
description:
# WE’RE HIRING: PERSONAL INJURY CASE MANAGER (REMOTE – PHILIPPINES)



**Edvin Jones Injury Law | U.S. Personal Injury Law Firm**



<text>**Location:** Davao City, Philippines (Preferred) – Applicants from other Philippine cities are welcome</text>



**Position:** Full-Time Personal Injury Case Manager  

**Salary:** $800 USD per month  

**Schedule:** 40 hours per week  

**Work Arrangement:** 100% Remote  

**Start Date:** Immediately



### About the Position



Edvin Jones Injury Law, a growing U.S. personal injury law firm handling cases in Nevada, California, and Arizona, is seeking an experienced **Personal Injury Case Manager** to join our team in the Philippines.



We are looking for a dedicated, organized, and reliable professional who has direct experience working for a **U.S.-based personal injury law firm** and is proficient in **Filevine**.



**IMPORTANT: DO NOT APPLY unless you have BOTH U.S. personal injury law firm experience AND hands-on Filevine experience. These are mandatory requirements.**



### Key Responsibilities

- Manage personal injury cases from intake through settlement.

- Communicate professionally with clients, insurance adjusters, medical providers, and attorneys.

- Maintain accurate case files, notes, deadlines, and tasks in Filevine.

- Request and follow up on medical records, billing statements, and insurance information.

- Monitor clients' medical treatment and case progress.

- Assist with demand preparation, settlement negotiations, and case documentation.

- Follow up with insurance companies regarding claims, coverage, and liability.

- Coordinate with attorneys and other team members to ensure cases move forward efficiently.

- Provide regular updates and ensure excellent client service.



### Mandatory Qualifications

- **Previous experience working for a U.S. personal injury law firm.**

- **Strong hands-on experience using Filevine.**

- Knowledge of U.S. personal injury claims, insurance procedures, medical treatment, and case management.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple cases.

- Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote workspace.

- Available to start immediately.



### Additional Requirements

- **Exclusive Employment:** You must not work for another law firm while employed with us.

- Must be willing to undergo lawful employment and criminal background screening.

- Must maintain strict client confidentiality and professional ethics.

- Must be dependable, responsive, and committed to a full-time, 40-hour workweek.



### Location Preference



We strongly prefer candidates located in **Davao City**, but applicants from anywhere in the Philippines are welcome if they have substantial U.S. personal injury experience and strong Filevine skills.



### How to Apply



Send your resume to 



*
 Subject:** PI Case Manager – Philippines – [Your Name]



Please include:

1. Your resume and relevant U.S. personal injury experience.

2. How many years you have used Filevine.

3. Names of the U.S. personal injury firms you previously worked for.

4. Your current city in the Philippines.

5. Your earliest available start date.



**Applications without demonstrated U.S. personal injury experience and Filevine proficiency will not be considered.**



**Join Edvin Jones Injury Law and grow your career with an expanding U.S. personal injury law firm.**

title: EXPERIENCED PARALEGAL (REMOTE)
description:
Edvin Jones Injury Law is expanding, and we are looking for a highly experienced, independent, and dedicated Paralegal to join our growing team.



We are a fast-growing personal injury law firm handling cases in Nevada, California, and Arizona. We are looking for someone who wants a long-term career and is ready to grow with us.



Position Details



Position: Experienced Personal Injury Paralegal



You have to know how to work with Filevine and court filing.



Location: 100% Remote



Schedule: Full-Time, 40 Hours Per Week



Starting Salary: $1100 USD Per Month



Career Growth: Performance and promotion review after 6 months



Requirements – PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



1. Must Have Actual Paralegal Experience



We are NOT looking for a case manager, legal assistant, or paralegal assistant.



A case manager's responsibilities are different from those of a litigation paralegal. Please apply only if you have real, hands-on paralegal experience.



2. Must Know Court Procedures and Filing Rules



You must have working knowledge of court procedures, deadlines, document preparation, and electronic filing requirements in at least ONE of the following states:



California



Nevada



Arizona



You do NOT need experience in all three states. Experience in at least one is required.



3. Must Be Able to Work Independently – NO INITIAL TRAINING PROVIDED



This is not an entry-level position. We expect you to already know how to perform the essential responsibilities of a litigation paralegal.



You must be comfortable preparing legal documents, managing litigation deadlines, handling court filings, and following applicable procedural rules without step-by-step training.



4. Exclusive Full-Time Employment Required



This is an exclusive, full-time position. You may NOT simultaneously work for another law firm or legal employer.



Any undisclosed outside legal employment, misrepresentation of working hours, or misuse of confidential firm information will be treated as a serious breach of your employment agreement and may result in immediate termination and appropriate legal action, including referral to authorities where criminal conduct is suspected.



5. Commitment, Accountability, and Professionalism



We value employees who take ownership of their responsibilities, meet deadlines, communicate effectively, and genuinely care about the quality of their work.



Why Join Us?



Edvin Jones Injury Law is growing rapidly, and we want people who will grow alongside the firm.



We believe in rewarding dedication, reliability, and excellent performance. After six months, you will be eligible for a performance review and consideration for promotion and increased compensation.



We are not looking for someone who simply wants another remote job. We are looking for someone who wants to become a valuable, long-term member of our team.



If you have the experience, discipline, and commitment, we want to hear from you.



How to Apply



Send your resume to 



Subject Line: Experienced Remote Paralegal Application



In your
, please identify which state's court rules and filing procedures you have experience with (CA, NV, or AZ).



IMPORTANT: Please do not apply unless you meet the qualifications above.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
The Role



Third Chair (YC X25) is hiring a Data Operations Analyst (contractor) to join our Data Ops team. Our platform finds brands using music on social media without a license, and our customers (record labels, music publishers and law firms) rely on accurate data about who those brands are and who to contact. You'll work from a queue of tickets, each with a clear request and rules, and close them carefully and on time.



You'll work closely with our team to:



- Find decision-maker contacts at specific brands (General Counsel, legal, marketing and brand leads) using LinkedIn, Apollo and company websites, and record names, titles,
s and LinkedIn URLs.

- Link brands' Instagram, TikTok,
 and X accounts to the right parent company, including regional and sub-brand accounts (e.g. every mall, cinema and retail franchise of one group in the Middle East).

- Review social media videos against our customers' music catalogs, confirm matches, and claim or re-attribute them in our dashboard.

- Record and capture evidence of social posts for legal cases.

- Comment on each ticket with what you found and how, so the work can be checked.



What We're Looking For



- 1–2+ years of lead generation, B2B research or data research experience.

- Strong LinkedIn research skills: you can find the right person at a large company, not just any person.

- Experience with 
, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, RocketReach or similar tools.

- Very careful about following rules and instructions; you double-check before marking work done.

- Clear written English.

- Reliable internet and availability for part of US business hours.



Nice to Have



- Familiarity with Instagram/TikTok business accounts and how brands structure their regional accounts.

- Interest in music, media or entertainment.

- Experience working from a ticketing tool (Linear, Jira, Trello, Asana).



About Third Chair



Third Chair (YC X25) builds AI-powered legal infrastructure with human lawyers in the loop, helping rightsholders turn complex legal workflows into scalable revenue. We're founded by two second-time YC founders with prior exits. Yoav previously co-founded Trendpop (YC W21), and Shourya previously co-founded Fello (YC W22). Backed by Y Combinator and FundersClub, our customers include major record labels and music publishers.



Structure / Expectations



- Independent Contractor, fully remote

- 20 hours/week (about 4 hours/day, Monday–Friday)

- At least 2 hours/day overlapping US Eastern business hours

- Work assigned and tracked in Linear; communication over Slack

title: Senior Meta Media Buyer + Account Infrastructure (Restricted E-Commerce)
description:
About us

We're a small performance marketing agency running Meta ads for e-commerce brands in restricted categories (mushrooms, peptides, CBD/cannabis accessories). One of our clients runs 5 brands and we're scaling toward $1M/month in revenue, so we need someone who can both build the account infrastructure and run the buying.



What you'll do

Infrastructure

- Buy and set up FB profiles, business managers and ad accounts from suppliers

- Set up AdsPower profiles and proxies

- Handle card verification, identity/selfie checkpoints and appeals

- Install pixels/CAPI and set up cloaked links

- Replace disabled accounts fast and keep a backup supply ready for every brand



Media buying

- Launch and relaunch campaigns across many ad accounts (horizontal scaling)

- Run creative testing and scale winners

- Write creative briefs for our designer

- Send a short end-of-shift report: what's live, pending and blocked



Requirements

- 2+ years running Meta ads in restricted/grey-hat niches

- Hands-on experience buying and building accounts in AdsPower or another antidetect browser

- Experience with cloaking and with spreading spend across many accounts

- Proof of results: screenshots of accounts you've scaled

- Reliable: stable internet, backup power, shows up on time every shift

- Must overlap 9 AM-1 PM Pacific (12 AM-4 AM Philippine time) every weekday



Pay

Up to $2,000 USD/month depending on experience, paid twice a month via Payoneer, with a monthly performance bonus. 30-day probation.



How to apply

Start your application with the word SCALE and answer:

1. What's the most monthly ad spend you've scaled a single brand to on Meta, and in what niche?

2. Walk us through taking purchased profiles to a live ad: AdsPower setup, business manager, ad account, payment and first launch.

3. Which account suppliers and cloaking tools have you used?

4. A business manager gets disabled mid-scale. What do you do in the first hour?

5. What hours (Philippine time) can you work, and are you currently working for anyone else?

title: 3D Product Rendering Artist for Lighting Fixtures

How to apply

title: Operations Support Specialist
description:
Remote | Full-Time | Long-Term Opportunity | Philippines



About Realty Hub



Realty Hub is an established U.S. real estate brokerage operating across Florida, Georgia, and Alabama.



Our remote operations team supports real estate agents through documented procedures, internal systems, and a centralized knowledge base. We focus on providing accurate, dependable support while continuously improving how our business operates.



We’re looking for a reliable, detail-oriented professional who enjoys learning, researching information, solving problems, and taking ownership of their work.



Prior real estate experience is not required. What matters most is your ability to learn, follow procedures accurately, think independently, and apply what you’ve learned.



We’re seeking someone interested in building a long-term professional relationship with our company.



About the Role

As an Operations Support Specialist, your initial responsibilities will focus on live chat support, routine agent inquiries, and basic operational assistance.



You’ll learn to navigate our internal resources, locate accurate information, assist agents, and recognize when a question requires additional review or escalation.



As you demonstrate proficiency, you may gradually take on additional operational responsibilities.



We’re not looking for someone who simply memorizes answers. We’re looking for someone who can research, understand, verify, and apply information independently.



Primary Responsibilities



Agent Support & Live Chat

Respond to agent inquiries through live chat and other assigned support channels.

Research answers using standard operating procedures (SOPs), company policies, and internal resources.

Communicate clearly, accurately, and professionally.

Identify situations requiring additional review or escalation.

Document inquiries and complete necessary follow-ups.



Operational Support

Follow established procedures for assigned administrative tasks.

Review information and documents for completeness and accuracy.

Maintain accurate records, trackers, and task statuses.

Verify required information before completing assigned workflows.

Track pending tasks and follow through without repeated reminders.

Additional Responsibilities as You Develop



Depending on your progress, you may gradually learn:



Agent onboarding and activation workflows.

License transfers and listing-related administrative tasks.

Basic transaction document review.

Additional operational systems and procedures.

SOP updates and knowledge base improvements.

Advanced responsibilities are introduced gradually, based on demonstrated proficiency and operational needs.



How We Work

We don’t expect you to know every answer or memorize every procedure.



We do expect you to:



Research before asking: Consult available documentation and resources before seeking assistance.

Understand, not just memorize: Learn why procedures exist so you can apply them to different situations.

Follow through: Track unfinished tasks and ensure nothing is overlooked.

Verify information: Prioritize accuracy over speed.

Use sound judgment: Recognize when to investigate further and when to escalate.

Learn from feedback: Apply corrections and avoid repeating preventable mistakes.

Take ownership: Be accountable for your responsibilities and communicate proactively.

Asking questions is encouraged. We value thoughtful questions that demonstrate preparation, effort, and a willingness to learn.



Training & Professional Development

We provide structured onboarding and ongoing opportunities to develop your professional skills.



Your initial training will include:

Guided navigation of our SOPs and support resources.

Introduction to internal systems and workflows.

Practical exercises and simulated agent inquiries.

Supervised live chat and operational tasks.

Regular feedback and progress reviews.

Training begins with a limited number of responsibilities. As your accuracy, confidence, and independence improve, additional tasks may be introduced.



We evaluate progress based on your ability to perform assigned work correctly, consistently, and with decreasing supervision—not simply how quickly you complete training.



What Success Looks Like



First 30 Days

Become comfortable navigating our SOPs and support resources.

Demonstrate effective research and reading comprehension.

Complete introductory training and practical exercises.

Begin handling selected routine inquiries and tasks with appropriate supervision.

Demonstrate attention to detail, accountability, and willingness to learn.



Days 31–60

Handle assigned routine tasks with increasing independence.

Consistently track pending work and complete follow-ups.

Apply previously learned procedures to similar situations.

Recognize when an issue requires escalation.

Demonstrate measurable improvement in accuracy and efficiency.



Days 61–90

Independently manage assigned responsibilities with consistent accuracy.

Handle routine agent inquiries confidently.

Maintain reliable task ownership and follow-through.

Demonstrate readiness to learn additional operational workflows.

Progression is based on demonstrated performance and may vary depending on assigned responsibilities.



Compensation & Benefits

Starting rate: $5.00 USD per hour, based on a 40-hour workweek.



Higher starting compensation may be considered for exceptionally qualified candidates based on demonstrated experience and capabilities.



13th-month pay provided annually in December.

Paid holidays in accordance with company policy.

Three paid wellness days annually, allocated quarterly during the first three quarters.

Structured training and opportunities for continued professional development.

Opportunities to participate in company-sponsored employee retreats, subject to eligibility and company arrangements.

Long-term opportunity with an established U.S. real estate brokerage.

We value the well-being of our team members and believe that professional development, personal wellness, and a supportive work environment contribute to long-term success.



Work Schedule

Full-Time Remote Position — 40 Hours Per Week

Regular work schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

Initial training: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, for approximately two weeks.

Because the position follows U.S. Eastern Time, working hours in the Philippines will generally be:

9:00 PM–5:00 AM Philippine Time during U.S. daylight saving time.

10:00 PM–6:00 AM Philippine Time during U.S. standard time.



Applicants must be comfortable maintaining this overnight schedule on a long-term basis.



Reliable availability during assigned working hours is essential.



Required Qualifications

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong reading comprehension and attention to detail.

Ability to research, understand, and apply unfamiliar information.

Strong organizational and follow-through skills.

Comfortable navigating websites, documentation, and multiple software systems.

Ability to work independently while following established procedures.

Good judgment, professionalism, and accountability.

Willingness to receive feedback and continuously improve.

Reliable availability during assigned working hours.

Previous experience in customer support, administrative operations, or process-driven work is helpful but not required.



We place greater importance on demonstrated ability, reliability, and willingness to learn than on job titles or years of experience alone.



Equipment & Connectivity Requirements



Reliable computer suitable for multitasking.

Stable primary internet connection.

Backup internet connection.

Reliable backup power arrangement for internet and computer equipment.

Quiet, professional workspace.

Headset suitable for voice communication.

Second monitor recommended but not required.

Applicants should be prepared to explain their backup arrangements and how they would maintain availability during internet or power interruptions.



How to Apply

Please include the following information in your application:



Brief introduction and relevant work experience.

Expected hourly rate in USD.

Current location in the Philippines.

Primary internet provider and recently tested connection speed.

Backup internet solution.

Backup power arrangement.

Computer and equipment specifications.

Confirmation that you can work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule on a long-term basis.



Please also answer the following two questions using specific examples from your own experience.



Question 1 — Independent Problem-Solving



Describe a time you encountered a work-related problem you didn’t know how to solve. What steps did you take, what resources did you use, and what was the outcome?



Question 2 — Accountability & Follow-Through



Tell us about a time you overlooked a task or made a mistake at work. How did you address it, and what did you change to prevent it from happening again?



We value specific, thoughtful answers that reflect your actual experience.



Our Selection Process

Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a practical assessment involving research, reading comprehension, resource navigation, problem-solving, and task organization.



This assessment is designed to evaluate how you approach unfamiliar situations, locate information, and apply instructions accurately.



Finalists will be invited to an interview.



Important Application Instructions

Please complete all requested information and answer both application questions.



Incomplete applications may not be considered.



We value clear communication, careful reading, genuine effort, and professionalism throughout the application process.



We’re looking for someone who wants to learn, contribute, and grow with Realty Hub over the long term.

title: Experienced Amazon Online Arbitrage Sourcer | FBA & FBM | Full-Time
description:
Experienced sourcers only. Serious applicants only. Apply only if you can independently find, verify, and submit purchase-ready Amazon Online Arbitrage leads from day one. You must be proficient with SellerAmp, confident in advanced Keepa analysis, and able to calculate profitability accurately for both FBA and FBM.



Remote · 40 hours per week · Flexible schedule · $4 USD/hour starting + performance bonuses · Paid trial



You’ll work for two U.S. Amazon sellers in one full-time role. One seller uses FBA and the other uses FBM. We coordinate priorities and share sourcing standards. Each lead must meet the eligibility and cost requirements of the account it’s submitted for.



Training is limited to our sourcing standards, account-specific costs, eligibility procedures, and reporting workflow. We’ll provide Keepa and SellerAmp access, set priorities, answer questions, and give feedback. You’ll work independently for most of the day and are responsible for verifying each lead before submission.

Daily performance expectations

Our target is 6–8 distinct, purchase-ready leads per eight-hour workday across both sellers combined. The FBA and FBM split will vary based on our priorities.



A lead counts toward the daily target when it’s in stock at submission, matches the Amazon listing exactly, is eligible for the assigned seller, meets our profit and ROI requirements at a Keepa-supported selling price, and has every required field completed. An ASIN that qualifies for both FBA and FBM counts once. Exceptions count only after approval.

What you’ll do

- Source from U.S. retailers using manual sourcing, Keepa Product Finder, reverse sourcing, and storefront research.

- Review 30-, 60-, and 90-day Keepa history for pricing, Buy Box activity, demand, seasonality, Amazon’s presence, and competition. Give particular weight to the most recent 30 days when estimating a realistic selling price.

- Verify the exact match, including brand, model, UPC where available, size, color, quantity, and pack configuration. Flag packaging differences and resolve any uncertainty before submitting a lead as purchase-ready.

- Confirm selling eligibility for the assigned account and flag potential IP concerns.

- Log each lead in our shared Google Sheet. Include the ASIN, retailer link, buy cost, expected selling price, estimated net profit, ROI, estimated monthly sales, competition, and why the lead qualifies for FBA, FBM, or both. Account for variations when estimating demand.

- Send a daily written update and attend a weekly review meeting. Flag sourcing issues promptly and explain any shortfall in qualifying leads.

Sourcing requirements

- Profitability. Minimum 30% ROI and $5 net profit per unit after all applicable costs.

- Demand. Target 100+ estimated monthly sales. Leads with 50–99 require clear justification and approval. Prioritize stable pricing, consistent demand, and replenishment potential.

- Competition. Target fewer than 15 FBA sellers. Leads with 15 or more require approval and an explanation of why demand supports the competition. Evaluate competing FBM offers where relevant.

- Amazon’s presence. Leads where Amazon is selling require approval. Show how historical Buy Box activity, consistent demand, and strong profitability support the opportunity.

- Product restrictions. No hazmat. Submit products the assigned seller can’t sell only when specifically requested for review. Slow-moving, heavy, bulky, oversized, or fragile products require approval. Clothing and shoes require approval and exceptional profitability that justifies the return risk.

- Discounts. Include verified gift-card discounts when instructed. Exclude cashback from qualifying profit and ROI.

Required cost calculations

- FBA. Include applicable Amazon fees, prep, inbound shipping, inbound placement fees, and relevant storage costs.

- FBM. Include applicable Amazon fees, shipping to the customer, and packaging. Use accurate weight and dimensions for the shipping estimate.

- Both. Include applicable retailer shipping and sales tax. We’ll provide the cost assumptions for each seller.

Experience, schedule, and pay

- Proven hands-on Amazon Online Arbitrage sourcing experience. You must be able to evaluate leads for both fulfillment methods. Prior sourcing experience with both FBA and FBM is preferred.

- Strong Google Sheets skills, clear written English, reliable internet, and dependable follow-through. You must be able to explain your decisions and apply feedback.

- 40 hours per week with flexible working hours. Be available for scheduled check-ins as needed between 9:00 and 10:00 a.m. U.S. Eastern Time.

- $4 USD/hour starting, with opportunities to reach $5/hour and beyond through consistent performance. Bonuses may be earned based on lead quality and the sales and profitability generated. We’ll share written bonus terms before the trial.

- This is a long-term role with potential advancement into senior sourcing or team leadership.

How to apply

On the first line of your application, write Favorite color: [your answer]. Then briefly introduce yourself and address all three items below.

1. Your experience. Tell us how long you’ve sourced for Amazon, which tools and methods you use, and what experience you have with FBA and FBM.

2. Two example leads. Share one FBA lead and one FBM lead. For each, include the product, retailer, buy cost, expected selling price, estimated net profit, and ROI. Show which fees and costs you included, what in the Keepa history supports your selling price, and why the lead fits that fulfillment method. Previous or redacted examples are welcome.

3. Your availability. Include your time zone, proposed working hours, availability for the Eastern Time check-in window, and earliest start date.

Finalists will complete a paid sourcing trial and a brief walkthrough of their analysis. During the walkthrough, be ready to explain one lead you passed on during the trial and why. We’ll evaluate how many leads pass review, the accuracy of your analysis, and how independently you work. We’ll agree on the trial scope, pay, and expectations in advance.



We’ll only consider applications that follow every instruction. On the very last line of your application, write Favorite number: [your answer].

If you answered YES to all four, keep reading. This job may be for you.



A LITTLE ABOUT ME

The Philippines has a special place in my heart. The two loves of my life, my life partner Pia (Pinay) and my son Cash (Pinoy), are both Filipino. I lived in the Philippines for many years, my roots there run deep, and I still have close family and friends throughout the islands who I stay in touch with today. It truly is my home away from home.



Living there, I saw firsthand how intelligent, hardworking and loyal Filipino people are, and how much heart they put into everything they do. That's exactly why I'm hiring from the Philippines.



I'm not looking for someone to just complete tasks. I'm looking for someone I can trust, someone who wants to grow with us and become part of our family business for the long run. If that sounds like you, I'd love to hear from you.



ABOUT THE BUSINESS

I own two growing online businesses:

- FindNFlip4U (
) – resale of vintage and name-brand clothing. We currently have over 3,000 items ready to sell, with new inventory arriving every day, including 100+ Harley-Davidson jackets (half of them leather), 200+ vintage Harley-Davidson shirts, 50+ Patagonia pieces, and vintage Icelandic and Dale of Norway wool sweaters.

- VeteranIssued (
) – veteran-owned brand selling shirts, mugs, challenge coins, cups and more



Follow us:

:

I handle all buying, inventory, photos, measurements, design, video, printing, shipping and payments. You will NOT handle any money or financial transactions. Your focus is LISTINGS, SOCIAL MEDIA GROWTH and CUSTOMER SERVICE.



PRIORITY #1 – LISTINGS & CROSSLISTING

 Marketplace, Vinted, Depop, Poshmark, Mercari and Etsy (vintage items) using Vendoo, List Perfectly or a similar tool

- Keep my Google Sheets inventory updated (SKU, platform, date listed, status)



PRIORITY #2 – SOCIAL MEDIA GROWTH & SALES

I want to build TikTok and Instagram into real sales channels, not just accounts. You will:

- Set up, build and grow business accounts on TikTok, Instagram,
 and new platforms as they trend

- Develop the strategy to grow followers and turn them into buyers

- Plan the content: tell me exactly what to create (example: "a 10-second clip of this jacket, shown like this, with this sound"). I make all photos, videos and graphics; you post them

- Build and run campaigns: paid ads (Meta, TikTok, eBay Promoted Listings, Etsy Ads), reels, clips, lives and promotions within the budget I set

- Stay on top of trends, sounds, hashtags and rising platforms (Vinted is big right now) and bring me ideas

You will be the main point of contact for our buyers and followers, and every customer must get the same consistent, friendly experience:

- Follow up after delivery to make sure they're satisfied and kindly ask for a review

- Leave positive feedback for buyers after they leave theirs

- Website orders and
 sign-ups: send a thank-you
 right away and follow up with new arrivals and offers

- Answer buyer questions quickly and professionally (within a few hours during work hours)

- Handle complaints calmly and send any return or refund request to me. I make all money decisions

- Use our message templates so every customer gets the same experience



OCCASIONAL SUPPORT (as needed)

From time to time I may ask for help with:

- Event planning – researching swap meets, farmers markets and vendor shows, contacting organizers and completing applications

- Web design – updates and fixes to my GoDaddy websites (Airo AI experience is a plus)

- Bookkeeping – organizing sales and expense records in Google Sheets



REQUIRED

- Experience creating eBay listings (clothing/vintage is a big plus)

 Marketplace)

PLUS

I upload new items to Google Drive daily. You list and crosslist them, update the inventory sheet, handle all customer messages, plan and request social content, post and run campaigns, and send me an end-of-day update on Viber. We'll have a short weekly call to review results and priorities.

Give me 3 specific content ideas or series that would grow our following AND sell this inventory, and tell me which platform each fits best.

title: Technical Customer Success Manager, English + Spanish (Fintech / Payments, Remote)
description:
About us



Disputely is a US fintech company that helps online stores stop chargebacks before they happen. We connect merchants to the card networks' alert programs (Visa and Mastercard), so disputes are caught and refunded automatically instead of becoming chargebacks. Our customers are e-commerce brands, many selling on Shopify and Stripe, and payment partners who resell our service.



We are growing fast and need someone who can handle the technical side of customer success: integrations, API questions and our biggest accounts.



The role



You will be the go-to person for technical questions from merchants and partners. Today those questions go straight to our founders. Your job is to take them over, solve them, and make sure our largest clients get a hands-on, technical point of contact.



What you will do



Be the dedicated technical contact for our high-volume merchants (5,000+ alerts a month).

Answer API, webhook and integration questions from merchants and partners (Shopify, Stripe, payment gateways, CRMs, help desk tools).

Troubleshoot problems end to end: reproduce the issue, read the logs or API responses, find the cause, and write a clear report for our developers when it is a bug.

Help merchants and partners connect to our API and set up custom flows.

Run onboarding and check-in video calls with merchants, explaining technical things in plain English.

Reply to merchants in our help desk, live chat and group chats (Slack, WhatsApp,
).

Write and update help articles, FAQs and step-by-step guides for technical topics.

Look after our reputation: follow up with happy merchants for reviews, and step in fast when a merchant is unhappy.

Requirements



3+ years in a technical customer-facing role: technical support, customer success, account management, solutions or implementation, ideally at a SaaS or fintech company.

Real hands-on API experience. You can read API documentation, understand requests, responses and webhooks, and test endpoints with Postman or a similar tool.

Comfortable with JSON and reading error logs.

Excellent written and spoken English. You will be on calls with US clients.

Fluent written and spoken Spanish. You will support our Spanish-speaking merchants on calls and in chat.

Clear, short writing. You can explain a technical problem in three sentences.

Organized and reliable with follow-ups. Nothing falls through the cracks.

Stable internet, a quiet workspace, and a working camera and headset.

Available during US Pacific business hours.

Big pluses



Experience in payments, e-commerce, fraud or chargebacks.

Experience with Shopify, Stripe or payment gateways.

Experience with help desk tools like Pylon, Intercom or Zendesk.

Basic SQL or scripting.

Experience handling a brand's public reviews or social media replies.

What we offer



Long-term, full-time remote role with a growing US company.

Direct work with the founders and the customer success lead.

Training on our product and the card networks' alert programs.

Room to grow as the team grows.

How to apply



Send the following.

( Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed. )



Your CV. to 

A short Loom or video (2 minutes max) introducing yourself: first half in English, second half in Spanish.

Answers to these three questions: 

a. Tell us about one API you have worked with. 

What did you use it for, and what problem did you solve? 

b. A merchant says: "Our refunds stopped syncing yesterday." 

What are the first three things you check? 

c. Describe a time you turned an unhappy customer around.

Write "DISPUTELY TECH" as the subject of your application so we know you read the full post.

title: Digital Marketing & Growth Expert
description:
### Meta Ads | GoHighLevel | Lead Generation | Google Ads | Content & Sales



We are looking for an **exceptionally tech-savvy, results-driven Digital Marketing & Growth Expert** to join our growing healthcare and wellness business.



This is **not just a social media posting job**. We are looking for someone who understands how to build a complete digital marketing system—from generating leads to nurturing them, creating content, optimizing campaigns, and helping convert leads into paying customers.



If you love technology, learn new software quickly, enjoy solving problems, and are excited about AI and digital marketing, we want to hear from you!



## 🎯 What You Will Do



### 📈 Lead Generation & Advertising



* Create, manage, and optimize **Meta/Facebook & Instagram advertising campaigns**

* Generate high-quality leads and continuously improve cost per lead and conversion rates

* Understand audiences, targeting, creative testing, retargeting, and lead funnels

* Assist with or manage **Google Ads campaigns**

* Monitor campaign performance and recommend improvements



### ⚙️ GoHighLevel & Automation



* Work inside **GoHighLevel (GHL)** to manage leads and marketing campaigns

* Build and improve funnels, forms, landing pages, pipelines, automations, workflows, SMS, and
 campaigns

* Track leads from first inquiry through conversion

* Help improve follow-up systems so leads do not fall through the cracks

* Troubleshoot technical and automation issues



### ✍️ Website & Content



* Write, edit, and upload **SEO-friendly blog posts** for our website

* Use AI and research tools intelligently to create high-quality content

* Help improve website content for lead generation and conversions

* Understand or be willing to learn **SEO, local SEO, and content marketing**

* Create marketing content based on customer questions, problems, symptoms, and interests



### 💰 Sales & Lead Conversion



* Understand the customer journey and what motivates someone to take action

* Help improve lead nurturing and follow-up strategies

* Identify opportunities to increase appointment bookings and sales

* Review lead performance and identify where potential customers are dropping off

* Work closely with our team to improve conversion rates



## 🧠 Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* **Extremely comfortable with technology**

* A fast learner who can quickly master new software and AI tools

* Experienced with **Meta Ads**

* Familiar with **GoHighLevel**, CRM systems, or marketing automation

* Familiar with **Google Ads**, or highly motivated to learn it

* Able to understand marketing numbers and analytics

* Comfortable writing and editing website/blog content

* Interested in sales psychology and lead conversion

* Highly organized and able to manage multiple projects

* Proactive and able to identify problems before being asked

* Excellent at researching and figuring things out independently

* Fluent in written and spoken English



## ⭐ BIG PLUS



Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:



* Meta Ads Manager

* GoHighLevel

* Google Ads

* Landing page and funnel building

* SEO

* WordPress or website management

* AI tools for marketing and content creation

*
 and SMS marketing

* CRM management

* Healthcare, wellness, aesthetics, or weight-loss marketing

* Sales or appointment-setting

title: Marketing Manager
description:

We're building with intention.

With structure.

With technology at the core.

With performance that compounds over time.



Our goal is to create a brand that sets the standard. A company that leads. A platform built to scale intelligently and sustainably across markets.



And for the right person, this isn't just a job inside that company.

It's a front-row seat to its growth.

--------------------------------------------------------------

Role: Marketing Manager (Full-Stack)

Location: Remote

Shift: Aligned with Canada MST

Role Type: Full-time

Compensation: To Be Discussed



We believe great people build great companies. If you can own marketing from idea to finished content to qualified lead, we are willing to offer premium compensation. Strong performers who focus, move fast, and deliver measurable results will be rewarded at the top end of the market.

--------------------------------------------------------------

Why This Role Is a Big Opportunity for You



This is a marketing-only role. No side projects, no wearing five hats. Your one job is to market, and your one metric is clear: deliver Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs).



You won't be handed a mess and told to figure it out. You'll step into a defined process, with clear expectations, and full ownership of the results.



We're a company that runs on constant, high-volume content and smart systems. We run on our own custom-built CRM and software, so you'll be working with tools designed around how we actually operate. You'll work directly with our founder and team, your ideas get implemented, and as we expand across markets, your scope, influence, and compensation grow with it.



This role has a clear path toward Head of Marketing for someone who wants to build long term.

--------------------------------------------------------------

What You'll Be Doing



Lead Generation (Your #1 Priority)

- Own the delivery of Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) as your primary metric

- Track and report MQLs and full-funnel performance from first touch to handoff to sales

- Identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements based on real data, not gut feel



Content Strategy

- Ideate content strategies and campaign ideas, not just execute what's handed to you

- Write scripts and generate content ideas for the team to film against

- Study high-performing real estate content and adapt what works for our brand

- Plan what gets posted, when, and on which accounts, across multiple channels

- Create educational content, like how our commission cashback program works and homebuying/selling tips, that builds trust and positions us as a resource



Editing & Graphics

- Turn raw, unedited footage from our team into short, polished reels ready to run as ads or organic posts

- Use vibe editing (AI-assisted editing tools) to produce content quickly without losing quality

- Keep the final result looking good and professional, but not overly edited

- Add captions, simple b-roll, background music, and sound effects

- Design graphics, thumbnails, overlays, and ad creatives, plus promotional materials (wins, houses bought/sold, announcements, holidays)



Coaching Our Agents

- Guide our agents in creating content, going beyond just editing what they send you

- Coach agents on camera so they get more comfortable and improve their delivery over time

- Create simple training or reference content, like a short example video or quick tip sheet, so agents know what to aim for before they film

- Keep raw clips organized by person and topic, and communicate clearly when footage is missing something



AI & Marketing Automation

- Use AI tools daily to work faster and smarter

- Build AI-powered marketing workflows and automations that create, repurpose, and schedule content

- Work with our custom CRM and software to connect marketing to lead tracking and follow-up

- Turn repetitive marketing tasks into simple, documented systems



Vendor & Partner Communication

- Communicate with outside vendors, agencies, and freelancers, giving clear briefs and following up until the work is delivered

- Keep vendors aligned with our brand, timelines, and lead goals



Funnel & Paid Ads

- Optimize our landing page (
) for conversions and clear calls-to-action

- Build and refine
 nurture sequences and keep leads cleanly segmented and tagged

- Keep tracking accurate (Pixel, CAPI, UTMs) so every lead is attributed

- Plan, write, launch, and scale Meta Ads campaigns

--------------------------------------------------------------

Who This Is Perfect For



- Someone who wants to focus only on marketing and be measured on results

- Someone who knows how to prioritize what matters most, and gets it done

- Someone intelligent, hardworking, and humble, who takes feedback and keeps improving

- Someone who keeps things simple, because simple scales



Must-Haves:

- At least 1 year of proven marketing experience with results you can show

- Proven experience generating leads, with numbers to back it up

- Hands-on Meta Ads experience (campaigns, copy, creative, A/B testing)

- Strong short-form video editing skills (captions, b-roll, music), including vibe editing with AI tools

- Graphic design skills for social posts, thumbnails, and ad creatives

- Experience creating content strategy and writing scripts or content ideas, not just executing someone else's

- Hands-on daily use of AI tools for marketing work

- Comfortable coaching non-professional talent, including on camera

- Experience communicating with vendors, agencies, or freelancers

- Able to work full-time, aligned with Canada MST, with reliable internet

- Strong, clear communication in English



Preferred:

- Experience running Google, YouTube, TikTok, or LinkedIn Ads

- Experience building marketing automations or workflows (AI agents, Zapier, or similar)

- Experience with vibe editing (AI-assisted video editing tools)

- Experience working inside a custom CRM or in-house software

- Real estate marketing experience, especially buyer or seller lead generation

- Experience with
 marketing and CRM lead management

- Experience with tracking and attribution (Pixel, CAPI, UTMs)

- Experience with landing page optimization

- Experience managing multiple social media accounts and posting schedules

- SEO experience

--------------------------------------------------------------

What You'll Gain



- Real ownership over marketing strategy and results

- A clear process and expectations from day one, not left to figure it out alone

- Direct collaboration with our founder and team, not buried under layers of approval

- Premium compensation aligned with performance

- A clear path toward Head of Marketing as the company scales

- Long-term stability inside a growing company

- The chance to build the marketing engine behind our expansion

--------------------------------------------------------------

How to Apply

Applications without an intro video will not be reviewed.

title: Google & Meta Media Buyer | Creative Testing + AI Production
description:
Ikan Media is looking for a hands-on media buyer who can independently run approved Google and Meta campaigns and own the creative-testing loop. We acquire subscribers for US research-opportunity brands and monetize through lead/affiliate offers and
. A cheap lead is not necessarily a valuable subscriber.



This is a long-term remote role for someone who already knows how to buy media, diagnose results and make practical ad creatives. Our tools and company-specific training should enhance your skills—not supply missing fundamentals.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Google Search and Meta campaign builds, monitoring, optimization and controlled tests within approved budgets and guardrails.

• Creative angles, hooks, copy and short scripts; usable static ads and basic short video/motion using tools you already know.

• Tracking QA, saved-state verification, clear change logs and prompt risk escalation.

• Decisions based on lead quality, downstream revenue and payback—not platform ROAS or CPL alone.

• Concise daily updates and a weekly decision memo without the owner chasing you.



WHAT YOU MUST DEMONSTRATE

• Personal, hands-on Google and Meta experience, with campaign examples and measurable outcomes.

• Sound judgment about attribution gaps, data maturity, budget limits and when to stop and ask.

• Creative work you personally produced and can explain—not only work delivered by another team.

• Practical AI use: good inputs, fact-checking, useful output, corrections and responsible data handling.

• Clear written English, reliable follow-through and disclosed outside commitments.



Relevant affiliate, lead-generation or subscriber-acquisition experience is strongly preferred. Snapchat and NewsBreak experience is useful; we do not expect equal expertise in every channel on day one. No on-camera filming or advanced animation is required. This is not a general-VA, organic-social posting or account-management-only role.



PAY AND SCHEDULE

$1,500–$2,000 USD/month; full-time, 40 hours/week. At least four working hours each day must overlap 9am–5pm America/New_York (Eastern Time, including daylight-saving changes). Exact work arrangement and payment terms will be agreed before an offer. No percentage-of-ad-spend commission.



HOW TO APPLY

Send a short reply with existing, redacted examples:

1. One Google and one Meta campaign: dates, objective, spend you personally controlled, results, data source and what you changed.

2. One static and one short video you personally made. Explain your contribution and share performance data if available.

3. One AI workflow you use, including a mistake you caught and corrected, plus an existing sample change log or owner update if available.

4. Your monthly pay expectation, availability, Eastern overlap and current commitments.



Do not share client credentials or private customer data. Confidentiality-safe examples are welcome; no new unpaid production assignment is required to apply. Finalists receive a structured interview and a short paid practical assessment, with scope and fees agreed before starting. AI is allowed with disclosure; you must defend your own decisions.

s, and inquiries promptly, and escalate urgent or unresolved issues to the right team member.

**What we're looking for**

title: Affiliate Program Manager (Shopify, BixGrow) for US Peptide Brand
description:
We're hiring a part-time affiliate manager for People's Peps, a US research peptide brand on Shopify. You'll run our affiliate program day to day in BixGrow: store partners, creators, codes, commissions and payouts. The role starts at 20 hours a week and moves to full time (40 hours) as the program grows.



A heads-up: research peptides are a restricted category. Ad platforms and payment processors watch this space closely, so everything our partners say has to stay inside clear rules. If you've managed affiliates for peptides, kratom, CBD, supplements or nootropics, you already know how this works.



ABOUT US

People's Peps runs on one rule: testing as a default. Every product has its own third-party lab test, published by lot. We sell vials, mists and dissolving strips direct to researchers, and wholesale to shops and distributors across the US. We're a small, founder-led team in Austin, Texas. You'll report to our marketing manager.



Our goal is for you to make a lot of money as you help us scale. This role runs on relationships, so we want someone who genuinely enjoys building them.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Hunt for new affiliates: find, pitch and sign creators, reviewers, community voices and shops in the research peptide space. This is the first job.

- Run our partner stores as affiliates: set up their accounts, codes and links, and help their staff sell inside the rules.

- Host weekly office hours and webinars for store partners and affiliates through Calendly, and coach them to better results.

- Run the program in BixGrow: commission tiers, custom store rates, coupons, links, the affiliate portal and fraud checks.

- Track commissions, handle refunds, and prep monthly payouts and W-9s with our ops team.

- Work with our sales reps on the stores they bring in, and with marketing on code cards and partner materials.

- Review partner content and pull codes from anyone who breaks the rules.

- Send a short weekly report: sales by partner, new and active partners, commission cost, problems.

- Later on, help with the affiliate program for our sister brand as time allows.



THE RULES EVERY PARTNER FOLLOWS

- Research use only. Compounds are "researched for," never "used for."

- No dosing, no health claims, no before-and-after content, no "helping people" language.

- 21+ only.

You'll teach these to every partner and hold them to it, top earners included.



SCHEDULE

title: Guest Support & Reservations Agent — Level I & Level II

We’re looking for hospitality professionals who communicate clearly, pay attention to details, and take ownership of guest requests. We are hiring at two levels, with placement based on relevant experience, system proficiency, and demonstrated ability to handle complex situations.



REQUIRED FOR BOTH LEVELS

• Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management or a closely related field.

LEVEL I — GUEST SUPPORT & RESERVATIONS AGENT

Responsibilities

• Respond to guest inquiries by phone,
, and chat.

• Strong customer service skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to follow procedures while recognizing when an issue requires escalation.

• Familiarity with reservation systems, property management systems (PMS), or CRM platforms is a plus.



LEVEL II — SENIOR GUEST SUPPORT & RESERVATIONS AGENT

You will handle complex bookings and escalations, coordinate resolutions across teams, and help strengthen the quality of guest support.



Responsibilities

• Perform core guest support and reservation duties while taking ownership of more complex cases.

• Manage corporate bookings, multi-property stays, and complicated reservation changes.

• Resolve escalated guest and property-partner concerns with professionalism and urgency.

• Investigate booking discrepancies and coordinate solutions with operations, revenue, and partnership teams.

• Serve as a resource for Level I agents on systems, policies, and workflows.

Qualifications

• Strong problem-solving, conflict-resolution, and prioritization skills.

• Experience with PMS platforms, channel managers, online travel agencies (OTAs), or corporate travel platforms preferred.

• Ability to coordinate across teams and take responsibility for cases through resolution.



WHAT WE OFFER

• Growth opportunities within a growing hospitality platform.

• A collaborative team focused on service quality and operational performance.

• Exposure to corporate travel, short-term rentals, and multi-channel booking operations.

Luxury Hub is an estate and letting agency covering Manchester, Stockport, Lancashire and the wider North West of England. We have a large database of homeowners, landlords and tenants who have already enquired with us, and we are expanding into new areas.



We are expanding our Philippines-based team and are hiring an Appointment Setter with estate agency experience. Your job is to call the people who have enquired with us, find out where they are in their moving journey, and book them in with our UK team.



This is a phone heavy role. You will make 50 to 60 outbound calls a day. If you know the property world, love being on the phone and get a buzz from a full diary, this role is for you.



WHY JOIN US



• Work remotely for a stable UK-based company

• Long-term role with guaranteed hours and job security

• Warm leads: you will be calling people who have already enquired with us

• Gain experience of the UK property market, sales and lettings

• Work closely with senior leadership and our UK valuers

• Training on our systems, scripts and local areas

• Clear progression as the business grows

• Annual performance review with potential pay increase

At Luxury Hub, culture matters. We are building a long term team, not short term contractors.



• Shared Vision – Aligning personal ambition with company success and shared goals

• Virtue and Talents – Individual talents are recognised and nurtured

• Continuous Improvement – We welcome feedback, stay curious, innovate and improve

• Focused Contribution – We play to our strengths and passions to create real impact

• Meaningful Partnerships – We believe in mutual value creation and growing together

Sales Valuations

• Re-engage older leads with a clear, friendly script and find out who is ready to move



Lettings

• Call tenants and applicants to book property viewings

• Collect viewing feedback and move interested applicants towards an application

• Support the lettings team with follow up calls when needed



CRM and Diary Management

• Log every call, outcome and note in our CRM (
)

• Set follow up reminders for people who are not ready yet, for example "call me back in six months"

• Coordinate diaries with our UK valuers and viewing agents



Targets and Reporting

• Hit daily call targets and weekly booked appointment targets

• Share call outcomes and feedback to help improve our scripts and lead sources



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should have:



• At least 1 year of experience calling for an estate agency, letting agency or real estate business (UK experience strongly preferred; US, Australian or Canadian real estate also considered)

• Proven appointment-setting results you can tell us about: calls per day and appointments booked

• Excellent spoken English, clear and confident on the phone

• Comfortable with rejection and with handling objections in real time

• Good understanding of how property sales and lettings work: valuations, viewings, landlords, tenants and applicants

• Experience using a CRM and a VoIP dialler

• Accurate, organised note-taking

• Quiet workspace, noise-cancelling headset, reliable internet with a backup connection and power backup

• Availability to work UK hours, including some Saturdays

• No other full-time job or full-time study commitments



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



Competitive Pay and Bonuses

• PHP 290 to 330 per hour starting rate, based on experience

• Biweekly pay

• Annual performance and pay review

• Appointment bonus for booked appointments that go ahead, available after 12 months of service and subject to agreed KPIs



Bonuses and Incentives

• Thirteenth month pay

• Fourteenth month performance bonus after five years of service

• Bonus days off every 80 hours worked after probation



Long-Term Growth and Stability

• Paid training and career development

• Health stipend after two years of service

• Company loan options after two years of service

• Guaranteed pay security: if we do not provide enough work, you will still be paid for at least 75 percent of your contracted hours



HOW TO APPLY



• Complete this short application form:

• Only applications made through the Google Form will be accepted. Applications sent only through OnlineJobs.ph will not be reviewed.

• The form includes a short voice recording. Applications without the recording will not be reviewed.

• No CV required at this stage.



HIRING TIMELINE



The job posting will close on 13th December 2026 at 11:59 PM UK time. We will review the applications received over the following days and let applicants know the results by 18th December.



Shortlisted candidates will then receive an invite to complete a trial task, due in the first week of January. For candidates who advance, interviews will take place in the 2nd or 3rd week of January. We aim to make a final decision by the end of January, and the successful candidate will begin in the 1st or 2nd week of February.



Note: This timeline may adjust slightly as we progress, especially around the Christmas holidays. We'll keep you informed.



Thank you for your patience and enthusiasm. Join us and grow your career with a UK based estate agency.

title: Virtual Receptionist & Admin Assistant – US Tax Firm | Full-Time, US Eastern Hours
description:
About us

We are a small, growing US tax and accounting firm. We prepare individual and business tax returns and help business owners save legally through year-round tax planning. Our clients are families, self-employed people and small business owners, and they choose us because we answer quickly and treat them like people. We're looking for a long-term team member to be the friendly, organized voice of our office.



Schedule

• Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time. That's 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila time, or 9:00 PM to 5:00 AM during US daylight saving time.

• Overnight shift, every week. Please apply only if this schedule works for you long-term.

• January to April is our busy season. Paid overtime is sometimes available.



Pay and benefits

• $900 USD per month, based on experience

• A raise review after 90 days, then every year

• Paid Philippine holidays, plus paid time off after 90 days

• Paid once a month through Wise

• Paid training on our software. No tax experience needed



What you'll do

• Answer and return client phone calls, texts and
s warmly and professionally

• Book appointments and keep the calendar organized

• Set up new clients in our client portal (TaxDome) and help clients log in, upload documents and sign forms

• Resend portal links, reminders and requests, and follow up with clients who still owe us documents or signatures

• Keep client records, notes and job statuses up to date

• Act as the virtual assistant for the firm's partners: manage their calendars and inboxes, schedule meetings, send reminders and help with other admin projects

• Route tax questions to the right person on our team. You will never give tax advice



What we're looking for

• Excellent spoken and written English. Our callers are American, so you need a clear, easy-to-understand speaking voice and a warm phone manner.

• At least 1 year of phone experience with US callers: a call center, a BPO or a front desk for a US business

• Experience with a CRM, client portal or practice management software

• Very organized and careful with details. You'll handle confidential information every day

• Calm and patient with stressed clients, especially at deadlines

• Quick to learn new software and willing to follow written procedures

• Nice to have: experience at a US accounting, tax, insurance, legal or medical office, or with TaxDome, Karbon, Canopy, QuickBooks, Google Workspace or Calendly



Your setup

• A private, quiet room with no other people talking during calls

• A computer you don't share with anyone, with a webcam and a noise-canceling USB headset

• Wired internet of at least 25 Mbps, plus a backup connection (for example, a pocket WiFi or a second provider)

• A backup power source (UPS) for brownouts



How to apply

We read every application that follows these steps.

1.  Start your message with the phrase "Clear and kind".

2.  Send a voice recording of 3 minutes or less (Vocaroo, Google Drive or Loom). 

In it:

    ◦ Read this script out loud, slowly and warmly, as if you're on the phone with one of our clients: "Thank you for calling, this is [your name]. How can I help you today? … Thank you for your patience. I can see your tax organizer is complete, but we're still missing your W-2 and two 1099 forms. I'll resend the secure portal link by text and
 right now. Once you upload them, your tax preparer will review everything, and we'll send Form 8879 for your electronic signature. If you need more time, we can file an extension before the April 15th deadline. Our firm handles every return with honesty and integrity, so please call us with any questions. Would Tuesday at 2:30 PM work for your appointment?"

    ◦ Then tell us about a time you helped an upset customer on the phone, and how it ended.

3.  Write 3 to 5 sentences about why you'd like to work for a tax office.

4.  Attach your resume and a screenshot of your internet speed test (speedtest.net).

5.  Tell us the earliest date you could start.



Applications without the voice recording won't be reviewed.

title: Virtual Assistant – Stock Options Trading Support
description:
Job Type: Part-Time / Long-Term

Location: Remote

Compensation: $4.00 USD per hour starting rate

Schedule: Flexible, with availability during U.S. market hours preferred

Experience Level: Intermediate to Advanced – Hands-on Options Trading Experience Required



About the Role



I’m an active stock options trader looking for a knowledgeable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant with hands-on experience in options trading.



This is not a general Virtual Assistant position. You must understand how options work, be comfortable analyzing option chains, and have experience using trading platforms.



I’m looking for someone who can help monitor potential trade opportunities, organize existing positions, track performance, and provide timely alerts based on my trading criteria.



The ideal candidate understands options terminology, trading strategies, and market data and can work independently while following established instructions.



Key Responsibilities



1. Trade Setup Research



- Scan stocks and options chains for potential trading opportunities based on my specified criteria.

- Monitor stocks for price movements and volatility changes.

- Review expiration dates, strike prices, premiums, and option volume.

- Identify potential setups involving calls, puts, covered calls, cash-secured puts, and spreads.

- Present potential opportunities for my review and approval.



2. Options Position Tracking



- Maintain an organized Google Sheets or Excel trading tracker.

- Track open options positions, including:

    -Stock ticker.

    -Strategy.

    -Call or put.

    -Strike price.

    -Premium received or paid.

    -Expiration date.

    -Number of contracts.

    -Current position value.

    -Profit and loss (P&L).

- Monitor upcoming expirations and important position dates.

- Keep records accurate and up to date.



3. Trading Alerts & Monitoring



- Monitor selected stocks and options positions during agreed-upon hours.

- Send alerts when specified stock prices, premiums, or volatility targets are reached.

- Notify me of approaching expiration dates.

- Flag significant changes in open positions.

- Provide timely updates when a potential trade setup meets my criteria.



4. Trade Journal & Performance Tracking



- Maintain a detailed trading journal.

- Record completed trades, entry and exit prices, dates, and strategies.

- Track realized and unrealized profit and loss.

- Organize trade history for performance reviews.

- Help identify patterns and summarize trading performance.



5. Daily Trading Summary



Provide a concise daily summary that includes:

- Relevant market and watchlist updates.

- Potential trade setups that meet my criteria.

- Current open positions.

- Upcoming expirations.

- Important price and volatility alerts.

- Updates to the trading journal and tracker.



Required Qualifications



Applicants must have:



- Hands-on experience trading stock options.

- Strong understanding of calls, puts, strike prices, expiration dates, and premiums.

- Knowledge of covered calls, cash-secured puts, and options spreads.

- Ability to read and interpret options chains.

- Understanding of the options Greeks, especially delta, theta, and implied volatility (IV).

- Experience using at least one professional or retail trading platform.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

- Strong written English communication.

- Ability to follow trading instructions and maintain confidentiality.



Preferred Trading Platforms



Experience with one or more of the following:



- thinkorswim

- Webull

- Interactive Brokers (IBKR)

- Tastytrade



Additional experience with options screeners, market research tools, and automated price alerts is a plus.



Important Position Guidelines



This role is focused on trading research, monitoring, organization, and administrative support.



- I will provide the trading criteria and approve all trading decisions.

- You will not independently enter, modify, or close trades.

- You must never execute trades or move funds without explicit authorization.

- Accuracy, discretion, and timely communication are essential.

- You must be comfortable working with confidential financial and trading information.



How to Apply



To be considered, please answer ALL of the following questions in your application.



1. Options Knowledge



What’s the difference between buying a put and selling a put? Explain the potential profit and risk associated with each.



2. Covered Calls



If you sell a covered call and the stock rises above the strike price at expiration, what happens to your shares and the premium you collected?



3. Trading Experience



Which trading platforms have you personally used (thinkorswim, Webull, IBKR, Tastytrade, or others), and how long have you used each?



4. Options Strategies



Which options strategies have you personally traded or monitored? Please describe your experience with covered calls, cash-secured puts, and spreads.



5. Options Greeks



Explain what delta, theta, and implied volatility mean and how you use them when evaluating an options trade.



6. Trade Tracking



Have you created or maintained an options trading spreadsheet or trade journal? If possible, provide a sample with personal financial information removed.



7. Availability



How many hours per week can you commit?

What is your current time zone?

What hours are you available during U.S. market hours (9:30 AM–4:00 PM Eastern Time)?

8. Compensation



We are looking to start you at $4.00/hour, but what is your expected hourly rate in USD?



What I’m Looking For



I’m looking for someone who genuinely understands options trading and can become a reliable part of my trading support process.



You should be proactive, organized, analytical, and comfortable working with numbers and market data.



If you have actual options trading experience, understand the platforms, and can help keep my trading activities organized and monitored, I’d like to hear from you.



Please include specific examples of your trading experience. Applications with generic VA experience but no practical options knowledge will not be considered.

title: Part-Time Cold Caller & Appointment Setter for a US Website Agency
description:
About Stonevale Media:

Stonevale Media is a growing US website agency. We build custom websites for landscaping businesses and other small service businesses — their name, photos, and services all in one place, with an easy way for customers to request a quote. We are a small, friendly team, and we are looking for one reliable cold caller to help us reach more business owners by phone.



Why this role exists:

We are adding phone calls as a new way to reach business owners. Our owner handles all
 and Instagram outreach herself — your job is the phone, and only the phone.



What you will do:

- Call landscaping businesses in Texas, USA, from a list we give you. Every business on the list has already been checked by us — real business, active, no website. You do not find or check businesses yourself.

- Follow our short script: introduce Stonevale Media, ask for the owner or decision-maker, explain in one sentence what we do, and ask one easy question about where their quote requests come from today. That question is how you qualify them — you find out how they get customers today and whether a website could help.

- If a business owner is interested, book a quick 10-minute call with our owner, Samantha, using the booking link we give you. Only book appointments with owners who are interested — never book someone who said no.

- Log every call and its outcome in our shared tracking sheet: who you called, whether they answered, what they said, and whether they want a call back.

- Flag disconnected numbers, closed businesses, wrong information, and anyone who asks not to be called again.



How to handle common answers (the basics — the full script has the exact words):

- "How much does it cost?" — say only this: "Growth is our most popular package. It's $250 to get started, and we'll have your website ready within 24 to 48 hours. The remaining $249 is due when your site goes live. And your $199 monthly fee doesn't start until your website has been live for a full 30 days!" Then offer to book the call. Never discuss other prices or offer a discount.

- "We already have a website." — thank them, and take them off the list. Do not try to change their mind.

- "We already get customers through
." — say that makes sense, and that a website gives those same people somewhere to see their work and book a quote request without messaging back and forth. Then offer the quick call with Samantha.

- "Not interested." — thank them kindly and move on. Never argue, never push, never call back the same day after a no.



What you will NOT do:

- You do not find prospects or check businesses — we do that for you.

- You do not close deals or handle sales calls — Samantha handles all sales calls, pricing, and closing. You do not negotiate prices or offer discounts.

- You do not send messages,
s, texts, or social media messages on our behalf.

- You do not call anyone who is not on the list we give you.



Hours and pay:

- Part-time: 15 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 10:00am–1:00pm Central Time (12:00am–3:00am Philippines time), 3 hours per day.

- Please do not apply if you cannot work 10am–1pm Central Time. These are the set hours — they cannot be moved to a different time of day.

- Pay: $5 USD per hour — $15 per day, $75 per week, about $325 per month. Paid every 2 weeks via Wise.

- Plus $10 for every qualified call — a business owner who knows what Stonevale Media does and is interested, and books a call with Samantha.

- Plus $50 for every sale that closes from a call you booked.

- Please note: 10am–1pm Central Time is 12:00am–3:00am Philippines time, so please only apply if you can work those hours.

- We start with a short paid trial (3 hours, $15) before any ongoing offer.



Daily target:

- About 60–80 dials per 3-hour shift once you're up to speed. This is a starting target, not a strict quota — a good conversation matters more than rushing through calls. We track conversations and qualified appointments, not just calls: calls attempted, calls answered, owners reached, real conversations, interested owners, and appointments booked.



You need:

- Clear, friendly spoken English and a good, confident phone voice.

- Reliable internet and a quiet place to call from.

- Comfortable being told "no" and moving on kindly — most people will say no, and that is normal.

- Able to follow a script and keep accurate records.

- Cold-calling experience.

- Experience setting appointments or using a CRM system is a plus.



Professional calling and do-not-call rules — please read this carefully:

- Only call people on the list we give you. Never call anyone else for us.
