### About Hope for Stomach Cancer

Hope for Stomach Cancer is a US national nonprofit dedicated to empowering patients, caregivers, families, and the medical community affected by stomach (gastric) cancer. Founded by Aki Smith after her father’s diagnosis, we provide education, practical resources, support programs, research partnerships, and advocacy so that no one has to navigate this disease alone. Our work includes patient resources (such as Hope in a Bag), Patient Empowerment Summits, awareness campaigns, and ongoing efforts to improve early detection, treatment, and policy.



We are looking for a dedicated, experienced Social Media Manager who wants to settle into a long-term role and grow with the organization for many years.



### The Role

You will work closely with Aki Smith, Founder and Executive Director, to create and execute approved social media content every day across YouTube,
, Instagram, TikTok, and X. You will be the person responsible for turning strategy into consistent, high-quality posts that educate, support, and inspire the stomach cancer community.



This is a full-time position for one dedicated individual who values professionalism, punctuality, and clear communication. We are not seeking an agency or a rotating team. We operate with a continuous-improvement mindset—constantly looking for better ways to advance our mission. There is no status quo.



### Key Responsibilities

- Plan, create, and publish daily approved social media content across YouTube,
, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and X

- Produce high-quality video content, graphics, short-form clips, stories, reels, and supporting visuals

- Edit videos, design graphics, and prepare assets that meet professional standards

- Maintain consistent branding, tone, and messaging that reflect hope, education, and patient empowerment

- Monitor engagement, respond professionally when appropriate, and report on performance

- Collaborate closely with Aki Smith on content direction, approvals, and organizational priorities

- Ensure every post and communication uses proper English grammar, spelling, and punctuation

- Actively contribute ideas for improving content, processes, and impact

- Work with urgency each day, understanding that we are helping people fighting a very deadly disease



### Requirements

- Completely fluent in both spoken and written English, with excellent communication skills; strong grammar, punctuation, and clear professional speech are non-negotiable

- Proven experience managing social media for organizations, nonprofits, or mission-driven brands

- Advanced skills in video editing and graphic design/creation (able to produce polished content independently)

- Comfortable working regular business hours in Pacific Standard Time

- Highly organized, punctual, professional, and reliable

- Ability to handle sensitive, emotional topics with empathy and care while remaining accurate and professional

- Self-motivated, adaptable, and interested in a stable, long-term position rather than short-term or project-based work

- Open to learning new tools and processes as we continuously improve how we work

- Work-from-home setup that includes a quiet, distraction-free space with rock-solid, reliable high-speed internet so you can join Zoom video calls without interruption

- Ability to present yourself professionally on video calls: professional attire, professional environment/background, and no distracting background noise

- Deep understanding of and commitment to our mission; ability to embrace the urgency of supporting people facing a very deadly disease



### What We Offer

- A full-time, dedicated role with a mission-driven nonprofit

- Direct collaboration with the organization’s Founder and Executive Director

- The opportunity to build a long-term professional relationship and grow with Hope for Stomach Cancer

- Meaningful work that supports patients and families facing stomach cancer

We are always open to evaluating and adopting any additional service or tool that can make us more effective and efficient

title: Development Finance Analyst
description:
ABOUT US

Vecino Group is a US real estate developer of affordable and market rate housing. We take each community from pursuit through construction, stabilization, and permanent loan conversion.



THE ROLE

This is a full time, long term, remote position. The Development Finance Analyst reports to the Vice President of Finance and supports our finance and development teams on project financing. You will work as an embedded member of our team, inside our systems, on live deals.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Underwrite and screen potential developments against our investment criteria, and flag financial risks with recommended solutions.

• Build and maintain financial models: pro formas, development budgets, sources and uses, cash flow, and return analysis, including sensitivities to rents, costs, interest rates, and lease up.

• Prepare and submit monthly construction draw requests, and reconcile each draw to the approved budget, prior funding, and supporting documents.

• Track budget to actual variances, cost to complete, interest reserves, and projected cash needs, and escalate funding gaps early.

• Maintain a schedule of lender and investor deadlines, loan maturities, and required deliverables.

• Support financial closings, stabilization, and permanent loan conversion, including review of operating statements, rent rolls, and debt service coverage.

• Support tax credit work: equity adjusters, cost certification, and final reconciliation of sources and uses.

• Correspond in writing and on calls with US lenders, investors, and consultants.

• Prepare presentations and reports for senior leadership.



WHAT YOU NEED

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Real Estate, or a related field. CPA is a plus.

• 5 or more years of experience in real estate finance, accounting, commercial banking, or private equity. Experience supporting a US company is strongly preferred.

• Advanced Excel: financial modeling, lookup functions, pivot tables, error checking, and the ability to trace assumptions through a model built by someone else.

• Experience with construction draws, construction lending, or US affordable housing finance (Low Income Housing Tax Credits) is a strong plus. We will train the right person on tax credits.

• Excellent written and spoken English. You will communicate directly with lenders and investors.

• Strong attention to detail, organized file and version control habits, and high ethical standards with confidential financial information.



HOW WE WORK

• We run on Microsoft 365. You will work every day in Excel, Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, and Planner, using a company account and our file structures and naming standards.

• We use ChatGPT and other AI tools within established internal workflows. You must be comfortable using them, verifying their output, and protecting confidential data.

• You will be expected to communicate proactively on Teams, post updates without being asked, and raise problems early.



SCHEDULE AND SETUP

• Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time.

• Reliable computer, primary internet of at least 50 Mbps, a backup connection, and backup power.

• A signed confidentiality agreement is required.



TO APPLY

Use the subject line "Sources and Uses" followed by your name. Applications without it will not be reviewed. Please include:

1. Your resume.

2. A short description of the most complex financial model you have built or maintained, and what decisions it supported.

3. Your experience with construction draws, lender reporting, or US real estate finance.

4. A two minute video introducing yourself in English.

description:
*MUST SEND VOICE OR VIDEO LINK TO APPLY*





We are a durable medical equipment provider specializing in ostomy supplies. We're hiring a licensed RN to review patient charts and clinical documentation to confirm medical necessity, verify coverage requirements, and keep every order audit-ready before it ships and bills. What You'll Do

Review patient medical records, physician notes, and orders to confirm medical necessity for ostomy supplies (pouches, barriers, wafers, accessories).

Confirm the right quantities, HCPCS coding, and diagnosis support match the clinical picture and payer limits.

Flag utilization outliers and document rationale to protect against audits, denials, and recoupments.

Maintain accurate review notes in the system and support clean, timely order release.

What You Bring

Active, unrestricted RN license (compact/multi-state a plus).

Experience in chart review, utilization review, case management, wound/ostomy care, or DME documentation. WOCN/CWOCN certification is a strong plus.

Working knowledge of Medicare DME documentation standards, medical-necessity criteria, and HCPCS/ICD-10 as applied to supplies.

Sharp eye for detail and the discipline to apply payer rules consistently.

Clear written communication for coordinating with providers and internal teams.

Comfort working independently in a remote, EMR/documentation-heavy workflow.

Nice to Have

Prior work with a DME supplier or billing/compliance team.

Familiarity with ostomy product categories and typical monthly supply allowances.

Experience responding to prepayment or post-payment audits.

Why This Role

Fully remote with a focused, repeatable clinical workflow.

Your review directly keeps orders compliant and the business audit-proof.

Growing DME team that values accuracy over volume.

Job Overview

Our primary requirement is someone who has previously developed complete credit repair business infrastructures, from professional websites and client acquisition funnels to backend CRM automations, AI chatbots, payment integrations, onboarding, client portals, and ongoing client communication.

* System Optimization: Identify inefficiencies, recommend improvements, resolve technical issues, and implement reliable, scalable solutions.



* Future Client Projects: Develop complete websites, AI systems, CRM platforms, and backend automations for businesses across multiple industries.



Required Experience & Skills



* Proven experience building fully automated credit repair business systems using GoHighLevel is our highest priority.

* Advanced GoHighLevel expertise, including workflows, CRM, websites, funnels, pipelines, and integrations.

* Strong coding skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and relevant web development frameworks.

* Experience with Lovable AI, AI website builders, and custom-coded website development.

* Experience building AI chatbots, voice agents, and automated business systems.

* Advanced knowledge of Zapier, Make, n8n, APIs, and webhooks.

* Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, and project management skills.

* Ability to work independently, execute projects efficiently, and provide consistent progress updates.



Preferred: Experience with professional branding, logo design, Figma, Canva, and Adobe design tools.





We prefer to begin with a defined project involving an audit and optimization of our existing GoHighLevel infrastructure and website.



Successful completion may  lead to ongoing development work and additional client projects as our business expands.



How to Apply



Please include the following:



1. Credit Repair Experience: Have you previously built a complete, automated credit repair business using GoHighLevel? Describe your experience.



2. Portfolio: Provide examples or video demonstrations of GHL systems, credit repair websites, and automations you’ve personally developed.



3. Technical Experience: Describe your experience with custom coding, Lovable AI, AI chatbots, voice agents, and third-party integrations.



4. Existing Systems: How would you approach auditing and improving an established GoHighLevel system?



5. Compensation & Availability: What is your preferred project-based rate, and how many hours per week are you available?



Applicants with direct, verifiable credit repair automation experience will receive priority consideration.



We are looking for a reliable, highly skilled developer who can deliver quality results efficiently and grow with our company long-term.

We're an online store selling functional swords: historical katanas and European swords, plus anime-inspired pieces. Our customers are collectors, martial artists, and history and anime fans in the US and worldwide, and we work with suppliers in China and the US. We're looking for one reliable, detail-oriented person to handle three connected areas.

s, and follow each issue through to resolution (order status, shipping, returns, refunds, product questions)

Our customers are knowledgeable and ask detailed questions about steel, forging, construction, and how a sword will perform. To answer them well, you need perfect written and spoken English and a real understanding of how swords are made.



You don't need to know this already. We provide training in the first month, covering how swords are made, our products, and the industry. At the end of that month, we d
 whether to continue based on how well you've understood it.

- Bookkeeping experience with QuickBooks Online, ideally in e-commerce

- Customer support experience and perfect English, written and spoken

- Comfortable with WooCommerce, PayPal, and spreadsheets

- Organized, proactive, and available long-term

- A quick learner who enjoys technical detail

- A plus: an interest in swords, history, martial arts, or anime

title: Collections & Accounts Receivable Specialist – 3PL Logistics
description:
## Role Overview



New York Fulfillment is seeking a proactive, detail-oriented Collections & Accounts Receivable Specialist with strong experience in B2B collections, financial management, and customer account administration.



*The primary responsibility of this position is to maintain healthy company cash flow by collecting outstanding receivables, enforcing payment terms, monitoring customer credit status, and ensuring payment commitments are fulfilled.*



We operate in the third-party logistics (3PL), warehousing, and fulfillment industry. Experience in logistics, distribution, freight, or warehouse operations is highly desirable.



The position also involves occasional billing support, financial reporting, customer service, freight invoice review, and purchasing cost analysis as business needs evolve.



## Primary Responsibilities



### 1. Accounts Receivable, Collections & Cash Flow Management



- Take ownership of the company's accounts receivable and collections process.

- Review aging reports daily and prioritize overdue balances.

- Proactively contact customers by phone and
 to collect outstanding invoices.

- Maintain detailed records of collection communications, payment commitments, and follow-up dates.

- *Track every promised payment and verify that funds are actually received by the agreed date.*

- Immediately follow up on missed payment commitments and escalate unresolved accounts.

- Place customer accounts on credit hold according to company policies when payments are overdue or commitments are broken.

- Coordinate with warehouse management to prevent unauthorized order releases or shipments from accounts on hold.

- Review customer credit limits, payment terms, and account standing.

- Identify high-risk accounts and recommend corrective action.

- Resolve payment discrepancies, unapplied payments, short payments, and disputed balances.

- Reconcile customer payments and outstanding balances in QuickBooks.

- Prepare weekly collection forecasts to help management plan cash availability.

- Maintain professional customer communication while consistently enforcing payment policies.



### 2. Financial Monitoring & Reporting



- Monitor expected incoming payments and provide management with cash collection forecasts.

- Prepare daily or weekly summaries of overdue accounts, promised payments, and collections received.

- Identify accounts that could create cash flow shortages.

- Track accounts receivable aging and collection performance.

- Assist with financial analysis, profitability reviews, and cost monitoring when requested.

- Support bank reconciliation and month-end accounting procedures as needed.



## Additional Responsibilities



### 3. Billing & 3PL System Support



- Assist with customer invoicing and billing reviews as needed.

- Review storage, receiving, fulfillment, shipping, kitting, labeling, and other warehouse service charges.

- Identify missing charges, billing errors, and customer rate discrepancies.

- Help reconcile billing information between Extensiv and QuickBooks.

- Assist with customer billing disputes and invoice corrections.

- Support improvements to billing accuracy and automation.



### 4. Customer Service & Account Coordination



- Respond to customer questions regarding invoices, payments, account balances, and credit holds.

- Assist with customer inquiries related to warehouse services, receiving, fulfillment, inventory, and shipping when needed.

- Coordinate with customer service and warehouse staff to resolve account-related issues.

- Communicate payment requirements, credit policies, and account status professionally.

- Help with customer onboarding and account administration as assigned.



### 5. Freight, Shipping & Vendor Invoice Review



- Review freight and transportation invoices for accuracy.

- Identify incorrect carrier charges, duplicate invoices, unexpected surcharges, and billing discrepancies.

- Communicate with UPS, FedEx, LTL, and FTL carriers when necessary to resolve billing disputes.

- Understand common freight documentation, including Bills of Lading (BOL), PRO numbers, and Proof of Delivery (POD).

- Compare freight charges against agreed rates and service terms.

- Assist with transportation cost analysis as needed.



### 6. Purchasing & Warehouse Supply Cost Control



- Monitor pricing and expenses for warehouse supplies, particularly cartons, boxes, packaging materials, labels, pallets, and stretch wrap.

- Regularly compare pricing among packaging suppliers and vendors.

- Request competitive quotes and identify lower-cost purchasing opportunities.

- Review supplier invoices for pricing errors, duplicate charges, and unexpected increases.

- Evaluate purchasing costs, delivery charges, minimum order quantities, and vendor terms.

- Recommend cost-saving alternatives while maintaining required quality standards.

- Assist with vendor negotiations and purchasing decisions when requested.



## Required Qualifications



- Strong experience in business-to-business (B2B) accounts receivable and collections.

- Proven ability to follow up on overdue accounts and secure payments.

- Experience enforcing payment terms, credit limits, and account holds.

- Proficiency with QuickBooks Online and Microsoft Excel.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple accounts, deadlines, and payment commitments.

- Confidence handling difficult collection conversations professionally.

- Ability to work independently and take responsibility for results.



## Highly Preferred Experience



- Previous employment in a 3PL, fulfillment center, warehouse, distribution, transportation, or logistics company.

- Experience with *Extensiv (formerly 3PL Central / 3PL Warehouse Manager)*.

- Familiarity with Shopify and other e-commerce platforms.

- Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS).

- Knowledge of LTL, FTL, small-parcel shipping, and freight billing.

- Experience reviewing supplier costs and negotiating packaging prices.

- Experience with financial forecasting, reporting, and cash flow management.



## Performance Expectations



The successful candidate will be evaluated primarily on:



1. Consistent collection of outstanding receivables.

2. Timely follow-up and verification of promised payments.

3. Proper enforcement of credit holds and payment terms.

4. Reduction of overdue balances and improvement in cash flow.

5. Accuracy of customer balances and payment records.

6. Timely identification and resolution of billing discrepancies.

7. Cost savings through supplier comparisons and invoice reviews.

8. Professional customer communication and account management.



*Our priority is finding someone who takes ownership of collections, follows through on commitments, and helps keep the company's cash flow healthy.*



To apply, please send your CV to

Aperture Motion is a media agency. We make short-form videos, product videos and ads for businesses in finance, real estate and tech, and for our own Instagram pages.



The role

We're looking for freelance video editors and motion designers to work with us per video. You get a brief, a script and the brand files, and turn them into finished vertical videos for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, plus some longer product and explainer videos.



The work includes:

- Explainer and product videos built from editable After Effects templates

- AI-generated shots and scenes that blend into the edit

- Making changes from feedback quickly and accurately



What you need

- Good written English and reliable communication



We'll teach you our exact setup, but you should already be comfortable working with Claude.

- We start with a short paid test. If it goes well, we send you regular work

This post can't cover everything. We'll go through the rest on an interview call with shortlisted applicants.

title: Supply Chain Manager + Backend Assistant
description:
E-commerce Fashion Dropshipping · Remote · Part-time (growing to full-time)



About us



We run a group of fast-growing online fashion stores selling to customers across Europe, the UK, Australia and the US. Our products are shipped directly from our supplier, so the quality of our backend (orders, shipping, returns, claims and product quality) d
 how much money we keep. We are building a stricter, faster and more profitable backend, and we need someone who wants to own that.



The role



You will be our right hand on the backend. You work closely with our Backend Manager to take our current backend apart and rebuild it, and you hold both our team and our supplier to a higher standard. You think along with us, you spot leaks, and you fix them. This is a hands-on role with a lot of freedom and full access to our systems.



What you will do

- Supplier management: Be our main point of contact with the supplier. Follow up daily, push for answers and escalate when deadlines are missed. Track response times and agree on clear service levels.

- Order problems: Own every problem order from start to finish: stuck or lost parcels, customs, carrier exceptions, missing tracking, stock issues, wrong items and sizes. No order stays open without an owner, a next step and a date.

- Claims and credits: Make sure we recover our money. Check that the supplier credits us for refunds, chargebacks, Chargeblast/RDR cases and returns (50% or 100% of cost price, depending on the case), and that these credits are deducted from the invoices. Check every invoice.

- Returns: Track return parcels to the warehouse, confirm receipt and make sure refunds are paid out.

- Quality control: Be responsible for quality checks. Review the supplier’s QC photos, materials and size charts, judge products on quality and flag products with high refund rates for removal or replacement.

- Team performance: Monitor the productivity and response times of our backend team (order
s, tickets, follow-ups). Give feedback, set targets and report on them weekly.

- Process improvement: Together with the Backend Manager, find what is broken, write clear procedures and use our internal dashboard and reports to improve how we work.

- Reporting: Give us a short weekly overview of problem orders, money recovered, supplier performance and team response times.



What we are looking for

- Experience in e-commerce, dropshipping, supply chain, logistics or customer operations

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong and direct communicator who can hold suppliers and colleagues accountable in a professional way

- Very organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable with numbers and invoices

- Takes ownership and keeps going until a problem is solved

- Comfortable with Shopify, Slack, spreadsheets and parcel tracking (we will train you on our dashboard)

- Available during the supplier’s working hours for part of the day

- Bonus: fashion or apparel quality knowledge, experience working with Chinese suppliers, any extra language



What we offer

- Part-time to start, with more hours as the role grows

- Starting pay of $5 per hour, with increases based on results (money recovered, fewer problem orders, faster response times)

- Fully remote work, with a lot of responsibility from day one

- Real growth: more responsibilities and a bigger role as the business scales

- Direct access to the owner and a team that wants to make the backend better



How to apply

Send a short introduction and your experience. Please also answer this: A parcel has been in customs for 3 weeks, the customer is asking for a refund, and the supplier has not replied for 4 days. What do you do, step by step?

title: Funding Specialist | Banking/Lending Experience Required | Salary + Performance Bonuses
description:
Funding Specialist, REMOTE



IMPORTANT: READ BEFORE APPLYING



If you do not have previous experience in banking, lending, business funding, credit, loan processing, or a related financial services role, DO NOT APPLY.



We are looking for someone who already understands how lending and funding work. We will train you on our systems, lenders, and processes, but we are not looking to teach someone the funding industry from scratch.



ABOUT US



We are a US-based funding company helping consumers, business owners, and real estate investors access capital through multiple lending products.



We are hiring a full-time Funding Specialist to help manage the day-to-day work required to move clients from onboarding through funding.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS



This is NOT a sales position.



You will also NOT be the primary relationship manager for the client.



Our Funding Director handles most face-to-face client communication, funding strategy calls, major conversations, approvals, escalations, and relationship management.



You will handle much of the day-to-day legwork required behind the scenes to keep each client moving.



Think of yourself as the person responsible for keeping the funding file moving.



You will gather documents, request missing information, update clients on what is needed, update the client app and CRM, prepare submissions, submit applications, track lender responses, clear conditions, follow up with lenders, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



You WILL communicate with clients frequently through messages,
, our client app, and other channels. You just will not be responsible for leading most face-to-face meetings or managing the overall client relationship.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Review every new client's file after onboarding



• Review credit, income, banking information, business information, and supporting documentation



• Determine which documents and information are still needed



• Contact clients to request missing documents or information



• Follow up consistently until required documents are received



• Keep clients updated on the status of their file



• Update the client app with progress, outstanding requirements, next steps, and important status changes



• Keep GoHighLevel and our internal systems updated throughout the entire funding process



• Organize bank statements, tax returns, identification, business documents, financial statements, and other lender requirements



• Prepare complete funding packages for submission



• Submit applications to banks, lenders, and funding partners



• Track every application after submission



• Follow up with lenders on pending applications



• Track approvals, denials, conditions, document requests, and underwriting updates



• Request additional documents from clients when lenders require them



• Clear lender conditions as quickly as possible



• Make sure the Funding Director always has an accurate picture of where every client stands



• Escalate problems, unusual situations, and important decisions to the Funding Director



• Coordinate with the Funding Director when a client needs a strategy conversation or face-to-face meeting



• Keep detailed notes so anyone on the team can open a file and immediately understand its current status



• Make sure no application, document request, lender follow-up, or client update gets missed



• Help move clients from onboarding to submission to approval to funding as efficiently as possible



CLIENT COMMUNICATION



There IS a significant amount of client communication in this position.



The difference is the TYPE of communication.



You will handle much of the operational communication:



• Requesting documents



• Following up on missing documents



• Telling clients what information is still needed



• Providing application status updates



• Updating the client app



• Communicating lender requirements



• Requesting additional information after underwriting



• Keeping clients informed about next steps



• Making sure clients complete required tasks



The Funding Director will primarily handle:



• Face-to-face client meetings



• Funding strategy calls



• Complex funding discussions



• Presenting and explaining major approvals or offers



• Client escalations



• Difficult conversations



• Overall relationship management



Your role is to do the legwork and keep everything moving so the Funding Director can focus on strategy, approvals, and higher-level client conversations.



COMPENSATION



Base Salary: $250 per week



Funded Deal Bonuses: $15 to $100 per funded deal, depending on deal type and funding volume.



The more deals you successfully help move through the funding process, the greater your bonus opportunity.



We measure performance based on:



• Funded deals



• Speed of document collection



• Submission accuracy



• Client follow-up



• Lender follow-up



• Accuracy of client and CRM updates



• Speed of clearing conditions



• Organization



• Overall pipeline movement



SCHEDULE



• Full-time position



• Monday through Friday



• US Eastern Time business hours



• Long-term position



• Time Doctor tracking is required during working hours



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



REQUIRED:



• Previous experience in banking, lending, business funding, credit, loan processing, underwriting support, or financial services



• Experience working with borrower documentation



• Understanding of the lending process from application through funding



• Strong written and spoken English



• Comfortable communicating with US-based clients



• Strong attention to detail



• Strong follow-up skills



• Highly organized



• Comfortable requesting documents repeatedly when necessary



• Able to manage a large number of active files at once



• Able to keep detailed and accurate CRM records



• Able to follow lender guidelines and internal processes



• Self-managed and proactive



• Reliable computer, internet connection, and quiet workspace



• Available during US Eastern Time business hours



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience with any of the following is a major plus:



• Business funding



• Loan processing



• Business credit cards and 0% funding



• Personal loans



• Business lines of credit



• Term loans



• SBA lending



• Equipment financing



• Real estate lending



• Consumer credit



• Bank underwriting support



• Document collection



• Lender submissions



• GoHighLevel



• CRM pipeline management



• US lenders or financial companies



HOW TO APPLY



Send us:



1. A 2 to 3 minute video introducing yourself.



2. Explain your previous experience in banking, lending, credit, loan processing, or funding.



3. Tell us which lending or funding products you have worked with.



4. Explain your experience gathering client documents, preparing files, submitting applications, and following up with lenders.



5. Explain how many active client files you have managed at one time.



6. Send your resume.



7. Send a screenshot of your internet speed test.



8. Tell us your earliest available start date.



Applications without relevant banking, lending, credit, loan processing, or funding experience will not be considered.



DO NOT APPLY IF



• You have zero experience in banking, lending, credit, loan processing, or funding



• You need to learn the basics of the lending industry from scratch



• You are looking for a sales position



• You dislike following up with clients



• You dislike chasing down documents



• You struggle with administrative work or detailed record keeping



• You regularly forget follow-ups



• You have trouble managing multiple active files



• You are uncomfortable communicating with clients throughout the day



• You cannot work US Time hours



• You already have another full-time position that conflicts with this schedule



• You are unwilling to use Time Doctor



This role requires someone who takes ownership.



If a document is missing, you follow up.



If a lender needs something, you get it.



If an application is pending, you check on it.



If a client needs an update, you provide it.



If the client app is outdated, you update it.



If something is holding up a deal, you identify it and get the right person involved.



The Funding Director handles the higher-level relationship and strategy. You handle the day-to-day execution that keeps every deal moving toward funding.

title: . Deal Marketing & Buyer Relations Representative – Real Estate
description:
Pay: Competitive base plus performance bonuses and deal commissions

Schedule: 40 hrs/weekly. Hours must overlap with U.S. business hours, with flexibility within that.



About Us

We’re a U.S.-based real estate investment company specialising in direct-to-agent wholesaling. We’re growing fast and need someone who can take a property and get it sold fast by marketing it to the right investors. This is the start of a long-term role for the right person.



What You’ll Do

1. Reach out to cash buyers: Cold call and text active investors, learn what they want to buy, and build lasting relationships.

2. Build the buyers list: Add every buyer to GoHighLevel with their criteria, target areas, price range, and proof of funds status.

3. Market our deals: Match each property to buyer criteria, send deal packages, and follow up consistently until we have offers.

4. Qualify and negotiate: Screen for serious buyers and handle early negotiations on price and terms.

5. Keep buyers engaged: Track KPIs (calls, new buyers, offers, closings) and make sure every lead has a clear next step.



What You Bring

1. Proven experience in real estate wholesaling, dispositions, or investor relations (required)

2. Clear, confident spoken English and strong communication skills

3. Comfort making a high volume of calls and texts

4. CRM experience (GoHighLevel preferred)

5. Organised, detail-orientated, and self-managed

6. Reliable, fast internet and a quiet workspace



What’s in it for you?

1. Long-term role with real growth potential

2. Uncapped upside through bonuses and commissions on closed deals

3. A direct line to the decision-maker and a chance to shape the acquisitions process



How to Apply

Send us a message with:

1. A short summary of your real estate experience (markets worked, deals sold, buyer lists built, call volume if you know it)

2. CRM tools you’ve used, especially GoHighLevel

3. Your available hours and time zone

4. A screenshot of your internet speed test

5. A 30-60 second voice recording introducing yourself and your real estate background



Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.

title: Commercial Painting Estimator
description:
Blair Commercial Painting, LLC

Commercial Painting Estimator - Remote

Location: Remote - Philippines



Schedule: Full-Time | 40 Hours per Week



Pay: $8 - $12 USD per hour, depending on experience







Own the Entire Estimating Process. From Bid Invitation to Final Follow-Up



Blair Commercial Painting, LLC is an established, award-winning commercial painting contractor serving Southeastern Wisconsin. We specialize in commercial interior and exterior painting, working on new construction, commercial developments, and renovation projects.



We're looking for an experienced Commercial Painting Estimator to take full ownership of our estimating process remotely.



This is not simply a quantity takeoff position. We need someone who can manage the entire estimating cycle independently, from receiving bid invitations and reviewing construction plans to preparing accurate estimates, submitting professional proposals, and following up with general contractors to help secure projects.



You'll be responsible for keeping our estimating pipeline organized, ensuring deadlines are met, and making sure no bidding opportunity falls through the cracks.



We're looking for someone who understands commercial painting, knows how to read construction drawings and specifications, and can confidently manage multiple bids without constant supervision.





Responsibilities

Bid Management & CRM



Receive, review, and organize incoming bid invitations and project opportunities.

Enter all bidding opportunities, project details, contacts, and deadlines into the CRM.

Review bid documents to determine project scope, requirements, and suitability.

Track bid deadlines, submission requirements, and project status.

Maintain an organized, accurate, and up-to-date estimating pipeline.

Takeoffs & Cost Estimating



Review architectural drawings, specifications, and construction documents.

Perform accurate digital quantity takeoffs for commercial interior and exterior painting projects.

Calculate labor, materials, equipment, production rates, and other project costs.

Identify different paint systems, surface preparations, finishes, and coating requirements.

Review project scope for exclusions, clarifications, and potential cost considerations.

Request and evaluate supplier pricing when necessary.

Prepare detailed, competitive estimates that support company profitability.

Proposals & Bid Submissions



Prepare complete, professional painting proposals with clearly defined scopes of work.

Include appropriate pricing, exclusions, qualifications, and project-specific requirements.

Submit bids to general contractors, construction managers, and other clients before deadlines.

Respond to bid clarifications, addenda, and scope revisions.

Revise pricing and proposals as project requirements change.

Ensure all estimates and proposals are properly documented and stored.

Follow-Up & Sales Coordination



Proactively follow up on submitted bids to obtain feedback and determine project status.

Communicate professionally with general contractors and prospective clients.

Track bid results, project awards, and upcoming opportunities.

Maintain regular contact with clients regarding outstanding proposals.

Identify opportunities to improve bid competitiveness and conversion rates.

Coordinate with company leadership when projects require additional review or negotiation.

Full-Cycle Estimating Ownership



Manage the entire process from initial bid invitation through estimate, proposal, submission, follow-up, and final bid outcome.

Prioritize multiple estimating opportunities while consistently meeting deadlines.

Maintain complete records of all bids, correspondence, revisions, and outcomes.

Provide regular updates on estimating activity, bid volume, pending proposals, and awarded projects.

Continuously improve estimating accuracy, workflows, and efficiency.

Qualifications

Minimum 5 years of professional estimating experience in commercial painting.

Proven experience independently managing the full estimating cycle, not just performing takeoffs.

Strong understanding of commercial interior and exterior painting systems, materials, preparation requirements, and labor production rates.

Experience estimating commercial new construction, renovations, and other commercial painting projects.

Ability to interpret architectural drawings, construction specifications, and bid documents accurately.

Proficiency with digital takeoff and estimating software.

Experience using CRM systems to manage bidding opportunities, client information, and follow-up activities.

Strong understanding of estimating labor, materials, equipment, overhead, and profit margins.

Excellent written and spoken English, particularly when communicating with U.S.-based general contractors.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple bids simultaneously.

Proactive approach to tracking deadlines, following up on proposals, and resolving issues independently.

Comfortable working remotely with a U.S.-based team.

Experience estimating commercial painting projects for U.S. contractors is strongly preferred.



Compensation & Opportunity

$8 - $12 USD per hour, depending on experience and capabilities.

Full-time, remote position based in the Philippines.

Long-term opportunity with an established U.S. commercial painting contractor.

Work directly with company leadership and play a key role in securing new business.

Opportunity to take ownership of the estimating function and help improve company systems and processes.

Supportive, professional team that values accountability, accuracy, and follow-through.

We're Looking for Someone Who Owns the Whole Process

description:
# Virtual Reservations Agent — Hotel or Vacation Rental Experience Required - VA experience with a strong background and experience using Streamline.



**Company:** Haustay Vacation Rentals  

**Location:** Fully remote  

**Schedule:** Monday–Sunday, Monday, Thursday, & Friday 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Tuesday & Wednesday 8am-9pm Saturday & Sunday 2pm-6pm

**Compensation:** $5.00 USD per hour, paid biweekly  

**Time Tracking:** Hubstaff required  



## About Haustay



Haustay Vacation Rentals is a boutique vacation rental management company serving North County San Diego, California. We specialize in premium vacation homes, exceptional guest experiences, and attentive homeowner service.



We are a lean, growing team that values responsiveness, accountability, initiative, and professional hospitality. We are looking for a dependable team member who wants to build a long-term career with us.



## About the Role



As our Virtual Reservations Agent, you will be a primary point of contact for guests, helping them from their first inquiry through their post-stay experience.



Reporting directly to the business owner, you will manage reservations, answer guest questions, coordinate with our operations team, and resolve concerns within established guidelines. This is an active, guest-facing position that requires sound judgment, attention to detail, and ownership of follow-through.



**Previous experience in hotel reservations, hotel front desk operations, or vacation rental guest services is required.**



## Key Responsibilities



### Guest Communication and Reservations



- Respond promptly and professionally to inquiries through Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, our direct website, SMS,
, and phone.

- Manage reservations, modifications, cancellations, and payment questions according to company policies.

- Provide accurate information about properties, availability, amenities, check-in procedures, policies, and local recommendations.

- Follow up on booking inquiries and identify appropriate upsell opportunities.

- Handle cancellation requests and disputes thoughtfully, protecting revenue while maintaining professional guest service.



### Listing Quality Control



- Check listings for accurate amenities, descriptions, policies, and pricing.

- Flag discrepancies promptly and make authorized updates.



### Operational Coordination



- Communicate new bookings, reservation changes, and special requests to cleaning and field teams.

- Escalate maintenance concerns and urgent guest issues promptly, with clear details.

- Maintain accurate reservation notes, task updates, and shift handoffs.

- Follow up on open issues to help ensure timely resolution.



### Guest Experience and Issue Resolution



- Handle concerns calmly, professionally, and with empathy.

- Resolve issues within your authority and escalate situations that require approval.

- Follow up with guests to confirm their concerns have been addressed.

- Request post-stay reviews and assist with professional responses to guest feedback.



## Required Qualifications



- At least one year of experience in hotel reservations, hotel front desk operations, or vacation rental reservations or guest services.

- Excellent written and spoken English, including clear, professional phone communication.

- Experience handling guest inquiries, reservation changes, and complaints.

- Strong organization, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to manage multiple conversations and software systems accurately.

- Ability to work independently while following procedures and escalation guidelines.

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a backup plan for internet or power outages.

- High integrity and discretion when handling guest, homeowner, and company information.

- Availability for the full scheduled shift.

- Willingness to use Hubstaff for time tracking and activity monitoring during working hours.



## Preferred Software Experience



Experience with the following is helpful, but not required:



- Streamline PMS

- Breezeway

- RingCentral

- Airbnb, Vrbo, and 
 dashboards

- Slack

- Hubstaff



Training on our systems and procedures will be provided. Applicants should already have a foundation in hotel or vacation rental guest service.



## Schedule and Work Expectations



- The schedule follows California local time, including daylight saving time changes.

- You must be available, responsive, and focused on assigned duties during scheduled working hours.

- Hubstaff is required for time tracking and activity monitoring.



## Compensation and Benefits



- $5.00 USD per hour, paid every two weeks.

- Fully remote work with a consistent schedule.

- Long-term opportunity with room for growth.

- Direct training and mentorship from the business owner.

- Performance-based opportunities for pay increases and expanded responsibilities.

- 13th-month pay.

- Potential for additional shifts as the company grows.



## Who Will Succeed Here



You will be a strong fit if you take initiative, communicate clearly, stay calm under pressure, and follow tasks through to completion. We value people who notice details, ask thoughtful questions, and take responsibility for the guest experience.



High performers may grow into reservations management, operations coordination, revenue management support, or team leadership roles.



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. A brief introduction explaining why you are a strong fit for Haustay.

2. Your résumé and a summary of your hotel or vacation rental experience, including the systems you have used.

3. A short example of a guest concern you handled and how you resolved it.

4. Your current internet speed and backup plan for internet or power outages.

5. Confirmation that you can work  Monday–Sunday, Monday, Thursday, & Friday 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Tuesday & Wednesday 8am-9pm Saturday & Sunday 2pm-6pm Pacific Time, including seasonal time changes.

6. Confirmation that you accept the $5.00 USD hourly rate, biweekly payment schedule, and required use of Hubstaff.

7. Your earliest available start date.



We are looking for someone dependable, detail-oriented, and ready to grow with Haustay over the long term.

title: Expert SDR - US B2B Outbound, Appointment Setting (Full-Time, US Eastern Hours)
description:
Focus Talent Partners is hiring an experienced Sales Development Representative for full-time, long-term work on US Eastern Time hours.



This role is for a proven SDR, not an entry-level caller. You will prospect senior US business executives by phone,
, text, and LinkedIn, open conversations, qualify interest, and book appointments for our sales team. LinkedIn is a core channel in this role, not an extra: you will send connection requests, run follow-up message sequences, and carry on conversations with executives who engage, alongside your calling. You will work a defined list, follow a structured outreach cadence across all channels, and keep the CRM current after every touch.



What success looks like here: a full day of outbound activity across phone,
, and LinkedIn, every working day; appointments booked each week for the sales team, measured on meetings the prospect actually attends; and a CRM that shows exactly what happened with every prospect, updated the same day.



Requirements:

- At least 3 years of SDR or B2B outbound appointment-setting experience, with US clients

- A record of booked meetings you can speak to with numbers

- Spoken English at a level US executives accept without friction; a voice recording is part of the application (see below)

- Daily high-volume outbound calling experience, including gatekeepers and voi
 strategy

- LinkedIn outreach experience: connection requests, follow-up sequences, and conversation handling (Sales Navigator experience is a plus)

- CRM discipline: every call,
, and outcome logged the same day (HubSpot experience is a strong plus)

- Experience with dialers and
 sequencing tools

- Full-time availability on US Eastern Time hours, Monday to Friday; this must be your only full-time role

- A completed university degree

- Reliable computer, headset, and wired internet connection with a quiet workspace



What we offer:

- Full-time, long-term position with a US company

- A base salary of $400 per month, paid reliably and on time

- Performance pay on every appointment you book that the prospect attends. This is where the money is in this role: top performers earn more than double the base in total pay, and the structure is explained in full before any offer

- A defined list, a defined process, and a sales team that closes what you book



Our hiring process: application, a short written questionnaire, a brief voice call, and a final interview. We aim to complete it within about two weeks, and every applicant who completes a stage hears back from us about the next one.



To apply: begin your application with the word PITCH. In five sentences or fewer, describe the outbound role where you booked the most meetings: who you called, what your monthly booking number was, and what tools you used. Then include a link to a short voice recording (Vocaroo or Google Drive) of 60 seconds or less: introduce yourself, then read this line as if you were leaving it on a call: "Good morning, this is [your name] with Focus Talent Partners. We work with companies that are hiring senior executives, and I was hoping to arrange a brief introductory call with you this week. Thursday morning or Friday afternoon, whichever suits you better." Applications without the recording will not be reviewed.

title: LinkedIn Account Partner — keep your old profile active (very light work)
description:
We run B2B outreach and we need real people with old, unused LinkedIn profiles. You will not be asked to send messages or find leads. We do all of that. You just let us use your profile and stay reachable. 



The perfect fit, in order:



You made a LinkedIn account 2+ years ago and you never use it. Perfect. Genuinely.

You have an old account with a handful of connections and no posts. Also great.

You don't have LinkedIn at all — still fine, you'd just make one.

If your profile is busy, active and full of posts, it's probably not for you, though we'll consider it.



What you'll actually do:



Keep your phone number on the account and forward us login codes when asked — usually a few times a month

Reply within about 4 hours during your day

If LinkedIn ever asks to verify you, take a selfie with your passport. Rare, but it matters

Filipino passport, valid 6+ months

Phone with NFC, for passport verification

Not currently using your LinkedIn to job hunt

English good enough for us to message each other

Terms: $40 (USD) / Month, negotiable for a good profile. One-week paid trial first. Monthly by GCash or Wise. You'll add our
 to the account so we can manage it — you stay the owner.

title: Junior Software Trainer
description:

Intellezy is seeking an enthusiastic, entry-level Junior Software Trainer to support the delivery and development of software training. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys explaining how software works, working with people, and learning new technology. The Junior Software Trainer will assist with virtual training on business software such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and AI tools, create and update training resources, and participate in recording and refreshing software instructional videos. • Strong English Language Proficiency

• Relevant coursework, internships, help desk or customer-facing experience, or L&D certifications.

About Intellezy 

Intellezy is a corporate training company that offers a training video library, custom eLearning development, and AI adoption services. The library is available in 40 languages and reaches learners in more than 200 countries. 

Intellezy also builds custom training. Its in-house team of instructional designers, eLearning developers, and video production specialists creates custom eLearning, virtual instructor-led training, and blended learning programs, and helps organizations adopt AI with role-based training and change management. 

Working at Intellezy 

Intellezy is a close-knit team where every person's work reaches learners at organizations around the world. Team members work alongside instructional designers, video producers, and L&D experts, and help shape how companies train their people on AI and the tools they use every day.

title: Virtual Recruiting Ambassador (Remote, U.S. Hours) Right Seat Recruiting
description:
Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

Pay: [$3.50 - $7.00 USD per hour] plus monthly performance incentives

Type: Long-term, independent contractor



About the Role

Recruiting is sales. We’re looking for a visually appealing, confident, energetic Virtual Recruiting Ambassador to be the face and voice of a growing U.S. construction company. You’ll be the first person candidates meet, and your job is to take someone who is “just interested” and make them genuinely excited to join the team.



This is not a scheduling role. We need someone who loves connecting with people, can sell an opportunity, and makes every candidate feel like they’re talking to a friend who believes in where they work.



What You’ll Do



Conduct video conversations with U.S. sales candidates

Discover what each candidate wants (income, growth, team) and show them how this opportunity fits

Handle candidate questions and concerns with confidence and warmth

Secure commitment: book next-step interviews and make sure candidates show up

Follow up before interviews and start dates to keep candidates engaged

Keep candidate notes and trackers accurate and up to date

Help with light administrative tasks for the hiring team as needed



What You Bring



A polished, professional on-camera presence: confident, warm, and engaging on video (required)

Excellent spoken and written English (required)

A natural ability to build rapport and get people excited

Comfortable handling objections without getting flustered

Organized, reliable, and coachable

Available 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday–Friday



Your Setup (required)



Reliable computer, webcam, and noise-cancelling headset

Quiet, professional, well-lit workspace

High-speed internet with a backup power or internet plan



Why Join Us



Long-term, full-time role with a U.S. recruiting firm

Monthly performance incentives for hitting offer-acceptance and show-rate goals

Paid U.S. holidays, plus paid time off after 90 days

Coaching from a U.S. recruiter with 20+ years of experience



How to Apply



Send your resume. 

Record a 60–90 second video (not just audio) answering this question: “A candidate is interested in a sales job but isn’t sure it’s right for them. What would you say to get them excited?”

Use the subject line “Right Seat Ambassador” so we know you read the full post.

title: Insurance Eligibility Coordinator - Remote
description:

Compensation: $4.50 per hr - 40 hours per week

Work Setup: Remote

Qualifications

- Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities

- Customer service mindset with professionalism and empathy

Requirements

- Quiet and distraction-free workspace

Nice to Have

How to Apply

Please include:



1. Updated resume and WhatsApp number

title: Social Media Lead Generation Specialist
description:
FitWINS / Fit With Nirit, LLC

FitWINS helps women in midlife build strength, lose weight, and feel confident through personalized fitness and nutrition coaching.



We are looking for a proactive, personable, and engaging Social Media Lead Generation Specialist to help us expand our reach and connect with women who could benefit from our coaching programs.



This is a relationship-building and conversation-starting role. Your primary responsibility will be to actively engage with potential clients on
 and Instagram by participating in comment conversations, identifying potential prospects within our audience, and initiating personalized DM conversations.



You will be the first point of contact for many prospective clients, creating positive first impressions, building curiosity about FitWINS, and generating interest that can be developed into qualified discovery calls by our appointment-setting team.



Once an initial conversation is established, you will hand off the prospect to Intellicoach and our Head Appointment Setter, who will take over the ongoing conversation, qualification, follow-up, and appointment-booking process.



If you love social media, enjoy connecting with people, and are naturally good at starting conversations, this could be a great opportunity for you!



Key Responsibilities



1. Social Media Engagement & Lead Generation



Actively engage with potential clients across FitWINS'
 and Instagram accounts.



Monitor comments on posts, reels, stories, ads, and other social media content.



Respond to comments in a friendly, authentic, and engaging way that encourages further interaction.



Identify opportunities to turn public comment interactions into private DM conversations.



Proactively initiate DM conversations with women who engage with our content, follow our accounts, interact with our stories, or demonstrate interest in health, fitness, nutrition, and weight loss.



Identify potential prospects within our existing social media audience and initiate personalized outreach.



Engage with followers of relevant accounts, communities, and approved social media sources to identify potential leads.



Use curiosity-driven questions and natural conversation to encourage prospects to share more about themselves.



Build rapport without making conversations feel scripted, salesy, or pushy.



Generate interest in FitWINS and our coaching programs without overwhelming prospects with information.



Recognize when someone may be a good fit for our programs and create a natural transition into the next stage of the conversation.



2. Initial DM Conversations & Prospect Handoffs



Initiate genuine, personalized conversations with potential clients through Instagram and
 Messenger.



Respond naturally to initial replies and keep conversations moving toward a meaningful next step.



Develop a basic understanding of the prospect's interests, goals, and potential challenges.



Recognize buying signals and opportunities for further conversation.



Create curiosity about how FitWINS helps women over 40 achieve their health and fitness goals.



Transition interested prospects to Intellicoach and our Head Appointment Setter for continued engagement and qualification.



Provide clear handoff information, including the prospect's name, social media profile, initial interaction, and any relevant information shared.



Ensure prospects are handed off promptly so interested individuals do not fall through the cracks.



Follow established communication guidelines and respect individuals who are not interested.



3. FitWINS Brand & Communication



Develop a strong understanding of FitWINS, our ideal clients, our coaching philosophy, and our programs.



Represent the FitWINS brand with warmth, enthusiasm, authenticity, and professionalism.



Understand the challenges women in midlife commonly experience, including weight gain, menopause-related changes, lack of confidence, frustration with dieting, and difficulty prioritizing themselves.



Communicate in a natural, conversational style that reflects our brand personality.



Personalize interactions rather than relying on generic copy-and-paste messages.



Use approved messaging, conversation starters, and engagement strategies.



Maintain a positive, encouraging, and nonjudgmental approach.



Avoid making medical claims, guaranteeing results, or providing unapproved coaching advice.



4. Lead Tracking & Daily Reporting



Maintain accurate records of new prospects and initiated conversations in our designated tracking system.



Track daily engagement activity, including comments, new DM conversations, and successful handoffs.



Ensure all interested prospects are transferred to the appropriate team member.



Monitor the status of conversations you initiate to help identify opportunities or missed handoffs.



Provide regular updates on lead generation activity and results.



Identify which engagement strategies, posts, and outreach methods generate the most interest.



Communicate recurring questions, objections, and feedback from prospective clients to the appointment-setting and marketing teams.



What We're Looking For



Excellent written communication skills and a natural ability to connect with people.



Comfortable initiating conversations with people you have never met.



Active familiarity with
, Instagram, and social media engagement.



Ability to recognize potential prospects and identify opportunities for meaningful conversations.



Friendly, outgoing, personable, and confident communication style.



Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established processes.



Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working independently.



Reliable and consistent with daily activity and assigned responsibilities.



Ability to manage multiple conversations and stay organized.



Comfortable using social media messaging platforms, Google Sheets, and CRM systems.



Previous experience in social media engagement, community management, lead generation, appointment setting, or sales is a plus.



What Success Looks Like



Consistent daily engagement across
 and Instagram.



An increasing number of meaningful conversations initiated with potential clients.



More followers and social media engagers converting into DM conversations.



A steady flow of interested prospects being handed off to Intellicoach and our Head Appointment Setter.



High-quality initial interactions that create a positive impression of FitWINS.



Accurate and timely lead tracking and handoffs.



A proactive team member who takes initiative rather than waiting for opportunities to come to them.



How to Apply



If you love social media, enjoy connecting with people, and are excited about helping women improve their health and confidence, we'd love to hear from you!

title: E-commerce Product Researcher

- Use feedback from our product tests to improve future research.



Requirements:

- A good understanding of Meta advertising and what makes a product worth testing.

title: Commissioned Sales Representative (Phone)

A brief overview of your phone sales experience

The highest monthly revenue you’ve personally closed in a past role

Your internet speed + headset setup

Your availability (confirm weekends)

A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you’re a good fit for phone sales

You’ll be working with customers who already have high intent, calling in with questions, requesting quotes, or abandoning carts and needing follow-up.



If you know how to build rapport fast, handle objections, and close confidently on the phone, you’ll thrive here. This is a performance-driven role with real upside for the right closer.



JOB REQUIREMENTS:

Key Responsibilities:

Answer inbound sales calls from customers looking to purchase diesel auto parts

Follow up on warm leads (abandoned carts, form fills, quote requests)

Help customers select the right parts for their truck (training provided)

Overcome objections and close orders on the phone

Log call notes and outcomes in Gorgias / Shopify

Work closely with the operations team to ensure smooth order handoff



Must-Have Skills:

7–10+ years of phone sales experience (inside sales, high-ticket phone sales, B2C or B2B)

Proven ability to close deals (not just take orders)

Excellent spoken English and clear phone presence

Comfortable working U.S. customer hours on weekends

Strong follow-up discipline and CRM hygiene

Auto parts/diesel performance knowledge is a plus, but not required

Competitive, goal-driven, and money-motivated



Performance Expectations

Focus on closing inbound calls and warm follow-ups efficiently



Tools You’ll Use

Aircall – phone system

Gorgias – support + sales inbox

Shopify – order management



Compensation

Base Pay: $7–$12/hour (based on experience and performance in trial)

Performance Bonuses: Ability to earn up to $3,000/month based on sales performance after the first three months

Clear path to increased hourly rate and higher bonus potential for consistent performers

title: Premiere Pro Wedding Video Editor | $500/Month | Paid Training & Weekly Pay
description:
Build a long-term editing career with EditValue. We are looking for reliable Adobe Premiere Pro editors to join our wedding-video team, with paid training, a constant flow of assignments and weekly PayPal payments.



Wedding-editing experience is welcome, but not required. If you already know Premiere, follow instructions carefully and want to improve, we would like to hear from you. Some of our strongest editors started without wedding experience.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

You receive synced footage, clear instructions and manageable editing assignments. Our AI prepares the multicam, so your role includes carefully vetting the ceremony and editing assigned sequences. A team leader gives feedback and helps you become faster and more consistent.



Real work and continued training go hand in hand. You learn the wedding workflow one sequence at a time, progressing toward reels and complete wedding highlights.



WHAT WE OFFER

- A long-term position with a steady flow of wedding-video work

- Around US$500 per month, with weekly PayPal payments for approved work

- Paid training, tutorials and individual guidance

- A clear path to more advanced editing and responsibility



WHAT YOU NEED

- Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and access to it for the assessment

- A suitable Windows PC. This workflow is not Mac-based. We supply the matching Premiere version for training and work.

- An active PayPal account that can receive payments

- Conversational spoken English

- Reliable delivery, attention to detail and responsive communication

- Availability Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 14:00 Israel time during initial training (currently 3 PM to 8 PM in the Philippines)



After approximately one month, editors who understand the workflow and can work independently may move to flexible editing hours. This depends on your progress. You must still complete assigned projects and meet deadlines.



THE PAID SKILLS TEST

Shortlisted applicants complete a US$2 paid editing assessment before training. It uses old footage from a real wedding completed and delivered several years ago, not a current client delivery.



The tasks are an already-synced five-minute multicam timeline and a 30-second reception edit. For the reception portion, use only reception and venue shots, such as the setup, decorations, tables, food, and guests during the reception. Do not use dancing, party, or ceremony footage, even if it appears in the supplied reception timeline. You submit only full-timeline screenshots and low-quality previews uploaded to 
. No Premiere project file is requested. Instructions and all test materials are supplied.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with CEREMONY and include:

1. A short, approximately 30-second spoken English introduction. This is required. A Vocaroo link is fine; no video is necessary.

2. Confirmation that you use a Windows PC and can edit in Adobe Premiere Pro.

3. Confirmation that your PayPal account is active and can RECEIVE payments.

4. Confirmation that you can reliably attend the initial training hours and complete assignments. If you have another job, please make sure the schedule is realistic before applying.

5. If you have wedding-editing experience, one link to your best wedding highlight. This is optional.



We value reliability, careful work and a willingness to learn. We look forward to meeting our next long-term team member.

title: Real Estate - Acquisitions VA
description:
Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist (Remote)



ABOUT US

Price Real Estate Investments is a U.S.-based real estate investment company purchasing properties directly from homeowners across multiple markets. Our team works remotely to build relationships with sellers, evaluate opportunities, negotiate purchases, and move deals toward closing.



We’re hiring an experienced Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist who can confidently speak with homeowners, present offers, handle objections, and guide sellers toward signed purchase agreements.



This is a hands-on phone sales position. We’re looking for someone who can negotiate and close, but also stays organized, documents information accurately, follows through, and takes ownership of their work.



COMPENSATION

$10 USD per hour base pay, paid on the 1st and 15th of each month.



Monthly Contract Bonuses:

• Bronze: 2 qualified signed contracts = $500 bonus

• Silver: 3 qualified signed contracts = $1,500 bonus

• Gold: 4 qualified signed contracts = $2,000 bonus

• Platinum: 5 qualified signed contracts = $2,500 bonus



For each qualified contract above five in the same month, you may earn an additional $500, subject to ownership approval.

You receive the bonus for the tier you reach, not the sum of all tiers. Contracts count toward the month in which they are fully signed by the seller and approved by ownership as qualified and realistic. Ownership determines contract qualification and agent credit.



Quarterly Consistency Bonus:

Earn an additional $2,000 by securing at least three qualified signed contracts in each month of a calendar quarter. This rewards consistent monthly production, not just the total number of contracts across the quarter.

Quarterly bonuses are reviewed after the quarter ends and paid on the next regular payroll after ownership approval.



SCHEDULE

Full-time, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Central Time, following U.S. daylight saving changes.

This is a fully remote position requiring reliable availability, a quiet workspace, and a dependable computer and internet setup.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Speak directly with homeowners. Build rapport and gather accurate information about property condition, motivation, timeline, occupancy, ownership, and price expectations.

• Evaluate opportunities and present offers. Review comparable properties, help evaluate pricing, and present offers approved by our acquisitions department.

• Negotiate and close. Handle objections, negotiate within approved amounts and terms, and guide sellers toward signed purchase agreements using DocuSign.

• Stay on top of follow-up. Work new leads, scheduled callbacks, pending offers, and ongoing seller follow-up according to team priorities.

• Keep FreedomSoft accurate. Maintain clear notes, correct contact information, current statuses, and specific next steps. Document what sellers actually say rather than making assumptions.

• Work closely with our team lead. Participate in coaching and call reviews, apply feedback, and communicate problems early.



TRAINING AND ONGOING INTAKE RESPONSIBILITIES

Initial training typically takes approximately three to four weeks, depending on progress. It includes reviewing SOPs, shadowing a senior team member, practicing calls, learning our CRM, and receiving feedback.

After training, you will handle seller intake and lead processing while management evaluates your readiness to make offers independently. Approval depends on call handling, accuracy, follow-through, consistency, and response to coaching, not simply time in the role.



Seller intake and lead processing remain regular responsibilities after you begin making offers. This is not a closer-only position. Your assignments will vary based on lead volume, pending offers, and team priorities.



WHAT IT TAKES TO SUCCEED

Sales ability: You can listen, uncover the real objection, communicate the value of our offer, and ask for a decision without sounding aggressive or robotic.

Ownership and reliability: You complete assigned work, keep commitments, and communicate when you are behind or need help. You do not quietly skip required work to catch up.

Attention to detail: You clarify conflicting information, preserve important details, and keep CRM records accurate so the next person can trust your notes.

Coachability: You bring your experience while remaining willing to learn our process, follow approved scripts and rebuttals naturally, and apply feedback.

Consistent follow-up: You stay professional and persistent through our approved calling, texting, and follow-up process, including when results are slow.



REQUIREMENTS

• At least two years of experience in real estate acquisitions or seller negotiations.

• Experience personally presenting offers, handling objections, and moving sellers toward signed purchase agreements. Be prepared to explain your own results and what other team members handled.

• Strong spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate clearly and naturally with U.S. homeowners.

• Familiarity with comparable sales, ARV, repair considerations, and purchase agreements.

• Comfort using CRMs and outbound dialers. FreedomSoft experience is helpful but not required.

• Ability to make 100 or more outbound calls per day when assigned to intake or outbound calling, while meeting the expectations for your assigned work.

• A reliable computer, high-speed internet, quality headset, quiet workspace, and a practical backup plan for internet or power interruptions.



WHY JOIN US?

You’ll have clear processes, training, coaching, and performance-based earning opportunities with a remote real estate investment team.

We’re looking for a long-term team member who wants to improve, contribute consistently, and turn seller conversations into qualified signed contracts.



HOW TO APPLY

 your application to: 

Use the subject line: Real Estate Acquisitions Application - OJPH



Include both of the following:

Your résumé: Highlight your relevant real estate acquisitions, seller-negotiation, and phone-sales experience. A 1-2 minute voice recording in English: Briefly introduce yourself, describe your most recent relevant role and day-to-day responsibilities, and explain your experience speaking with homeowners, making offers, handling objections, or securing signed contracts. Be clear about what you personally handled.



Speak naturally in your own voice. Do not read a prepared script or use AI-generated audio. We want to hear how you communicate and learn about your relevant experience. Audio is sufficient; video is optional.



You may attach the recording or provide a link that opens without requesting access.



Applications missing the résumé or introductory recording will not move forward.
