Full-time, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Central Time, following U.S. daylight saving changes.

This is a fully remote position requiring reliable availability, a quiet workspace, and a dependable computer and internet setup.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Speak directly with homeowners. Build rapport and gather accurate information about property condition, motivation, timeline, occupancy, ownership, and price expectations.

• Evaluate opportunities and present offers. Review comparable properties, help evaluate pricing, and present offers approved by our acquisitions department.

• Negotiate and close. Handle objections, negotiate within approved amounts and terms, and guide sellers toward signed purchase agreements using DocuSign.

• Stay on top of follow-up. Work new leads, scheduled callbacks, pending offers, and ongoing seller follow-up according to team priorities.

• Keep FreedomSoft accurate. Maintain clear notes, correct contact information, current statuses, and specific next steps. Document what sellers actually say rather than making assumptions.

• Work closely with our team lead. Participate in coaching and call reviews, apply feedback, and communicate problems early.



TRAINING AND ONGOING INTAKE RESPONSIBILITIES

Initial training typically takes approximately three to four weeks, depending on progress. It includes reviewing SOPs, shadowing a senior team member, practicing calls, learning our CRM, and receiving feedback.

After training, you will handle seller intake and lead processing while management evaluates your readiness to make offers independently. Approval depends on call handling, accuracy, follow-through, consistency, and response to coaching, not simply time in the role.



Seller intake and lead processing remain regular responsibilities after you begin making offers. This is not a closer-only position. Your assignments will vary based on lead volume, pending offers, and team priorities.



WHAT IT TAKES TO SUCCEED

Sales ability: You can listen, uncover the real objection, communicate the value of our offer, and ask for a decision without sounding aggressive or robotic.

Ownership and reliability: You complete assigned work, keep commitments, and communicate when you are behind or need help. You do not quietly skip required work to catch up.

Attention to detail: You clarify conflicting information, preserve important details, and keep CRM records accurate so the next person can trust your notes.

Coachability: You bring your experience while remaining willing to learn our process, follow approved scripts and rebuttals naturally, and apply feedback.

Consistent follow-up: You stay professional and persistent through our approved calling, texting, and follow-up process, including when results are slow.



REQUIREMENTS

• At least two years of experience in real estate acquisitions or seller negotiations.

• Experience personally presenting offers, handling objections, and moving sellers toward signed purchase agreements. Be prepared to explain your own results and what other team members handled.

• Strong spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate clearly and naturally with U.S. homeowners.

• Familiarity with comparable sales, ARV, repair considerations, and purchase agreements.

• Comfort using CRMs and outbound dialers. FreedomSoft experience is helpful but not required.

• Ability to make 100 or more outbound calls per day when assigned to intake or outbound calling, while meeting the expectations for your assigned work.

• A reliable computer, high-speed internet, quality headset, quiet workspace, and a practical backup plan for internet or power interruptions.



WHY JOIN US?

You’ll have clear processes, training, coaching, and performance-based earning opportunities with a remote real estate investment team.

We’re looking for a long-term team member who wants to improve, contribute consistently, and turn seller conversations into qualified signed contracts.



HOW TO APPLY:

 your application to: 

Use the subject line: Real Estate Acquisitions Application - OJPH



Include both of the following:

Your résumé: Highlight your relevant real estate acquisitions, seller-negotiation, and phone-sales experience. A 1-2 minute voice recording in English: Briefly introduce yourself, describe your most recent relevant role and day-to-day responsibilities, and explain your experience speaking with homeowners, making offers, handling objections, or securing signed contracts. Be clear about what you personally handled.



Speak naturally in your own voice. Do not read a prepared script or use AI-generated audio. We want to hear how you communicate and learn about your relevant experience. Audio is sufficient; video is optional.



You may attach the recording or provide a link that opens without requesting access.



Applications missing the résumé or introductory recording will not move forward.

title: Loan Officer Assistant (LOA) / Junior Mortgage Processor
description:
Ready to make your next career move?

Apply directly through our careers page: 
/careers/apply



About the Company:

BrokerVA is a specialized virtual assistant and operations support company dedicated exclusively to the mortgage industry. Designed to help mortgage brokers and lenders scale efficiently, the company provides trained, experienced mortgage professionals who integrate seamlessly into existing operations.



About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Loan Officer Assistant (LOA) / Junior Mortgage Processor with hands-on experience in the U.S. mortgage industry. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of borrower financial analysis, loan program eligibility, and the initial stages of the mortgage origination and processing workflow.



This role requires someone who can independently review loan applications, identify potential red flags, determine documentation needs, and prepare files for submission to underwriting. Experience working with wholesale lenders and broker-side mortgage operations is highly preferred.



Key Responsibilities

- Income Calculation and Analysis: Calculate and analyze borrower income, with a strong emphasis on self-employed borrowers, including reviewing tax returns, profit and loss statements, and other supporting financial documents.

- Borrower Financial Review: Evaluate credit reports, assets, liabilities, and income documentation to assess borrower qualifications and identify suitable loan programs.

- Loan Program Analysis: Identify potential loan options based on borrower qualifications, including Conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, and Non-QM, as applicable.

- Initial File Review: Identify red flags, discrepancies, missing information, and potential qualification issues during the initial review.

- Needs List Preparation: Request additional documentation and prepare clear, comprehensive needs lists to address outstanding items before submission.

- Loan Registration: Register loan files through various wholesale lender portals, such as UWM, Rocket Mortgage, PennyMac, TPO, Newrez, and other investors.

- Pricing and Initial Disclosures: Understand mortgage pricing and assist with preparing the initial Loan Estimate (LE) for disclosure, following applicable procedures and compliance requirements.

- Automated Underwriting System (AUS): Run and review AUS findings, identify eligibility issues or warnings, and help resolve findings by addressing documentation gaps or other concerns.

- Document Management: Upload, organize, and index loan documents in the appropriate loan origination system (LOS) and lender portals.

- Third-Party Orders: Order and track third-party services and documentation, such as title, appraisal, homeowners insurance, and other required reports.

- Document Review and Condition Preparation: Review documents received from borrowers and third parties to determine whether they adequately address anticipated underwriting requirements.

- Underwriting Submission: Prepare complete and properly documented loan files and submit them to underwriting through the appropriate lender portal.



Qualifications and Requirements

- At least 2 year of hands-on experience in U.S. mortgage origination, preferably in an LOA, Junior Processor, Loan Setup, or Mortgage Processing role.

- Strong knowledge of U.S. mortgage documentation and the loan origination process.

- Demonstrated experience calculating and analyzing income, especially for self-employed borrowers.

- Familiarity with borrower qualification guidelines and major mortgage loan programs.

- Experience registering loans through wholesale lender portals, preferably UWM, Rocket Mortgage, PennyMac, TPO, and Newrez.

- Working knowledge of mortgage pricing, initial Loan Estimates, and disclosure procedures.

- Experience running and interpreting AUS findings, such as DU and LPA.

- Familiarity with document uploading, indexing, third-party orders, and underwriting submission requirements.

- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, U.S.-based mortgage environment.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working on the broker/wholesale lending side, particularly with non-delegated lenders.

- Familiarity with mortgage LOS platforms such as Encompass, LendingPad, Arive, or similar systems.

- Experience reviewing complex self-employed income documentation and resolving initial loan qualification issues.

- Ability to manage files with minimal supervision and prepare them for underwriting without extensive training.



What We’re Looking For

We need someone who understands more than basic administrative support. The ideal candidate should be comfortable reviewing borrower financials, calculating income, evaluating loan eligibility, identifying potential issues, and preparing mortgage files for underwriting.



Candidates must have relevant, hands-on U.S. mortgage experience and be ready to apply their knowledge with minimal supervision.

description:

The ideal candidate combines exceptional social media content creation skills with hands-on experience managing GoHighLevel CRM systems, marketing automations, and lead generation campaigns.



This is a hands-on position for someone who can work independently, take ownership of assigned projects, and consistently deliver high-quality results without constant supervision.



Position Breakdown:



- 60% Social Media Management & Content Creation

- 40% GoHighLevel CRM & Marketing Automation



Key Responsibilities



1. Social Media Management & Content Creation (60%)



- Develop and execute monthly content marketing strategies and calendars across Instagram,
, TikTok, and YouTube.

- Create engaging social media posts, Reels, Stories, graphics, and short-form videos.

- Write compelling captions, attention-grabbing hooks, and effective calls to action.

- Design professional, visually appealing content using Canva and other creative tools.

- Edit videos using CapCut or similar software.

- Manage comments, direct messages, and audience engagement.

- Schedule and publish content consistently across multiple business accounts.

- Maintain consistent branding, messaging, and visual identity for each business.

- Research industry trends, competitors, and content opportunities.

- Use AI tools to improve content creation, productivity, and marketing performance.

- Monitor social media analytics, including reach, engagement, follower growth, clicks, and leads.

- Continuously test and improve content based on performance data.

- Collaborate with our marketing team to execute campaigns, promotions, and lead generation initiatives.



2. GoHighLevel CRM & Marketing Automation (40%)



- Manage and maintain existing GoHighLevel CRM accounts and subaccounts.

- Build, update, and troubleshoot automated workflows.

- Create and manage SMS and
 marketing campaigns.

- Maintain lead nurturing sequences and follow-up automations.

- Manage CRM pipelines, contact tagging, segmentation, and lead tracking.

- Create landing pages, forms, surveys, and marketing funnels.

- Monitor automation performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Ensure leads are properly captured, organized, and followed up with.

- Connect social media lead generation campaigns with GoHighLevel workflows.

- Track lead conversions, appointments, and campaign effectiveness.

- Troubleshoot CRM issues and coordinate with technical support or developers when necessary.

- Recommend improvements to increase efficiency, customer engagement, and lead conversion.



Required Qualifications



GoHighLevel Experience



- Minimum 2 years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience.

- Proven ability to independently build and troubleshoot workflows, pipelines, funnels, and automations.

- Experience with SMS and
 marketing campaigns.

- Understanding of lead generation, CRM management, and conversion tracking.



Social Media Experience



- Minimum 2 years of professional social media management experience.

- Proven experience managing multiple business social media accounts.

- Advanced proficiency with Canva.

- Strong experience creating and editing Reels and short-form videos using CapCut or similar software.

- Experience using Meta Business Suite and social media scheduling tools.

- Strong understanding of Instagram,
, TikTok, and YouTube marketing.

- Excellent English copywriting, grammar, and communication skills.

- Ability to develop and execute content marketing plans.

- Experience analyzing social media performance and adjusting strategies.



Professional Skills



- Ability to work independently, efficiently, and creatively.

- Strong organizational and time management skills.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

- Proactive problem-solving skills.

- Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT to improve marketing productivity.

- Reliable communication and willingness to collaborate with our U.S.-based marketing team.



Preferred Qualifications



- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

- Experience marketing dental, medical aesthetics, healthcare, or other consumer service businesses.

- Experience with Meta Ads Manager and paid social advertising.

- Familiarity with Google Analytics and marketing performance reporting.

- Experience with Zapier, Make, or other marketing integrations.

- Knowledge of AI-powered marketing automation.

- Experience generating qualified leads and appointment bookings through social media campaigns.



Work Expectations — Please Read Before Applying



We are looking for an individual who is committed to this position and comfortable working in a structured, accountable remote environment.



Please DO NOT apply if:



- You are unwilling to use company-approved screen and time-tracking software during scheduled working hours.

- You are an agency or work as part of a team that delegates assigned responsibilities to others.

- You are unable or unwilling to participate in scheduled Zoom meetings with our marketing team.

- You cannot consistently work the required U.S. Central Time schedule.

- You do not have actual hands-on experience with BOTH social media management and GoHighLevel.

- You require constant supervision to complete routine assignments.



This position is for an individual professional, not an agency or outsourced team.



Technical & Hardware Requirements



Candidates must have a professional remote work setup that includes:



- Reliable computer capable of handling video editing and CRM applications.

- Dual-monitor workstation.

- Noise-canceling headset.

- Stable, high-speed internet connection.

- Wired Ethernet (LAN) connection directly to the router.

- Backup internet connection in case of service interruptions.

- Backup power solution to minimize downtime during outages.

- Quiet, professional workspace suitable for Zoom meetings and daily collaboration.



Compensation & Benefits



- Hourly Pay: $5–$8 USD, based on experience and demonstrated skills.

- Performance Bonuses: Additional incentives based on qualified leads generated and measurable marketing results.

- Biweekly Payments: Consistent, reliable payment schedule.

- Remote Work: Work from home.

- Team Environment: Collaborate with an established U.S.-based marketing team.

- Long-Term Opportunity: Stable position with opportunities for professional growth.

- Career Development: Opportunity to expand responsibilities and compensation based on performance.



Application Requirements



To be considered, applicants MUST provide all of the following:



- Resume: Include your current location, professional experience, and relevant qualifications.

- GoHighLevel Experience: Briefly describe your experience managing GHL accounts, workflows, automations, and funnels.

- GHL Work Samples: Provide examples or screenshots of workflows, funnels, or automations you personally created, with confidential client information removed.

- Social Media Portfolio: Provide links to actual client or business social media accounts you have personally managed.

- Performance Results: Provide analytics screenshots demonstrating reach, engagement, clicks, follower growth, or lead generation results.

- Content Samples: Include examples of Reels, graphics, videos, or campaigns you personally created.

- Compensation Expectations: State your expected hourly rate in USD.

- Availability: Confirm your ability to work Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time.



Attention to Detail Test: To confirm you have read the entire job posting, please include your favorite color in the first sentence of your application.



Applications missing the required information may not be considered.



Interview Attendance & Professionalism



We value your time and make every effort to provide a professional and efficient interview experience.



Candidates who are selected for an interview are expected to:



- Confirm their scheduled interview appointment.

- Arrive on time and be prepared to discuss their experience.

- Communicate promptly if they need to reschedule.

- Provide accurate information regarding their qualifications and availability.



We understand that unexpected circumstances can arise. If you cannot attend your scheduled interview, please notify us as early as possible.



Repeated no-shows, intentional misrepresentation, or failure to communicate may result in removal from further consideration.



These expectations help us maintain a fair and respectful hiring process for all applicants.



Who Will Succeed in This Role?



We are not looking for someone who simply schedules social media posts or follows basic instructions.



We want a creative, technically capable, and results-oriented professional who understands how social media, marketing automation, and CRM systems work together to generate leads and grow a business.



If you take initiative, enjoy solving problems, produce high-quality content, and have proven GoHighLevel experience, we encourage you to apply.



We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Billing and Invoicing Specialist
description:
All You Need Services, LLC is looking for an experienced Billing & Invoicing Specialist to manage the company's billing and invoicing operations. We are looking for someone with extensive experience in preparing invoices, monitoring billings, tracking payments, and maintaining accurate financial records.



The ideal candidate must be detail-oriented, organized, proactive, and comfortable handling billing processes for a U.S.-based construction company.



Experience in the construction industry is a strong advantage.



Key Responsibilities



Billing and Invoicing



Prepare, review, and issue client invoices accurately and on time.



Manage progress billing, milestone billing, and project-based invoicing.



Review contracts, proposals, approved change orders, and project documentation to ensure accurate billing.



Monitor outstanding invoices and ensure billing schedules are followed.



Maintain organized and updated billing records.



Accounts Receivable and Payment Monitoring



Monitor customer payments and maintain accurate accounts receivable records.



Follow up on overdue invoices and outstanding balances.



Prepare accounts receivable aging reports.



Reconcile invoices against payments received.



Identify billing discrepancies and coordinate with the appropriate departments for resolution.



Financial Documentation and Reporting



Maintain accurate billing and payment documentation.



Prepare regular billing summaries and collection reports.



Coordinate with Project Managers, Operations, and Accounting regarding project billing.



Ensure all billing transactions are properly documented and recorded.



Assist with month-end billing reconciliation and financial reporting.



Administrative and Coordination



Coordinate with internal teams to obtain necessary billing information and supporting documents.



Track approved change orders and additional work for proper invoicing.



Maintain organized digital records of invoices, receipts, and payment confirmations.



Ensure billing procedures and deadlines are consistently followed.



Qualifications and Requirements



Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience in billing, invoicing, or accounts receivable.



Extensive experience handling high-volume invoicing and billing transactions.



Strong understanding of billing procedures, payment tracking, and accounts receivable management.



Experience preparing invoices, monitoring collections, and reconciling payments.



Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.



Experience using accounting, invoicing, or project management software.



Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.



Strong organizational and time-management skills.



Ability to work independently and meet strict deadlines.



Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



Preferred Qualifications



Previous experience working with U.S.-based companies or clients.



Construction industry experience is a major advantage.



Familiarity with construction billing, progress billing, and milestone-based invoicing.



Knowledge of AIA billing, Schedule of Values (SOV), retainage, change orders, and lien waivers.



Experience with QuickBooks, JobTread, or similar construction management and accounting platforms.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



Has extensive practical billing and invoicing experience, not just basic administrative knowledge.



Can independently manage the billing process from invoice preparation through payment monitoring.



Is proactive in identifying billing errors, discrepancies, and overdue accounts.



Can communicate professionally with clients and internal departments.



Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities and ensures deadlines are met.

title: HubSpot CMS Developer
description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a HubSpot CMS Developer to build and maintain client websites and landing pages. You’ll work with our designers and marketers to turn Figma designs into responsive, accessible pages and build reusable modules that content teams can update on their own.



What You’ll Do

- Develop and maintain custom HubSpot themes, page templates, and modules using HubL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

- Translate Figma designs into responsive website pages and campaign landing pages.

- Build flexible drag-and-drop sections and configure theme settings so content teams can create and update pages 

independently.

- Implement HubSpot forms and calls to action, then test submissions and conversion tracking before launch.

- Improve page speed, accessibility, and technical SEO. Test pages across browsers, devices, and screen sizes.

- Support website migrations and launches by validating redirects, links, forms, and tracking.

- Troubleshoot issues on existing client sites and document custom components for future updates.



What We’re Looking For

- Hands-on experience building and launching websites in HubSpot CMS, with a portfolio that shows your contributions.

- Proficiency in HubL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

- Experience with HubSpot Design Manager, the HubSpot CLI, and Git.

- Ability to turn Figma designs into responsive pages and build custom themes, templates, and modules that are easy for others to maintain.

- Working knowledge of web accessibility, technical SEO, and website performance.

- Clear communication and the ability to manage priorities across multiple client projects.



Nice to Have

- Experience building websites for B2B software, IT, or professional services companies.

- Experience migrating websites from WordPress, Webflow, or another CMS to HubSpot.

- Familiarity with HubDB, dynamic pages, or HubSpot API integrations.

- A relevant HubSpot Academy certification.



How to Apply

Submit your resume and links to two or three HubSpot websites or projects you’ve worked on. Private work samples are welcome if you can share them.

title: Remote Role — Senior Expert Revenue Manager (Short-Term Rentals) - Pricing Tool Knowledge Is Required

Part-Time | Remote | 20–30 hours/week

Preferred Location: Worldwide

RevTech is a fast-growing hospitality tech company based in London. We help hotels and short-term rentals grow revenue through smarter pricing, stronger visibility, and performance optimisation across platforms like Airbnb and 
.

Results over promises – We deliver measurable impact

title: High Proficiency English SEO Content Writer
description:
We are hiring a high proficiency English SEO content writer for this 45 hr / week position.



The job will be to:

-set up a website using a drag and drop web builder (no prior experience needed) 

-write SEO landing pages and articles for web pages on various service industries, 

- create social media pages for these sites (creation only, no continuous posting)

-communicate professionally with us

-independently work with and deliver tasks to our clients



The right applicant will:



- understand the basics of an SEO article (headers, intros, keywords, etc)

- have a willingness to learn new SEO concepts

- make sure the content is relevant for readers, original and written in a way that flows naturally

- understand how to use basic AI tools

- use a website building tool (no past experience needed)

- be meticulous with details and communication with us and with our clients



The BEST applicant will be able to:

- have a native level of understanding of the English language. if you cannot hold a casual conversation without the assistance of an app, please do not apply. 

- be a self-starter and remain on task

- take feedback and apply it without needing many reminders

- communicate with a team promptly, clearly, and effectively

- always be looking for ways to improve, both for themselves and for the company



The job is full-time and long term. There is always more work for those who are diligent, professional, and consistent. Please do not apply if you cannot commit to 45 hr per week.



Please fill out this form to be considered. 



This is a long term job so we are being selective. Please, only apply if you are a writer and have worked with SEO before. Only serious applicants who are willing to give their best and to prove their competency by way of a real sample should apply.

title: Appointment Setter (US Market Expert)
description:
We are Jumper Media, a dynamic digital marketing agency specializing in social media management and growth strategies. We help businesses harness the power of social platforms to build their brands and drive exceptional results.



We are looking for a high-caliber Appointment Setter who understands the psychology of sales. We do not want robotic dialers or script-readers. We need a sharp, relentless prospector who knows how to control a conversation, diagnose business pain points, and qualify leads before handing them off to our closing team. If you understand that your job is not just to book a meeting, but to book a highly qualified, revenue-generating meeting, this role is for you.



This role is NOT for you if:



You sound like a robot reading a script.

You freeze when a prospect gives you a basic objection (e.g., "Send me an
," or "We already have an agency").

You don’t know how to qualify a lead and just want to put anyone on the calendar to hit a quota.

You lack a fundamental understanding of digital marketing and social media growth.

You require micromanagement to hit your daily call volume and follow-ups.



The Role & What You’ll Do



As our front-line prospector, you are the first impression of Jumper Media. You will be responsible for fielding inbound inquiries, executing outbound follow-ups, and strategically prioritizing leads to maximize our sales team's revenue potential.



Identify, engage, and qualify potential clients over the phone, converting at least 50% of inbound calls into scheduled, qualified appointments.

Properly explain our services, asking the right probing questions to ensure the prospect is a strong fit before they speak to a closer.

Navigate past gatekeepers and handle initial resistance with tact, confidence, and sales psychology.

Manage your pipeline flawlessly. Develop and distribute daily appointment reports and execute complete end-of-day call sheets.

Analyze the lead pool and prioritize appointments that have the highest potential for revenue generation.



Qualifications & Sales Acumen



3+ years of highly successful B2B/B2C appointment setting or SDR experience specifically in the US Market.

You must have exceptional spoken and written English, capable of holding high-level, fluid business conversations with US business owners.

You understand lead qualification frameworks (like BANT), active listening, and objection handling.

Ability to multitask, manage CRM data efficiently (Microsoft Office Suite proficiency required), and operate independently.

A relentless, positive attitude with the ability to handle rejection and keep dialing.



Technical Requirements (Mandatory)



Since this is a high-volume remote role, your tech stack must be unshakeable:

Internet: Lightning-fast, stable connection (Hardwired connection preferred).

Hardware: At least Intel Core i5 (higher generation) or equivalent, with 8–16GB RAM.

Contingency Plan: You must have verified backups for both electricity and internet disruptions.





HOW TO APPLY:

title: Part Time Virtual Assistant - Marketing Operations
description:
Position: Part-Time Real Estate Virtual Assistant — Marketing & Operations



Company: Luminary Homes Group LLC

Compensation: Target 360–450/month

Schedule: Approximately 15–20 hours per week, flexible with some U.S. Eastern Time overlap

We are looking for an organized, creative virtual assistant to support a growing Ohio real estate business.

Responsibilities:

Edit short-form videos for
 and Instagram

Create social media graphics & schedule posts & ads using provided outlines and templates

Maintain and organize leads in CRM

Assist with campaigns and client follow-up

Coordinate monthly real estate events

Assist with completing transaction documents (from templates)

title: SEO, Google Ads & Marketing Automation Specialist (Full-Time, 2 B2B Manufacturers)
description:
We are two B2B manufacturers in North America. One makes high-end commercial planters for landscape architects, designers, and contractors. The other makes industrial ventilation equipment. We are looking for one hands-on specialist to join our small marketing team, full-time, for a long-term commitment starting in December 2026 or January 2027.



The idea behind this role

We don’t want someone who manually edits 200 meta titles one by one. We want someone who builds the system that does it. AI should do about 95% of the legwork on repetitive tasks, and a human reviews the final 5% before anything goes live. You will design those systems, test them on one company, then adapt them for the other. A workflow built for one company should be reusable by the other, with only the settings changing.



What you will do

Plan and run SEO work across two websites, one on Wix and one on Shopify. This includes metadata, internal linking, image optimization, content updates, indexing checks and AI-search (GEO) optimization.

Use Claude and other AI tools to automate repetitive SEO, content, reporting and data tasks.

Build automations between our tools so data and tasks flow without manual copying.

Support Google Ads campaigns: setup, monitoring, reporting and optimization.

Support B2B prospecting and outreach in Apollo: lists, sequences, data hygiene and follow-up.

Support social media content and our newsletter and database processes.

Build a review step into every automation: a validation queue, a change log and a way to roll back.

Document what you build in short runbooks, so a teammate can run it without you.



Our stack

Wix, Shopify, HubSpot, Apollo, Google Ads, Semrush, Google Search Console. We work with Claude daily. You don’t need to know all of these, but you should be strong in several and quick to learn the rest.



What we are looking for

Proven experience in SEO (technical and content), ideally with results you can show.

Hands-on use of Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools in daily work, with examples of prompts, workflows, or automations you built.

Experience with Google Ads and Semrush.

Experience with Apollo or a similar outreach tool.

Experience with a no-code automation tool and, ideally, light scripting.

Strong written English and attention to detail. Typos and sloppy work are not acceptable.

Self-starter who works without micromanagement and takes ownership of results.

Bonus: experience with Wix, Shopify or HubSpot, B2B manufacturing or construction, and US/Canada SEO.



How we work

Team: You join a small team made up of the founder, an SEO strategist, a full-time teammate, and a few marketing partners. You and your teammate work together on the same projects. You attend the same meetings and share the same knowledge.

Direction: The founder sets priorities. The SEO strategist directs the SEO strategy. If requests ever conflict, you ask the founder.

Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week. You must be available for all meetings held early in the Eastern Time (US/Canada) workday, and for at least 4 hours of overlap with our hours each day.

Reporting: A short end-of-day report, written by you (not by AI), with numbers and links to your work. You also keep your Trello tasks up to date.

Growth: You will have a clear strategy and tools to work with. We want a long-term partner who grows with us.



How to apply

Please send a cover letter that answers the questions below. Short, specific answers are best. Generic or AI-copied answers will not move forward.



Describe one workflow or automation you built that saved significant time (what it did, which tools, and the result). Did you reuse it for another company or project? How did the second time compare to the first?

What is your experience level with Wix and Shopify? How do you approach a technical SEO audit and bulk updates (metadata, images) on these platforms?

How do you use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Perplexity in your daily work? How do you keep quality high and make sure a human checks the results before they go live?

What is your experience with B2B outreach, and with tools such as Apollo or HubSpot?

What is your experience with Google Ads and Semrush?

Have you worked with manufacturing, construction or architectural clients? Have you run SEO for both the Canadian and US markets? How do you handle regional keyword differences?

Please confirm you can attend early-morning Eastern Time meetings and share your ideal schedule.

What is your expected rate? Please specify the currency (USD).

title: Business Development Representative
description:
We're looking for a **Senior Cold Caller** to own outbound phone-based outreach for a newly founded private equity firm actively sourcing acquisition targets across IT managed services, marketing agencies, BPO, accounting and finance, logistics, SaaS, software development, and recruiting. You will make a high volume of outbound calls to business owners and company leaders to identify potential acquisition interest, qualify conversations, and book meetings for the deal team.



This is a pure cold calling role, and a senior one. We are looking for someone with more than 5 years of experience as an SDR. You will be dialing business owners and operators all day, opening conversations from cold, and moving qualified interest forward to the next step. The work is repetitive, the rejection rate is high, and results come from consistent volume and a professional, confident phone manner. If you are an experienced SDR who is resilient, disciplined, and motivated by a clear and measurable output, this role is a strong fit.



## Why You'll Want to Join



- You will be paid in **USD** (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

- **Paid Time Off** in accordance with company policy

- Observance of **Holidays** per company guidelines

- **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive

- This role requires availability during **US business hours**

- Work at the front end of the deal pipeline for a newly founded private equity firm with an active acquisitions thesis

- High-activity role with clear metrics and direct impact on deal flow



## What You'll Work On



**High-Volume Outbound Cold Calling**



- Make high-volume outbound calls to business owners and company leaders across target verticals daily

- Open cold conversations professionally and pivot quickly to qualify acquisition interest

- Handle objections confidently and keep conversations moving toward a booked meeting or callback

- Maintain a consistent, high call volume throughout the full working day without losing energy or quality



**Lead Qualification and Pipeline Management**



- Qualify prospects based on defined criteria including business type, revenue range, ownership structure, and interest level

- Log all call activity, outcomes, and notes accurately in the CRM after every interaction

- Book qualified meetings for the deal team with full context and qualification notes

- Follow up on warm contacts and callbacks consistently



**Reporting and Communication**



- Meet daily and weekly call volume targets consistently

- Report on call activity, connect rates, and meetings booked regularly

- Flag patterns in objections or prospect feedback that could improve targeting or messaging



## What You Bring



- More than 5 years of experience as an SDR, with a track record of booking meetings or qualified conversations from cold outreach

- Confident, clear, and professional phone presence with the ability to engage a business owner or executive from a cold call

- Comfortable with high rejection rates and able to reset quickly between calls without losing momentum

- Fluent, professional spoken English; this is a phone-first role and your voice is the product

- Organized with clean CRM habits and accurate call logging

- Reliable, self-directed, and disciplined with the ability to hit daily activity targets independently

- Quiet, professional calling environment and reliable high-speed internet



## Nice to Have



- Experience cold calling in a B2B context including business owners, executives, or operators

- Background in deal sourcing, business development, or financial services outreach

- Familiarity with the verticals being targeted including IT services, marketing agencies, BPO, accounting, logistics, SaaS, or recruiting



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your **updated resume**

2. A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself, describing your SDR and cold calling experience, and giving an example of how you handle a business owner who immediately says they are not interested in selling



**Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.**



If you are an experienced SDR who is resilient, disciplined, and comfortable making a high volume of cold calls to business owners every day, this role gives you the volume, the mission, and the direct impact to do your best work.

title: Experienced California Legal Assistant
description:
Full-Time Remote Position

Compensation: $700 per month

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM Pacific Time

Alternative schedules may include Saturday and Sunday, depending on the assigned shift.



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced, independent, and highly organized Legal Assistant to help manage approximately 4 to 6 active California legal matters.



This is a hands-on role for someone who can prepare legal documents, complete court forms, handle electronic filings, communicate with courts and attorneys, monitor deadlines, organize evidence, and keep every case moving without constant supervision.



Experience with California family law, civil litigation, restraining orders, discovery, and Los Angeles County Superior Court is strongly preferred.



Responsibilities



-Maintain a master tracker for all cases, hearings, deadlines, filings, and next actions.

-Review court orders, minute orders,
s, discovery, and case documents.

-Draft motions, pleadings, declarations, objections, notices, and other legal documents under direction.

-Draft discovery requests, responses, deficiency letters, subpoenas, and meet-and-confer correspondence.

-Complete California Judicial Council forms and related court forms.

-Prepare exhibits, attachments, proposed orders, and proofs of service.

-Handle California family law and civil electronic filings.

-Monitor filings until accepted and promptly correct rejected submissions.

-Check court dockets for new filings, rulings, orders, and hearing dates.

-Call court clerks, attorneys, law offices, agencies, and other authorized contacts.

-Coordinate signatures, service, transcript requests, records requests, and document delivery.

-Assist with authorized online claims, FBI reports, police reports, and government submissions using verified information.

-Transcribe court hearings and recordings when legally permitted.

-Organize evidence, including
s, messages, recordings, photographs, transcripts, and court documents.

-Prepare hearing packets, case summaries, timelines, and daily status reports.

-Research California court procedures, local rules, forms, and filing requirements.



Required Skills



You should be comfortable with:



-California family law and civil litigation

-Drafting pleadings, motions, and discovery

-Completing California court forms

-Electronic filing and service systems

-Calling clerks, attorneys, and government agencies

-Court docket monitoring

-Hearing preparation and transcription

-Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Word, and PDF tools

-ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools



AI may assist with research and drafting, but all deadlines, laws, filing requirements, citations, and case facts must be independently verified.



Working Standards



-Be online and ready before your assigned shift.

-Take ownership of tasks through completion.

-Follow up without waiting to be reminded.

-Never guess about deadlines, court requirements, or filing status.

-Verify important information and provide the source.

-Keep every task marked as Completed, Pending, Waiting, or Blocked, with the next action listed.

-Maintain strict confidentiality.

-Do not provide independent legal advice or engage in the unauthorized practice of law.



You Will Be Successful When



-No important deadline is missed.

-Every case has a clear next action.

-Filing packages are complete and prepared early.

-Rejected filings are corrected promptly.

-Hearings are organized in advance.

-Evidence and documents can be found immediately.

-The court filing systems you have used.

title: Guest Operations VA
description:
Guest Operations VA — Vacarya

50-60 hours per week

Full time



About Vacarya

Vacarya is a short-term rental business. We operate 50+ furnished units in the USA and support a growing network of clients who run short-term rentals under our model. Most stays are booked through [Airbnb / VRBO / direct]. Day-to-day operations run through a remote team working with local cleaning and maintenance crews.



The role

You'll be the first point of contact for our guests and the person who keeps daily operations moving. You'll answer messages, solve problems, coordinate cleaners and maintenance, and make sure every guest has a smooth stay from booking to checkout.



We need someone who writes warmly and clearly, stays calm under pressure, and proactive. 



Who we're looking for

An organized, reliable person who takes ownership. You don't wait to be told what to do next: you check open issues, follow up until they're closed, and tell us when something in our process isn't working.



What you'll do

Guest communication

• Reply to guest messages in Hostaway before, during and after each stay. Slow or missed replies are the biggest driver of bad reviews, so speed matters.

• Handle check-in and access issues, Wi-Fi, house rules, booking changes, cancellations, early check-in / late checkout, and pet and parking requests.

• Calm unhappy guests and fix the problem before it becomes a bad review, including refunds within our guidelines.

• Ask guests who had a great stay to leave a review.

Reviews and platform cases

• Track review scores by unit and flag units that are slipping.

• Respond to reviews, and work with platform support on removal requests for reviews that break policy.

• Handle Resolution Center cases and damage claims.

Operations

• Dispatch and follow up on cleaning and maintenance issues with local teams until they're closed.

• Keep listings, check-in guides and unit details (door codes, Wi-Fi, instructions) accurate.

• Keep our project management platform current: tasks, maintenance tracker, SOPs.

• Pull daily and weekly reports on guest issues, reviews and unit performance.



Must have

• 2+ years in short-term rental guest communication or operations, with Airbnb as your main channel

• Experience managing a 80+ unit portfolio

• Excellent written English that reads warm and natural, not scripted

• Good judgment on when to fix, when to refund and when to escalate

• Strong organization and follow-through: nothing gets dropped

• Comfortable in Google Sheets (basic formulas, filters)

• Reliable internet with a backup connection and backup power

• Available full-time on eastern standard time zone hours



Nice to have

• Experience at Airbnb Support 

• Experience writing SOPs or training other VAs



What we offer

• Full-time, long-term role

• Raises based on performance reviews

• Room to grow as Vacarya's portfolio grows



How to apply

Your application must include all of the following:

1.  Start your message with "VACARYA GUEST" so we know you read the full post.

2.  Your resume (PDF).

3.  A 1–2 minute video introducing yourself and your short-term rental experience

4.  Your reply to the guest message below, plus 2–3 lines on what you'd do behind the scenes. Write it yourself, the way you'd actually send it.

    "Hi, the door code you sent isn't working. We've been outside for 25 minutes with two kids and it's 11pm. If we're not inside in 10 minutes I want a full refund."

5.  In 3–5 sentences: a time a guest was unhappy and you turned the stay around. What happened, what did you do, and how did it end?



Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed.

title: SaaS Operations Specialist / Technical Virtual Assistant — AI Startup
description:
SaaS Operations Specialist / Technical Virtual Assistant — AI Startup



20 Hours/Week | Remote | $6 USD/Hour | Long-Term Opportunity



About Revi



Revi is a fast-growing AI SaaS company building conversion and communication technology for the fitness and wellness industry.



Our platform integrates with fitness CRM systems and uses AI, automation, and behavioral data to help businesses convert more leads, improve customer engagement, and automate communication throughout the customer lifecycle.



We're looking for an **exceptionally sharp, detail-oriented SaaS Operations Specialist / Technical Virtual Assistant** to join our growing team.



**This is NOT a traditional virtual assistant position.**



You will not be managing calendars, booking travel, or performing basic administrative work.



You'll be working directly inside our software platforms, helping our Customer Success team execute important technical and operational tasks across multiple client accounts.



We're looking for someone who is **smart, technical, extremely organized, dependable, and obsessive about accuracy.**



What You'll Be Doing



A large part of this role involves configuring, managing, and maintaining client accounts across multiple SaaS platforms.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Creating and configuring campaigns inside the Revi platform

- Building campaign conditions, triggers, and automation logic

- Replicating campaigns across multiple client locations

- Copying and configuring SMS campaigns inside EZ Texting

- Ensuring Revi campaigns and EZ Texting campaigns match exactly

- Setting up new client accounts during onboarding

- Configuring client-specific automations, messaging, and workflows

- Performing repetitive but highly important technical tasks across multiple accounts

- Quality-checking your own work to ensure everything is configured correctly

- Following detailed SOPs, checklists, and video instructions

- Identifying inconsistencies, errors, or potential problems before they affect clients

- Communicating clearly with our Customer Success team about completed work, questions, and issues



Example of a Typical Assignment



A client has 10 locations and wants to launch a new marketing campaign across all of them.



You may be responsible for taking the campaign from the first location, recreating it across the other nine locations, configuring the correct conditions and automation logic, transferring the messages into another software platform, and verifying that everything matches perfectly.



Some of this work is repetitive.



However, it requires someone who can stay focused, organized, and accurate while working efficiently.



**A small configuration mistake can affect real client communications. Accuracy is absolutely critical.**



Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys working with technology, solving problems, and making sure things are done correctly.



You should be someone who:



- Learns new software extremely quickly

- Is very comfortable navigating SaaS platforms

- Understands conditional logic and automated workflows

- Has exceptional attention to detail

- Can perform repetitive work without becoming careless

- Double-checks everything before marking a task complete

- Thinks critically rather than blindly following instructions

- Asks intelligent questions when something doesn't make sense

- Can follow complex written and video instructions

- Is highly organized and manages multiple accounts without mixing up information

- Takes ownership of assignments

- Notices when something looks incorrect

- Communicates clearly and proactively

- Has strong written and conversational English

- Is dependable, consistent, and comfortable working independently



**We value intelligence, accuracy, initiative, and the ability to learn quickly more than years of experience.**



Technical Experience



You do not need to be a software engineer or know how to code.



However, you should be naturally comfortable working with technology.



Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:



- SaaS platforms

- CRM systems

- Marketing automation software

- SMS marketing platforms

- Zapier

- GoHighLevel

- HubSpot

- ActiveCampaign

- 

- Airtable

- Asana

- Slack

- Excel / Google Sheets

- AI tools such as ChatGPT

- Software testing and quality assurance



Experience working for a SaaS company, marketing technology company, automation agency, or software startup is especially valuable.



The Person Who Will Succeed Here



You're the type of person who gets bothered when something is slightly wrong.



If you're assigned 50 campaigns to configure, campaign #50 should be just as accurate as campaign #1.



You don't just copy and paste. You understand what you're copying, where it belongs, and whether it makes sense.



If instructions say one thing but the software shows something different, you stop and ask instead of guessing.



You enjoy learning new systems and becoming so good at operating them that your team can trust you to get things done correctly without constant supervision.



**We want someone who takes pride in being the person everyone can rely on.**



Hours & Compensation



- **$6 USD/hour**

- Approximately 20 hours per week

- Fully remote

- Long-term opportunity

- Potential for increased hours and responsibilities as Revi grows

- Opportunity to gain hands-on experience working inside a growing AI SaaS company



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with the company and become a trusted member of our operations team.



---



How to Apply — IMPORTANT



**We are using a short Loom video as our first-round interview.**



Instead of scheduling an initial interview with every applicant, we want to hear directly from you.



To apply, you must record a **3–5 minute Loom video** answering all four questions below.



Please speak naturally and answer in your own words. We're not looking for a perfectly scripted presentation. We want to understand how you think, communicate, and approach your work.



Your Loom Video Interview — 4 Required Questions



**1. Tell us a little about yourself.**



Introduce yourself, tell us about your professional background, and explain why you're interested in working with a growing AI SaaS company like Revi.



**2. Tell us about your technical experience.**

**DETAILS MATTER**

title: digital marketing and lead generation specialist
description:
# Performance Marketing & Content Specialist



**Full-Time | Remote | UK Service Business**



We are an established and growing UK window cleaning and exterior cleaning business looking for a talented **Performance Marketing & Content Specialist** to take ownership of our digital marketing.



We already have established websites, social media pages and a large existing customer base. We are now looking for someone who can help us significantly grow our online customer acquisition as we expand into new areas.



This is a hands-on position combining **Google Ads, Meta Ads, lead generation, landing pages, social media, content creation and local community marketing.**



Our main goal is simple:



**Generate more high-quality customers at a profitable cost while continuing to build our brands online.**



## Google Ads – Core Responsibility



Google Ads will be one of the most important parts of your role.



You will be responsible for:



* Creating, managing and optimising Google Search campaigns

* Keyword and competitor research

* Geographic targeting across different UK towns and areas

* Keyword, match-type and negative keyword management

* Search-term analysis

* Writing and testing ad copy

* Managing bidding strategies and budgets

* Setting up and maintaining conversion tracking

* Monitoring cost per lead and cost per acquired customer

* Identifying opportunities to increase lead volume

* Continually testing and improving campaign performance



You should be confident taking ownership of Google Ads campaigns and making decisions based on data.



## Meta Ads – Core Responsibility



**Meta Ads is equally important to Google Ads in this position.**



You will manage advertising across
 and Instagram using **Meta Ads Manager**.



Responsibilities include:



* Creating and managing lead-generation campaigns

* Audience research and targeting

* Geographic targeting

* Creating and testing different offers

* Developing advertising copy and creatives

* Creating video advertisements

* Retargeting campaigns

* A/B testing

* Monitoring cost per lead

* Monitoring lead quality

* Tracking customer acquisition

* Scaling successful campaigns

* Identifying and stopping underperforming campaigns



We want someone who understands the difference between generating **cheap leads** and generating **quality leads that become paying customers**.



## Content Creation



Content creation is an important part of this position.



Our UK team will provide photographs and raw video footage from jobs. Your responsibility will be to turn this material into professional, engaging content.



You should be confident using:



* **CapCut**

* **Canva**

* Other video and graphic editing software

* AI editing and content tools where appropriate



You will create:



* Instagram Reels

* TikTok videos

*
 videos

* Before-and-after content

* Short-form advertising creatives

* Customer testimonials

* Educational content

* Promotional content

* Local/community content

* Graphics and social media posts



You should understand hooks, pacing, subtitles, captions, calls to action and how to turn simple raw footage into content people actually want to watch.



##
, Instagram & TikTok



You will help manage and grow our organic presence across:



*
 | Instagram | TikTok**



Responsibilities include:



* Planning and scheduling content

* Creating and editing posts

* Creating Reels and TikToks

* Repurposing successful content across platforms

* Researching relevant trends and content ideas

* Testing different styles of content

* Building brand awareness within the geographical areas we operate

* Helping develop our overall social media strategy



Experience with TikTok Ads is beneficial but not essential.



## Local
 Group & Community Marketing



An important part of this role will be actively finding potential customers through **local
 groups and community pages**.



We operate across multiple towns and continue to expand into new areas, so we want someone who is proactive in finding local online communities where potential customers are already looking for our services.



You will be expected to:



* Find and join relevant local
 groups and community pages

* Participate through an appropriate individual profile where permitted by the group's rules

* Regularly monitor local groups for people asking for **window cleaner recommendations**

* Look for posts requesting window cleaning, gutter cleaning and other relevant exterior cleaning services

* Respond quickly and professionally to relevant posts

* Introduce and recommend our services where appropriate

* Create promotional posts in groups that allow advertising

* Engage naturally with local communities rather than simply posting repetitive advertisements

* Find new groups within areas we currently cover

* Research groups within new locations before we expand into them

* Keep track of group rules and which groups allow promotional posts

* Direct interested customers to our website, quotation form or appropriate contact channel

* Track enquiries and customers generated through
 groups



We are **not looking for someone to spam groups or create fake customer recommendations**.



We want someone who can genuinely participate in local communities, spot opportunities and professionally introduce our business when someone is looking for the services we provide.



## Landing Pages & Conversion



You should be capable of creating and improving landing pages to support our Google and Meta advertising campaigns.



This includes:



* Creating campaign-specific landing pages

* Creating pages targeting different services and locations

* Building enquiry forms

* Writing effective headlines and calls to action

* Ensuring pages are mobile-friendly

* Improving conversion rates

* A/B testing pages and offers

* Connecting forms to our lead-management systems

* Meta Pixel setup

* Google Ads conversion tracking

* Google Analytics and Tag Manager where required



You do not need to be an advanced web developer, but you should be comfortable using modern landing-page builders and making changes yourself.



## Performance & Reporting



We are a **results-driven business**.



Followers, likes and views have value, but our primary objective is **generating paying customers**.



You will be expected to monitor and understand:



* Advertising spend

* Leads generated

* Cost per lead

* Cost per acquired customer

* Lead quality

* Conversion rates

* Google Ads performance

* Meta Ads performance

* Landing-page conversion rates

* Leads generated through local
 groups

* Best-performing advertisements and creatives

* Best-performing geographical areas

* Opportunities to scale



We want someone who can tell us:



**What worked? What didn't? Why? What should we test next?**



## What We're Looking For



You should have strong experience with:



* **Google Ads**

* **Meta Ads Manager**

*
 & Instagram advertising

* Lead-generation campaigns

* Google Search campaigns

* Conversion tracking

* Landing pages

* **CapCut**

* Instagram Reels

* TikTok

*
 groups/community marketing

* Copywriting

* Analytics and reporting



Previous experience generating leads for **local service businesses** would be a major advantage.



Experience marketing businesses in the **UK, USA, Canada or Australia** would also be beneficial.



## The Right Person



We're looking for someone who is:



* Proactive

* Creative

* Analytical

* Reliable

* Organised

* Comfortable working independently

* Excellent at written English

* Confident making decisions based on data

* Willing to experiment and test new ideas

* Comfortable engaging with people online

* Interested in learning new tools

* Focused on measurable business results



We don't want someone who waits to be told exactly what advert, video or post to create next.



We want someone who can understand our goals, analyse the results and proactively say:



**“Here's what I think we should try next.”**



## Working With Us



We already employ a **long-term team member based in the Philippines** who works closely with our UK team, so we have experience employing and supporting remote Filipino staff.



For shortlisted candidates, we're happy to arrange an opportunity to speak privately with our existing Philippines-based team member, **Mikaella**.



You can ask her directly about her experience working with us, our management style, reliability of pay, working environment and what it's genuinely like being part of our team.



We believe recruitment works both ways. We want to make sure you're right for us, but we also want you to be comfortable that **we're the right employer for you**.



We're looking for someone who wants to build a **long-term career with us as the company continues to grow.**



## Salary



**?45,000–?65,000 PHP per month, depending on experience and ability.**



This is a **full-time, long-term position**.



## How to Apply



Please provide:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Details of your experience with **Google Ads**.

4. Screenshots or evidence of previous advertising results.

, Instagram or TikTok content you have created.

 groups to generate leads or customers**.

title: AI Content Creator (Instagram Carousels & TikTok Slideshows
description:
Hiring: AI Content Creator (Instagram Carousels & TikTok Slideshows)



We're looking for a creative content creator who knows how to make high-quality Instagram carousels, graphic posts, and TikTok slideshows using AI tools.



We're building a brand in the cooking, food, and healthy eating niche, so most of the content you'll be making will revolve around recipes, meal ideas, grocery hauls, food comparisons, and more.



We're looking for someone who has a really good eye for design and understands what makes content perform well on social media.



Your portfolio matters more to us than your resume. We don't care how many years of experience you have. We care about what you can actually create.



What You'll Be Doing



Creating Instagram carousels and TikTok slideshows.



Using AI tools to generate realistic food images and graphics.



Designing posts that look clean, aesthetic, and engaging.



Researching viral content and coming up with new ideas.



Taking inspiration from existing posts and making them even better.



Working with our team to consistently produce high-quality content.



What We're Looking For



Experience making Instagram carousels, TikTok slideshows, or similar graphic content.



Strong design skills, including typography, layouts, and colors.



Experience using AI image-generation tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Nano Banana, Flux, etc.



Comfortable using Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or similar tools.



Someone who understands social media trends and what makes people stop scrolling.



Good communication, attention to detail, and the ability to take feedback.



Someone who is resourceful and can figure things out without needing their hand held.



BIG PLUS: If you've worked in the cooking/food niche before, that's a huge advantage.



EVEN BIGGER PLUS: If you know how to generate realistic AI cooking videos using tools like Seeddance, Kling, or similar platforms, we'd love to see your work.



How to Apply



We're looking for people who actually put effort into their applications.



If you send us a generic AI-written application with no portfolio, we're not going to review it.



Please answer the questions below.



1. Show us your work. (MOST IMPORTANT)



Send us your portfolio with at least 5 of your best Instagram carousels, TikTok slideshows, or graphic designs.



If you have work in the food niche or have created AI-generated food images, definitely include those.



2. Find an Instagram carousel or TikTok slideshow in the food niche that you think is really well made.



Send us the link and explain what you like about it.



Also, tell us ONE thing you would improve about it and why.



3. Let's say we're making a TikTok slideshow titled "5 High-Protein Dinners That Actually Taste Good."



Walk us through how you'd design the first 3 slides.



What would the images look like? What text would you use? How would you make someone want to keep swiping?



Be specific.



4. Show us something you've made using AI.



Send us the final result, tell us what tools you used, and explain how you made it.



If you've made AI cooking videos, we'd especially love to see those.



5. What's the BEST piece of content you've ever created?



Show it to us and explain why you think it's your best work.



Also, tell us one thing you would change about it today.



A Few Final Things



We're not looking for someone who just throws images and text together in Canva.



We want someone who genuinely has a good eye for content, pays attention to small details, and is always looking for ways to make their work better.



Somewhere in your application, include the word MANGO so we know you've read the full job posting.



We're a small but ambitious team, and we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us long term.



If we're interested in your application, we'll reach out to you with a paid trial test. This will give us a chance to see your actual creative skills and how well we work together.



Looking forward to seeing your work!

title: AI Forward QA Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE



We are a focused software development team building and improving internal and customer-facing applications, including web admin tools, digital signage systems, and media-player software.



We're rebuilding and expanding our core platform while supporting products already used by customers. We have steady, ongoing work and are looking for someone who can grow into a long-term role with our team.



THE ROLE



We're looking for a detail-oriented QA Engineer who takes ownership of software quality and helps ensure our releases are reliable before they reach customers.



This role goes beyond following a checklist. You should understand what is being changed, think critically about what could break, and know when focused regression testing is sufficient versus when broader testing is needed.



You'll work closely with developers, designers, and product teammates to identify issues, verify fixes, and improve our testing processes.



We also encourage using AI tools to make testing more efficient, provided the results are independently reviewed and validated.



This is a contract-to-hire position with a path to full-time employment for the right person.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



 - Review requirements and code changes to plan and execute appropriate testing.

 - Perform functional, regression, and end-to-end testing across web applications.

 - Test real user workflows, edge cases, and unexpected behavior beyond the happy path.

 - Use browser testing, Playwright, and automated CI test suites to identify issues.

 - Write clear bug reports with reproduction steps, expected versus actual results, and supporting evidence.

 - Verify fixes and ensure changes don't introduce new problems.

 - Use AI tools to assist with test planning, troubleshooting, and potential code fixes while validating their output.

 - Communicate blockers, ask questions, and collaborate closely with the development team.

 - Help improve test coverage, QA processes, and release reliability.

 - Participate in short daily stand-ups with some overlap during U.S. working hours.



WHAT YOU BRING



Required

 - Experience testing web applications and understanding common user workflows.

 - Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

 - Ability to create meaningful test cases, identify edge cases, and prioritize regression testing.

 - Familiarity with browser developer tools and automated testing concepts.

 - Ability to write clear, reproducible bug reports and follow issues through resolution.

 - Comfortable using AI tools to support testing and troubleshooting without relying on them blindly.

 - Good written and spoken English communication skills.

 - Ability to work independently, manage responsibilities, and communicate proactively.



Nice to Have

 - Experience writing automated tests using Playwright.

 - Experience with CI pipelines, Git, and pull requests.

 - Familiarity with AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot.

 - Experience testing digital signage, media players, or connected-device applications.

 - Experience improving QA processes within a development team.



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



We care about reliable releases, not simply the number of bugs found or tests completed.

 - Identify meaningful bugs and regressions before they affect customers.

 - Apply good judgment when determining the appropriate scope of testing.

 - Take ownership of issues from discovery through final verification.

 - Communicate clearly and raise questions or blockers early.

 - Improve testing efficiency through automation, AI, and better QA practices.



WHY JOIN US



 - Contract-to-hire with a path to a full-time position.

 - Steady, ongoing work on real products used by customers.

 - Opportunities to shape QA processes and improve product quality.

 - Modern development workflows incorporating automation and AI.

 - Small, collaborative team where your contributions make a direct impact.



We're looking for someone practical, curious, communicative, and dependable who enjoys finding problems, understanding why they happen, and helping deliver better software.

Position Overview:

The Controller exists to own the financial backbone of a scaling, multi-company organization, keeping the books accurate, timely, and audit-ready every month, and to build and lead the Philippines-based accounting team that supports it. You’ll own the full accounting cycle and close, serve as the local finance leader in the Philippines, shape the structure and development of the PH team, and bring the controls, modern ERP/FP&A tooling, AI-enabled automation, and operating discipline (EOS or a similar system) a growing business needs.

Key Responsibilities:



• Own the full accounting cycle: general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, payroll (US payroll via third-party provider), and month-end close

• Lead, develop, and mentor the Philippines-based finance/accounting team: own team performance and development, help define team structure and standards, and participate in assessing and interviewing candidates as the team is built out

• Manage financial consolidation, intercompany transactions and eliminations, and consolidated reporting in partnership with the VP of Finance as the finance function expands across multiple companies

• Manage cash flow forecasting, daily cash positioning, and bank reconciliations

Prepare accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with US GAAP, at the individual company and consolidated level

• Develop and maintain internal financial controls and accounting policies; support compliance with US federal, state, and local tax and regulatory requirements in coordination with external US CPA and tax advisors

• Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and FP&A in partnership with the VP of Finance, including budget-to-actual reporting

• Maintain and optimize accounting systems and ERP (QuickBooks, NetSuite, or similar); identify gaps in existing processes and implement scalable improvements

• Apply AI and automation tools to streamline reconciliations, close, and recurring reporting

• Support the operating cadence with finance scorecards, quarterly priorities, and accountability rhythms (EOS/Traction or a similar operating system)

• Partner closely with the US-based VP of Finance and executive team across time zones, with clear documentation, async updates, and full close-calendar visibility



Required Qualifications:



• Years of experience: 15+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including at least 5 years in a Controller, Finance Director, or equivalent senior finance leadership role

• Team leadership: At least 5 years directly managing a finance or accounting team, with responsibility for team performance and development (we value the scope and complexity of the teams you’ve led over headcount)

• Industry background: Demonstrated experience supporting US-based companies (in-house or offshore/remote), ideally in a startup, founder-led, or PE-backed small-company environment (under 200 employees)

• Multi-entity scope: Hands-on multi-entity accounting experience, including intercompany transactions, eliminations, and consolidations

• Technical skills: Strong command of US GAAP and financial reporting standards; proficiency in accounting/ERP software and Microsoft Excel

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy, Accounting, Finance, or a related field

• Other: Hands-on experience with bank reconciliation, cash management, and financial close processes

• Communication: Excellent written and spoken English

• Work setup: Able to work US Central business hours (PH night shift) full-time; dedicated home office with reliable primary and backup internet and power



Big Pluses:



• EOS experience: working within the Entrepreneurial Operating System (scorecards, Rocks, Level 10 meetings) or a comparable operating cadence

• AI experience: practical use of AI and automation tools in close, reconciliation, or reporting workflows

• FP&A and ERP tools: FP&A exposure and hands-on experience with modern ERP and planning platforms (e.g., NetSuite, Adaptive, Planful, Cube, or similar)



Nice-to-Have:



• Licensed CPA (Philippines) or CMA certification

• Experience in healthcare, waste management, logistics, or a service-based industry

• Experience with US sales/use tax, 1099 reporting, or multi-state compliance

• Familiarity with HR administrative processes and people operations

• Track record of building finance teams and processes in a growing, multi-company environment



Compensation & Benefits:

per month (based on experience)

s.

Correct any technical issues.

9. Training & Final Handover

A walkthrough of the Shopify dashboard.

 automations.

.

Project Expectations

I am looking for someone who can take ownership of the technical development and deliver a complete ecommerce operation.

The final deliverable should include:

A professionally designed Shopify ecommerce website.

All provided products uploaded and organized.

Functional product pages and collections.

Automated customer
s and ecommerce workflows.

Payment and shipping configurations.

I want a website that is built with scalability in mind. The business should be able to expand its product catalog, introduce new products, run promotions, and add additional sales channels without needing to rebuild the entire system.
