title: Graphic Designer for Social Media & Real Estate Marketing
description:
Picture Your Property is a real estate photography and marketing company based in North Carolina, USA. We’re looking for a creative, dependable Graphic Designer to create social media content and marketing materials for our company and our clients.



This is a remote, part-time position starting at approximately 10 hours per week. Hours will grow as you become comfortable in the role and take on more work. We’re looking for someone interested in building an ongoing working relationship with our team.



We hired two team members through OnlineJobs.ph almost a year ago, and both are still working with us today. Both have increased their hours and their pay since joining. We’re hoping to find another person who can grow with us in the same way.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Design social media graphics, carousels, promotional materials, and other branded content.

• Create digital and print marketing materials for clients.

• Edit and naturally retouch photos of people while preserving their actual appearance.

• Adapt designs for different platforms and sizes.

• Follow each client’s brand guidelines, including fonts, colors, logos, and overall visual style.

• Keep brand assets, editable design files, and completed materials organized.

• Apply feedback and carry those lessons into future assignments.

• Use AI tools thoughtfully to support your creative process.



HOW WE ASSIGN AND MANAGE WORK



You will receive assignments through our proprietary software and our Slack channel. These are the two places you’ll need to check for new work, project instructions, feedback, and updates.



We’ll train you on our software and workflow. You should be comfortable learning a new system, keeping your work status current, and communicating through Slack so the team knows what is in progress, ready for review, or complete.



WORKING WITH MULTIPLE BRANDS



We work with different clients, each with their own identity. You need to be comfortable switching between brands while keeping their materials consistent and recognizable.



We’re looking for someone who understands layout, typography, spacing, and visual hierarchy, and can make thoughtful design decisions beyond simply filling in a template. Your work should reflect the individual client rather than making every brand look the same.



OUR APPROACH TO AI AND PHOTO EDITING



We use AI tools and welcome someone who knows how to use them well. However, we are strictly against finished graphics that look obviously AI-generated. Our clients expect polished, authentic materials that feel specific to their business.



We also do not allow AI to recreate or change the people we photograph. Do not replace or alter their faces, facial features, body shape, or identity. Natural retouching and corrections are welcome, but the person must still look like themselves.



Strong design judgment and careful review of your finished work are essential.



HOURS, DEADLINES, AND COMMUNICATION



This position starts at approximately 10 paid working hours per week, generally spread throughout the week. Hours will grow as you become comfortable in the role and our workload increases.



Real estate moves quickly, and most assignments require a 24-hour turnaround. You must be able to check our software and Slack during agreed working days, communicate promptly, and meet deadlines consistently.



We do not expect you to be online around the clock. We do need clear availability and reliable follow-through. If an assignment or deadline is unclear, ask questions early.



PAY AND GROWTH



Our pay structure rewards your ability to consistently deliver quality work at the pace our clients need:



• Training: $6 USD per hour while learning our processes, client brands, software, and delivery standards.

• First month after completing training: $7 USD per hour.

• Independent delivery: $8 USD per hour once your work consistently meets our standards and no longer requires supervision before delivery.

• For the right candidate: We are willing to pay up to $10 USD per hour once you can work independently and consistently demonstrate excellent work quality, reliable turnaround, and strong client satisfaction.



The $10 rate is not an automatic increase. It is available to someone whose performance and results justify that rate.



Progression depends on the quality of your creations, how reliably you meet turnaround times, and how satisfied our clients are with the finished materials. We also look for accurate branding, an efficient working pace, and the ability to apply feedback without repeating the same mistakes.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• A portfolio showing strong graphic design and social media content.

• Experience with Canva and Adobe Photoshop, or comparable design and photo editing tools.

• A good eye for typography, layout, and brand consistency.

• Natural portrait editing and retouching skills.

• Comfortable written English for communication and checking text in designs.

• Strong organization and attention to detail.

• Reliable internet access and a computer suitable for the work.

• Willingness to learn our proprietary software and use Slack for team communication.

• Willingness to learn our processes and new creative tools.



Experience with real estate marketing is helpful, but not required. This role focuses on graphic design, branded content, and editing photos of people, rather than primarily editing property photos.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction and a summary of your relevant experience.

2. A link to your portfolio. Point out two or three pieces that best demonstrate your social media design and branding skills, and explain your contribution.

3. Before-and-after examples of natural portrait retouching, if available.

4. The design, photo editing, and AI tools you use.

5. A brief explanation of how you organize assets and maintain consistency across multiple client brands.

6. Your experience using Slack and other task or project management software.

7. Your time zone, usual working availability, and earliest start date.

8. Confirmation that the starting hours, pay structure, and typical 24-hour turnaround work for you.



Please begin your application with “Picture Your Property Designer” so we know you read the full description.



We’re looking for someone who takes pride in their work, communicates clearly, and wants to grow with our team.

title: General Admin for tradie- Servicem8, Simpro, Tradify etc

We're a busy Australian trades and construction business, and we're growing. We've got strong work volume, a solid team on the tools, and a business owner who needs to get out of the weeds of day-to-day admin so we can focus on what we do best.



We're looking for an experienced Virtual Assistant who understands the trades and construction industry and can plug straight into our operations — not someone who needs six months of hand-holding to understand how a job management platform works.



About the Role



This is a hands-on, operational VA role supporting the day-to-day running of a trades and construction business. You'll take ownership of job management, customer communication, scheduling, quoting, invoicing, and general administration while working closely with the business owner and on-the-ground team.



If you've previously supported an Australian construction or trades business and you're confident using Tradify, ServiceM8, or simPRO, we want to hear from you.



What You'll Be Doing

Job and schedule management — creating and updating jobs, scheduling technicians and trades, and managing workflows in ServiceM8

Customer communication — responding to enquiries via phone, email, and SMS; booking and confirming appointments; and following up on outstanding jobs

Quoting and invoicing — drafting quotes, converting approved quotes to jobs, generating and sending invoices, and following up on outstanding payments

Data entry and administration — maintaining accurate job records, updating client information, and filing documentation

Supplier and subcontractor coordination — managing purchase orders and following up on materials, subcontractors, and timeframes as directed

Reporting support — pulling job reports and tracking completion rates, outstanding quotes, and revenue summaries

 and inbox management — triaging, responding to, and flagging priority items

General operations support — adapting to the business owner's needs and taking on additional responsibilities as the role grows



What We're Looking For



Non-Negotiable

Hands-on experience with Tradify, ServiceM8, and/or simPRO — you need to be operational from day one

Previous experience supporting an Australian construction or trades business — construction industry experience is strongly required

Strong written and verbal English — you'll be communicating directly with customers, suppliers, subcontractors, and team members

Understanding of trades/construction workflows, including jobs, scheduling, quoting, invoicing, suppliers, and subcontractors

Reliable, fast internet connection and a professional home office setup

Available to work Australian business hours (AEST)



Highly Regarded

Experience with the Jack App

Experience with Xero or similar accounting platforms

Familiarity with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Trello, or Asana

Previous VA or administration experience with an electrical, plumbing, HVAC, building, or construction business

Exposure to scheduling, dispatching, or coordinating field teams

Experience managing supplier and subcontractor communications

Experience handling construction documentation and job records



Who You Are

Proactive — you see what needs doing and move without waiting to be told

Detail-oriented — a missed job, incorrect quote, or incorrect invoice has real consequences in this industry

Calm under pressure — a busy workday doesn't throw you off

A clear communicator — you don't go quiet when things get complicated

Accountable — you take ownership and follow through without being chased

Independent — you're comfortable working with minimal supervision

Adaptable — you can learn how the business operates and adjust to the owner's pace and working style

Trades-savvy — you understand that construction and trades businesses move quickly and that accurate admin directly impacts the field team and customers



How to Apply

s, return missed calls, and assist with appointment confirmations and reminders.
